```
   304→/**
   305→ * Variants sub-facade: variant loading, selection, promotion.
   306→ * Usable standalone when callers only need variant state.
   307→ */
   308→export function useSharedVariantsState(input: SharedVariantsInput): SharedVariantsStateResult {
   309→  const {
   310→    media,
   311→    isFormOnlyMode,
   312→    variantFetchGenerationId,
   313→    initialVariantId,
   314→    selectedProjectId,
   315→  } = input.core;
   316→  const {
   317→    variants,
   318→    primaryVariant,
   319→    activeVariant,
   320→    isLoading: isLoadingVariants,
   321→    setActiveVariantId: rawSetActiveVariantId,
   322→    refetch: refetchVariants,
   323→    setPrimaryVariant,
   324→    deleteVariant,
   325→  } = useVariants({
   326→    generationId: variantFetchGenerationId,
   327→    enabled: !isFormOnlyMode,
   328→  });
   329→  const { setActiveVariantId: baseSetActiveVariantId, isViewingNonPrimaryVariant } = useVariantSelection({
   330→    media,
   331→    viewedGenerationId: variantFetchGenerationId,
   332→    rawSetActiveVariantId,
   333→    activeVariant,
   334→    variants,
   335→    initialVariantId,
   336→  });
   337→  const intendedActiveVariantIdRef = useRef<string | null>(activeVariant?.id || null);
   338→  const {
   339→    promoteSuccess,
   340→    isPromoting,
   341→    handlePromoteToGeneration,
   342→    handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot,
   343→  } = useVariantPromotion({
   344→    selectedProjectId,
   345→  });
   346→
   347→  useEffect(() => {
   348→    if (activeVariant?.id && activeVariant.id !== intendedActiveVariantIdRef.current) {
   349→      intendedActiveVariantIdRef.current = activeVariant.id;
   350→    }
   351→  }, [activeVariant?.id]);
   352→
   353→  const setActiveVariantId = useCallback((variantId: string) => {
   354→    intendedActiveVariantIdRef.current = variantId;
   355→    baseSetActiveVariantId(variantId);
   356→  }, [baseSetActiveVariantId]);
   357→
   358→  return {
   359→    section: {
   360→      list: variants || [],
   361→      primaryVariant,
   362→      activeVariant,
   363→      isLoading: isLoadingVariants,
   364→      setActiveVariantId,
   365→      refetch: refetchVariants,
   366→      setPrimaryVariant,
   367→      deleteVariant,
   368→      isViewingNonPrimaryVariant,
   369→      promoteSuccess,
   370→      isPromoting,
   371→      handlePromoteToGeneration,
   372→      handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot,
   373→    },
   374→    intendedActiveVariantIdRef,
   375→    activeVariant,
   376→    primaryVariant,
   377→    isViewingNonPrimaryVariant,
   378→    setPrimaryVariant,
   379→    refetchVariants,
   380→  };
   381→}
   382→
   383→/**
   384→ * Navigation sub-facade: keyboard nav, swipe nav, safe close.
   385→ * Usable standalone when callers only need navigation controls.
   386→ */
   387→export function useLightboxNavigationModel(input: SharedNavigationInput): UseSharedLightboxStateReturn['navigation'] {
   388→  const { onClose, readOnly } = input.core;
   389→  const {
   390→    hasNext = false,
   391→    hasPrevious = false,
   392→    handleSlotNavNext,
   393→    handleSlotNavPrev,
   394→    swipeDisabled,
   395→    showNavigation,
   396→  } = input.navigation;
   397→  const { safeClose, activateClickShield } = useLightboxNavigation({
   398→    onNext: handleSlotNavNext,
   399→    onPrevious: handleSlotNavPrev,
   400→    onClose,
   401→  });
   402→  const swipeNavigation = useSwipeNavigation({
   403→    onSwipeLeft: () => {
   404→      if (hasNext) handleSlotNavNext();
   405→    },
   406→    onSwipeRight: () => {
   407→      if (hasPrevious) handleSlotNavPrev();
   408→    },
   409→    disabled: swipeDisabled || readOnly || !showNavigation,
   410→    hasNext,
   411→    hasPrevious,
   412→    threshold: 50,
   413→    velocityThreshold: 0.3,
   414→  });
   415→
   416→  return {
   417→    safeClose,
   418→    activateClickShield,
   419→    swipeNavigation,
   420→  };
   421→}
   422→export const useSharedNavigationState = useLightboxNavigationModel;
   423→
   424→/**
   425→ * Shot management sub-facade: positioning, creation, association state.
   426→ * Usable standalone when callers only need shot management.
   427→ */
   428→export function useLightboxShotActions(input: SharedShotActionsInput): UseSharedLightboxStateReturn['shots'] {
   429→  const { media, selectedProjectId, onClose } = input.core;
   430→  const {
   431→    allShots,
   432→    onNavigateToShot,
   433→    onShotChange,
   434→    selectedShotId,
   435→    positionedInSelectedShot,
   436→    associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot,
   437→    optimisticPositionedIds,
   438→    optimisticUnpositionedIds,
   439→    onAddToShot,
   440→    onAddToShotWithoutPosition,
   441→    onShowTick,
   442→    onShowSecondaryTick,
   443→    onOptimisticPositioned,
   444→    onOptimisticUnpositioned,
   445→  } = input.shots;
   446→  const {
   447→    isCreatingShot,
   448→    quickCreateSuccess,
   449→    handleQuickCreateAndAdd,
   450→    handleQuickCreateSuccess,
   451→  } = useShotCreation({
   452→    media,
   453→    selectedProjectId,
   454→    allShots: allShots || [],
   455→    onNavigateToShot,
   456→    onClose,
   457→    onShotChange,
   458→  });
   459→  const computedPositionedInSelectedShot = useMemo(() => (
   460→    typeof positionedInSelectedShot === 'boolean' ? positionedInSelectedShot : undefined
   461→  ), [positionedInSelectedShot]);
   462→  const {
   463→    isAlreadyPositionedInSelectedShot,
   464→    isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition,
   465→    handleAddToShot,
   466→    handleAddToShotWithoutPosition,
   467→  } = useShotPositioning({
   468→    media,
   469→    selectedShotId,
   470→    allShots: allShots || [],
   471→    positionedInSelectedShot: computedPositionedInSelectedShot,
   472→    associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot,
   473→    optimisticPositionedIds,
   474→    optimisticUnpositionedIds,
   475→    onNavigateToShot,
   476→    onClose,
   477→    onAddToShot,
   478→    onAddToShotWithoutPosition,
   479→    onShowTick,
   480→    onShowSecondaryTick,
   481→    onOptimisticPositioned,
   482→    onOptimisticUnpositioned,
   483→  });
   484→
   485→  return {
   486→    isAlreadyPositionedInSelectedShot,
   487→    isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition,
   488→    handleAddToShot,
   489→    handleAddToShotWithoutPosition,
   490→    isCreatingShot,
   491→    quickCreateSuccess,
   492→    handleQuickCreateAndAdd,
   493→    handleQuickCreateSuccess,
   494→  };
   495→}
   496→export const useSharedShotState = useLightboxShotActions;
   497→
   498→function useSharedMakeMainVariantState(params: {
   499→  media: GenerationRow;
   500→  sourceGenerationData: GenerationRow | null;
   501→  isViewingNonPrimaryVariant: boolean;
   502→  activeVariant: GenerationVariant | null;
   503→  setPrimaryVariant: (id: string) => Promise<void>;
   504→  refetchVariants: () => void;
   505→  shotId?: string;
   506→  selectedShotId?: string;
   507→  onClose: () => void;
   508→}): UseSharedLightboxStateReturn['makeMainVariant'] {
   509→  const {
   510→    media,
   511→    sourceGenerationData,
   512→    isViewingNonPrimaryVariant,
   513→    activeVariant,
   514→    setPrimaryVariant,
   515→    refetchVariants,
   516→    shotId,
   517→    selectedShotId,
   518→    onClose,
   519→  } = params;
   520→  const canMakeMainVariantFromChild = !!sourceGenerationData && !!media.location;
   521→  const canMakeMainVariantFromVariant = isViewingNonPrimaryVariant && !!activeVariant?.location;
   522→  const canMakeMainVariant = canMakeMainVariantFromChild || canMakeMainVariantFromVariant;
   523→  const { isMakingMainVariant, handleMakeMainVariant } = useMakeMainVariant({
   524→    media,
   525→    sourceGenerationData,
   526→    canMakeMainVariantFromChild,
   527→    canMakeMainVariantFromVariant,
   528→    activeVariant,
   529→    setPrimaryVariant,
   530→    refetchVariants,
   531→    shotId,
   532→    selectedShotId,
   533→    onClose,
   534→  });
   535→
   536→  return {
   537→    canMake: canMakeMainVariant,
   538→    canMakeFromChild: canMakeMainVariantFromChild,
   539→    canMakeFromVariant: canMakeMainVariantFromVariant,
   540→    isMaking: isMakingMainVariant,
   541→    handle: handleMakeMainVariant,
   542→  };
   543→}
   544→
   545→function useSharedButtonGroupState(params: {
   546→  input: UseSharedLightboxStateInput;
   547→  localStarred: boolean;
   548→  handleToggleStar: () => void;
   549→  toggleStarPending: boolean;
   550→  isAddingToReferences: boolean;
   551→  addToReferencesSuccess: boolean;
   552→  handleAddToReferences: () => Promise<void>;
   553→  handleAddToJoin: () => void;
   554→  isAddingToJoin: boolean;
   555→  addToJoinSuccess: boolean;
   556→  handleGoToJoin: () => void;
   557→}) {
   558→  const {
   559→    input,
   560→    localStarred,
   561→    handleToggleStar,
   562→    toggleStarPending,
   563→    isAddingToReferences,
   564→    addToReferencesSuccess,
   565→    handleAddToReferences,
   566→    handleAddToJoin,
   567→    isAddingToJoin,
   568→    addToJoinSuccess,
   569→    handleGoToJoin,
   570→  } = params;
   571→  const { media, onClose } = input.core;
   572→  const {
   573→    showDownload,
   574→    isDownloading,
   575→    onDelete,
   576→    isDeleting,
   577→    isUpscaling,
   578→    handleUpscale,
   579→  } = input.actions;
   580→  const handleDelete = useCallback(async () => {
   581→    if (!onDelete) return;
   582→    await invokeLightboxDelete(onDelete, media.id, 'MediaLightbox.delete');
   583→  }, [onDelete, media.id]);
   584→
   585→  return useMemo<LightboxButtonGroupProps>(() => ({
   586→    topRight: {
   587→      showDownload: !!showDownload,
   588→      isDownloading,
   589→      onDelete,
   590→      handleDelete,
   591→      isDeleting,
   592→      onClose,
   593→    },
   594→    bottomLeft: {
   595→      isUpscaling,
   596→      handleUpscale: async () => {
   597→        await Promise.resolve(handleUpscale());
   598→      },
   599→      localStarred,
   600→      handleToggleStar,
   601→      toggleStarPending,
   602→    },
   603→    bottomRight: {
   604→      isAddingToReferences,
   605→      addToReferencesSuccess,
   606→      handleAddToReferences,
   607→      handleAddToJoin,
   608→      isAddingToJoin,
   609→      addToJoinSuccess,
   610→      onGoToJoin: handleGoToJoin,
   611→    },
   612→  }), [
   613→    showDownload,
   614→    isDownloading,
   615→    onDelete,
   616→    handleDelete,
   617→    isDeleting,
   618→    onClose,
   619→    isUpscaling,
   620→    handleUpscale,
   621→    localStarred,
   622→    handleToggleStar,
   623→    toggleStarPending,
   624→    isAddingToReferences,
   625→    addToReferencesSuccess,
   626→    handleAddToReferences,
   627→    handleAddToJoin,
   628→    isAddingToJoin,
   629→    addToJoinSuccess,
   630→    handleGoToJoin,
   631→  ]);
   632→}

   634→export function useSharedLightboxState(input: UseSharedLightboxStateInput): UseSharedLightboxStateReturn {
   635→  const variantsState = useSharedVariantsState({ core: input.core });
   636→  const interactionState = useSharedLightboxInteractionState({
   637→    core: input.core,
   638→    shots: input.shots,
   639→    starred: input.starred,
   640→    onOpenExternalGeneration: input.onOpenExternalGeneration,
   641→  }, variantsState);
   642→  const presentationState = useLightboxPanelModel({
   643→    core: input.core,
   644→    navigation: input.navigation,
   645→    layout: input.layout,
   646→    actions: input.actions,
   647→    media: input.media,
   648→  }, variantsState, interactionState);
   649→
   650→  return {
   651→    variants: presentationState.variants,
   652→    intendedActiveVariantIdRef: presentationState.intendedActiveVariantIdRef,
   653→    navigation: presentationState.navigation,
   654→    star: interactionState.star,
   655→    references: interactionState.references,
   656→    lineage: interactionState.lineage,
   657→    shots: interactionState.shots,
   658→    sourceGeneration: interactionState.sourceGeneration,
   659→    makeMainVariant: interactionState.makeMainVariant,
   660→    effectiveMedia: presentationState.effectiveMedia,
   661→    layout: presentationState.layout,
   662→    buttonGroupProps: presentationState.buttonGroupProps,
   663→  };
   664→}

   666→export interface SharedLightboxInteractionState {
   667→  star: UseSharedLightboxStateReturn['star'];
   668→  references: UseSharedLightboxStateReturn['references'];
   669→  lineage: UseSharedLightboxStateReturn['lineage'];

   674→
   675→export function useSharedLightboxInteractionState(
   676→  input: SharedInteractionInput,
   677→  variantsState: SharedVariantsStateResult,
   678→): SharedLightboxInteractionState {
   679→  const star = useStarToggle({
   680→    media: input.core.media,
   681→    starred: input.starred,
   682→    shotId: input.shots.shotId,
   683→  });
   684→  const referencesState = useReferences({
   685→    media: input.core.media,
   686→    selectedProjectId: input.core.selectedProjectId,
   687→    isVideo: input.core.isVideo,
   688→    selectedShotId: input.shots.selectedShotId,
   689→  });
   690→  const joinState = useJoinClips({
   691→    media: input.core.media,
   692→    isVideo: input.core.isVideo,
   693→    selectedProjectId: input.core.selectedProjectId,
   694→  });
   695→  const lineageState = useGenerationLineage({
   696→    media: input.core.media,
   697→    enabled: !input.core.isFormOnlyMode,
   698→  });
   699→  const shots = useLightboxShotActions(input);
   700→  const { sourceGenerationData, sourcePrimaryVariant } = useSourceGeneration({
   701→    media: input.core.media,
   702→    onOpenExternalGeneration: input.onOpenExternalGeneration,
   703→  });
   704→  const makeMainVariant = useSharedMakeMainVariantState({
   705→    media: input.core.media,
   706→    sourceGenerationData,
   707→    isViewingNonPrimaryVariant: variantsState.isViewingNonPrimaryVariant,
   708→    activeVariant: variantsState.activeVariant,
   709→    setPrimaryVariant: variantsState.setPrimaryVariant,
   710→    refetchVariants: variantsState.refetchVariants,
   711→    shotId: input.shots.shotId,
   712→    selectedShotId: input.shots.selectedShotId,
   713→    onClose: input.core.onClose,
   714→  });
   715→
   716→  return {
   717→    star: {
   718→      localStarred: star.localStarred,
   719→      setLocalStarred: star.setLocalStarred,
   720→      toggleStarMutation: star.toggleStarMutation,
   721→      handleToggleStar: star.handleToggleStar,
   722→    },
   723→    references: {
   724→      isAddingToReferences: referencesState.isAddingToReferences,
   725→      addToReferencesSuccess: referencesState.addToReferencesSuccess,
   726→      handleAddToReferences: referencesState.handleAddToReferences,
   727→      isAddingToJoin: joinState.isAddingToJoin,
   728→      addToJoinSuccess: joinState.addToJoinSuccess,
   729→      handleAddToJoin: joinState.handleAddToJoin,
   730→      handleGoToJoin: joinState.handleGoToJoin,
   731→    },
   732→    lineage: {
   733→      derivedItems: lineageState.derivedItems || [],
   734→      derivedGenerations: lineageState.derivedGenerations || [],
   735→      derivedPage: lineageState.derivedPage,
   736→      derivedTotalPages: lineageState.derivedTotalPages,
   737→      paginatedDerived: lineageState.paginatedDerived || [],
   738→      setDerivedPage: lineageState.setDerivedPage,
   739→    },
   740→    shots,
   741→    sourceGeneration: {
   742→      data: sourceGenerationData,
   743→      primaryVariant: sourcePrimaryVariant,
   744→    },
   745→    makeMainVariant,
   746→  };
   747→}

   749→export interface SharedLightboxPresentationState {
   750→  variants: UseSharedLightboxStateReturn['variants'];
   751→  intendedActiveVariantIdRef: UseSharedLightboxStateReturn['intendedActiveVariantIdRef'];
   752→  navigation: UseSharedLightboxStateReturn['navigation'];

   757→
   758→export function useLightboxPanelModel(
   759→  input: SharedPresentationInput,
   760→  variantsState: SharedVariantsStateResult,
   761→  interactionState: SharedLightboxInteractionState,
   762→): SharedLightboxPresentationState {
   763→  const navigation = useLightboxNavigationModel(input);
   764→  const { effectiveVideoUrl, effectiveMediaUrl, effectiveImageDimensions } = useEffectiveMedia({
   765→    isVideo: input.core.isVideo,
   766→    activeVariant: variantsState.activeVariant,
   767→    effectiveImageUrl: input.media.effectiveImageUrl,
   768→    imageDimensions: input.media.imageDimensions,
   769→    projectAspectRatio: input.media.projectAspectRatio,
   770→  });
   771→  const layout = useLayoutMode({
   772→    isMobile: input.core.isMobile,
   773→    showTaskDetails: input.layout.showTaskDetails ?? false,
   774→    isSpecialEditMode: input.layout.isSpecialEditMode,
   775→    isVideo: input.core.isVideo,
   776→    isInpaintMode: input.layout.isInpaintMode ?? false,
   777→    isMagicEditMode: input.layout.isMagicEditMode ?? false,
   778→  });
   779→  const buttonGroupProps = useSharedButtonGroupState({
   780→    input,
   781→    localStarred: interactionState.star.localStarred,
   782→    handleToggleStar: interactionState.star.handleToggleStar,
   783→    toggleStarPending: interactionState.star.toggleStarMutation.isPending,
   784→    isAddingToReferences: interactionState.references.isAddingToReferences,
   785→    addToReferencesSuccess: interactionState.references.addToReferencesSuccess,
   786→    handleAddToReferences: interactionState.references.handleAddToReferences,
   787→    handleAddToJoin: interactionState.references.handleAddToJoin,
   788→    isAddingToJoin: interactionState.references.isAddingToJoin,
   789→    addToJoinSuccess: interactionState.references.addToJoinSuccess,
   790→    handleGoToJoin: interactionState.references.handleGoToJoin,
   791→  });
   792→
   793→  return {
   794→    variants: variantsState.section,
   795→    intendedActiveVariantIdRef: variantsState.intendedActiveVariantIdRef,
   796→    navigation,
   797→    effectiveMedia: {
   798→      videoUrl: effectiveVideoUrl,
   799→      mediaUrl: effectiveMediaUrl,
   800→      imageDimensions: effectiveImageDimensions,
   801→    },
   802→    layout: {
```

**Definition**: Initialization coupling measures whether startup order and import-time behavior are stable and explicit.
- 100 = startup order and import-time behavior are stable and explicit
- 90 = mostly stable with limited boot-order fragility
- 80 = repeated import-time coupling risk
- 60 = boot behavior is routinely fragile/order-dependent

```
    15→import '@/index.css';
    16→
    17→let presenterInstalled = false;

    21→interface RuntimeEnvironment {
    22→  MODE?: string;
    23→  DEV?: boolean;
    24→  VITEST?: unknown;
    25→}
    26→
    27→function isTestRuntimeEnvironment(env: RuntimeEnvironment): boolean {
    28→  return env.MODE === 'test' || Boolean(env.VITEST);
    29→}
    30→
    31→export function shouldLoadAutoplayMonitor(env: RuntimeEnvironment): boolean {
    32→  return !isTestRuntimeEnvironment(env) && Boolean(env.DEV);
    33→}
    34→
    35→export function shouldLoadDevDebugTools(env: RuntimeEnvironment): boolean {
    36→  return !isTestRuntimeEnvironment(env) && Boolean(env.DEV);
    37→}
    38→
    39→function registerToastErrorPresenter(): void {
    40→  if (presenterInstalled) {
    41→    return;
    42→  }
    43→
    44→  installRuntimeErrorPresenter((appError, toastTitle) => notifyError(appError, toastTitle));
    45→  installErrorNotifier(({ title, description }) => {
    46→    toast({
    47→      title,
    48→      description,
    49→      variant: 'destructive',
    50→    });
    51→  }, ERROR_NOTIFIER_OWNER);
    52→  presenterInstalled = true;
    53→}
    54→
    55→export function initializeAppEnvironment(): void {
    56→  if (environmentInitialized) {
    57→    return;
    58→  }
    59→
    60→  initializeLoggerRuntime();
    61→  const env = import.meta.env;
    62→  initializeToastManager();
    63→  registerToastErrorPresenter();
    64→  initializeViewportLockRuntime();
    65→
    66→  // Initialize autoplay monitoring in development (after console suppression check)
    67→  if (shouldLoadAutoplayMonitor(env)) {
    68→    import('@/shared/lib/debug/autoplayMonitor');
    69→  }
    70→
    71→  // Debug tooling is intentionally loaded only for local dev runtime, never test/prod.
    72→  if (shouldLoadDevDebugTools(env)) {
    73→    import('@/shared/lib/simpleCacheValidator');
    74→    import('@/shared/lib/debug/debugPolling');
    75→    import('@/shared/lib/mobileProjectDebug');
    76→  }
    77→
    78→  // Initialize dark mode from localStorage (prevents flash of wrong theme).
    79→  const storedDarkMode = localStorage.getItem('dark-mode');
    80→  if (storedDarkMode === null || storedDarkMode === 'true') {
    81→    document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
    82→  }
    83→
    84→  if (!isTestRuntimeEnvironment(env)) {
    85→    const supabaseInitResult = initializeSupabaseResult();
    86→    if (!supabaseInitResult.ok) {
    87→      normalizeAndPresentError(supabaseInitResult.error, {
    88→        context: 'initializeAppEnvironment.initializeSupabase',
    89→        showToast: false,
    90→      });
    91→    }
    92→
    93→    if (supabaseInitResult.ok && shouldLoadDevDebugTools(env)) {
    94→      import('@/integrations/supabase/support/debug/initializeSupabaseDebugGlobals')
    95→        .then(({ initializeSupabaseDebugGlobals }) => {
    96→          initializeSupabaseDebugGlobals();
    97→        })
    98→        .catch((error) => {
    99→          normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   100→            context: 'initializeAppEnvironment.initializeSupabaseDebugGlobals',
   101→            showToast: false,
   102→          });
   103→          return undefined;
   104→        });
   105→      import('@/shared/realtime/DataFreshnessManager')
   106→        .then(({ registerDataFreshnessManagerDebugGlobal }) => {
   107→          registerDataFreshnessManagerDebugGlobal();
   108→        })
   109→        .catch((error) => {
   110→          normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   111→            context: 'initializeAppEnvironment.registerDataFreshnessManagerDebugGlobal',
   112→            showToast: false,
   113→          });
   114→          return undefined;
   115→        });
   116→    }
   117→  }
   118→
   119→  environmentInitialized = true;
   120→}
   121→
   122→export function renderApp(rootElement: HTMLElement): void {
   123→  initializeAppEnvironment();
   124→  createRoot(rootElement).render(
   125→    <AppErrorBoundary>
   126→      <Profiler id="Root" onRender={reactProfilerOnRender}>
   127→        <App />
   128→      </Profiler>
   129→    </AppErrorBoundary>
   130→  );
   131→}
```

```
    26→function composeProviders(providers: TreeProvider[]): TreeProvider {
    27→  return function ProviderTree({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    28→    return providers.reduceRight(
    29→      (acc, Provider) => <Provider>{acc}</Provider>,
    30→      children
    31→    );
    32→  };
    33→}
    34→
    35→const AppProviderTree = composeProviders([
    36→  AuthProvider,
    37→  AuthGate,
    38→  UserSettingsProvider,
    39→  ProjectProvider,
    40→  RealtimeProvider,
    41→  ShotsProvider,
    42→  GenerationTaskProvider,
    43→  IncomingTasksProvider,
    44→  PanesProvider,
    45→  ShotAdditionSelectionProvider,
    46→  LastAffectedShotProvider,
    47→  CurrentShotProvider,
    48→  ToolPageHeaderProvider,
    49→]);
    50→
    51→export function AppProviders({ children }: AppProvidersProps) {
    52→  return (
    53→    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
    54→      <TooltipProvider delayDuration={300}>
    55→        <TaskTypeConfigInitializer />
    56→        <AppProviderTree>{children}</AppProviderTree>
    57→      </TooltipProvider>
    58→    </QueryClientProvider>
    59→  );
    60→}
    61→
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * useEditSettingsSync Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Handles bidirectional sync between persisted edit settings and
     5→ * the active inpainting UI state. Syncs on initial load and on changes.
     6→ *
     7→ * Includes prompt race-condition protection: if the inpainting hook resets
     8→ * its prompt to empty while persistence has a value, the prompt is restored
     9→ * from persistence after a short delay.
    10→ */
    11→
    12→import { useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
    13→import type { EditMode } from './useGenerationEditSettings';
    14→
    15→interface UseEditSettingsSyncProps {
    16→  /** Current generation ID for tracking changes */
    17→  actualGenerationId: string | undefined;
    18→  /** Whether edit settings are ready to use */
    19→  isEditSettingsReady: boolean;
    20→  /** Whether there are persisted settings for this generation */
    21→  hasPersistedSettings: boolean;
    22→
    23→  // Persisted values
    24→  persistedEditMode: EditMode | undefined;
    25→  persistedNumGenerations: number | undefined;
    26→  persistedPrompt: string | undefined;
    27→
    28→  // Current UI values
    29→  editMode: EditMode;
    30→  inpaintNumGenerations: number;
    31→  inpaintPrompt: string;
    32→
    33→  // Setters for UI values
    34→  setEditMode: (mode: EditMode) => void;
    35→  setInpaintNumGenerations: (num: number) => void;
    36→  setInpaintPrompt: (prompt: string) => void;
    37→
    38→  // Setters for persisted values
    39→  setPersistedEditMode: (mode: EditMode) => void;
    40→  setPersistedNumGenerations: (num: number) => void;
    41→  setPersistedPrompt: (prompt: string) => void;
    42→}
    43→
    44→interface UseEditSettingsSyncReturn {
    45→  /** Whether initial sync from persistence to UI has completed */
    46→  hasInitializedFromPersistence: boolean;
    47→}
    48→
    49→/**
    50→ * Syncs edit settings bidirectionally between persistence layer and UI state.
    51→ * - On load: applies persisted settings to UI (once per generation)
    52→ * - On change: syncs UI changes back to persistence
    53→ * - Protects against prompt race conditions (empty-reset while persistence has a value)
    54→ */
    55→export function useEditSettingsSync({
    56→  actualGenerationId,
    57→  isEditSettingsReady,
    58→  hasPersistedSettings,
    59→  persistedEditMode,
    60→  persistedNumGenerations,
    61→  persistedPrompt,
    62→  editMode,
    63→  inpaintNumGenerations,
    64→  inpaintPrompt,
    65→  setEditMode,
    66→  setInpaintNumGenerations,
    67→  setInpaintPrompt,
    68→  setPersistedEditMode,
    69→  setPersistedNumGenerations,
    70→  setPersistedPrompt,
    71→}: UseEditSettingsSyncProps): UseEditSettingsSyncReturn {
    72→  // Track if we've synced initial values from persistence to inpainting
    73→  const hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef = useRef(false);
    74→  const lastSyncedGenerationIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
    75→  // Track the last known good prompt to detect race-condition resets
    76→  const lastUserPromptRef = useRef<string>('');
    77→  // Debounce timer for prompt race-condition restoration
    78→  const promptSyncTimerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
    79→
    80→  // Reset sync tracking when generation changes
    81→  useEffect(() => {
    82→    if (actualGenerationId !== lastSyncedGenerationIdRef.current) {
    83→      hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current = false;
    84→      lastSyncedGenerationIdRef.current = actualGenerationId ?? null;
    85→      lastUserPromptRef.current = '';
    86→    }
    87→  }, [actualGenerationId]);
    88→
    89→  // Cleanup prompt restore timer on unmount
    90→  useEffect(() => {
    91→    return () => {
    92→      if (promptSyncTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(promptSyncTimerRef.current);
    93→    };
    94→  }, []);
    95→
    96→  // Initialize inpainting state from persisted/lastUsed settings (once per generation)
    97→  // IMPORTANT: Wait for isEditSettingsReady to ensure effective values are computed correctly
    98→  useEffect(() => {
    99→    if (
   100→      isEditSettingsReady &&
   101→      !hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current &&
   102→      actualGenerationId
   103→    ) {
   104→      hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current = true;
   105→
   106→      // Sync edit mode
   107→      if (persistedEditMode && persistedEditMode !== editMode) {
   108→        setEditMode(persistedEditMode);
   109→      }
   110→
   111→      // Sync numGenerations
   112→      if (persistedNumGenerations && persistedNumGenerations !== inpaintNumGenerations) {
   113→        setInpaintNumGenerations(persistedNumGenerations);
   114→      }
   115→
   116→      // Sync prompt (only if has persisted settings - otherwise leave empty)
   117→      if (hasPersistedSettings && persistedPrompt && persistedPrompt !== inpaintPrompt) {
   118→        setInpaintPrompt(persistedPrompt);
   119→        lastUserPromptRef.current = persistedPrompt;
   120→      }
   121→    }
   122→  }, [
   123→    isEditSettingsReady,
   124→    actualGenerationId,
   125→    hasPersistedSettings,
   126→    persistedEditMode,
   127→    persistedNumGenerations,
   128→    persistedPrompt,
   129→    editMode,
   130→    inpaintNumGenerations,
   131→    inpaintPrompt,
   132→    setEditMode,
   133→    setInpaintNumGenerations,
   134→    setInpaintPrompt,
   135→  ]);
   136→
   137→  // Sync changes FROM inpainting TO persistence (debounced via the persistence hook)
   138→  useEffect(() => {
   139→    if (!hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current || !isEditSettingsReady) return;
   140→
   141→    // Sync editMode changes
   142→    if (editMode !== persistedEditMode) {
   143→      setPersistedEditMode(editMode);
   144→    }
   145→  }, [editMode, persistedEditMode, setPersistedEditMode, isEditSettingsReady]);
   146→
   147→  useEffect(() => {
   148→    if (!hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current || !isEditSettingsReady) return;
   149→
   150→    // Sync numGenerations changes
   151→    if (inpaintNumGenerations !== persistedNumGenerations) {
   152→      setPersistedNumGenerations(inpaintNumGenerations);
   153→    }
   154→  }, [inpaintNumGenerations, persistedNumGenerations, setPersistedNumGenerations, isEditSettingsReady]);
   155→
   156→  // Sync prompt changes with race-condition protection:
   157→  // If inpaintPrompt is reset to empty but we had a user prompt, it's likely
   158→  // a race condition from hook re-initialization — restore from persistence.
   159→  useEffect(() => {
   160→    if (!hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current || !isEditSettingsReady) return;
   161→
   162→    if (inpaintPrompt === '' && lastUserPromptRef.current !== '' && persistedPrompt !== '') {
   163→      // Restore the prompt from persistence after a short delay
   164→      if (promptSyncTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(promptSyncTimerRef.current);
   165→      promptSyncTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
   166→        if (persistedPrompt) {
   167→          setInpaintPrompt(persistedPrompt);
   168→        }
   169→      }, 100);
   170→      return;
   171→    }
   172→
   173→    if (inpaintPrompt !== persistedPrompt) {
   174→      setPersistedPrompt(inpaintPrompt);
   175→      lastUserPromptRef.current = inpaintPrompt;
   176→    }
   177→  }, [inpaintPrompt, persistedPrompt, setPersistedPrompt, setInpaintPrompt, isEditSettingsReady]);
   178→
   179→  return {
   180→    hasInitializedFromPersistence: hasInitializedFromPersistenceRef.current,
   181→  };
   182→}
   183→
```

```
1→import { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     2→
     3→const STALE_TIME_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000; // 5 minutes
     4→const MAX_QUERY_RETRY_DELAY_MS = 3000;
     5→const MUTATION_RETRY_DELAY_MS = 1500;
     6→
     7→export const queryClient = new QueryClient({
     8→  defaultOptions: {
     9→    queries: {
    10→      // Mobile-friendly retry strategy that avoids retrying auth/permission failures.
    11→      retry: (failureCount, error) => {
    12→        if (error?.message?.includes('unauthorized') || error?.message?.includes('forbidden')) {
    13→          return false;
    14→        }
    15→        return failureCount < 2;
    16→      },
    17→      retryDelay: (attemptIndex) => Math.min(1000 * 2 ** attemptIndex, MAX_QUERY_RETRY_DELAY_MS),
    18→      refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
    19→      staleTime: STALE_TIME_MS,
    20→      networkMode: 'online',
    21→    },
    22→    mutations: {
    23→      retry: (failureCount, error) => {
    24→        if (error?.message?.includes('unauthorized') || error?.message?.includes('forbidden')) {
    25→          return false;
    26→        }
    27→        return failureCount < 1;
    28→      },
    29→      retryDelay: MUTATION_RETRY_DELAY_MS,
    30→      networkMode: 'online',
    31→    },
    32→  },
    33→});
```

```
    63→/**

    70→export const useImg2ImgMode = ({
    71→  media,
    72→  selectedProjectId,
    73→  isVideo,
    74→  availableLoras = [],
    75→  state,
    76→  source,
    77→  options,

    89→  const { baseImageUrl, activeVariantLocation, activeVariantId, shotId } = source;
    90→  const { toolTypeOverride, createAsGeneration } = options ?? {};

    92→  // Local state (not persisted)

    94→  const [img2imgGenerateSuccess, setImg2imgGenerateSuccess] = useState(false);
    95→  const run = useTaskPlaceholder();
    96→
    97→  // Derive the base generation prompt from the generation params (best-effort)
    98→  const baseGenerationPrompt = useMemo(() => {
    99→    const params = media.params;
   100→    const raw =
   101→      (typeof params?.base_prompt === 'string' && params.base_prompt) ||
   102→      (typeof params?.prompt === 'string' && params.prompt) ||
   103→      '';
   104→    return raw.trim();

   108→  useEffect(() => {
   109→    if (img2imgPromptHasBeenSet) return;
   110→    if (img2imgPrompt && img2imgPrompt.trim().length > 0) return;
   111→    if (!baseGenerationPrompt) return;
   112→
   113→    setImg2imgPrompt(baseGenerationPrompt);
   114→  }, [img2imgPromptHasBeenSet, img2imgPrompt, baseGenerationPrompt, setImg2imgPrompt]);
   115→

   117→  const loraManager = useLoraManager(availableLoras, {
   118→    projectId: selectedProjectId || undefined,

   120→    enableProjectPersistence: false,

   124→  // Track generation to prevent double-submits
```

```
   139→  videoEnhance: ReturnType<typeof useVideoEnhance>;

   141→  isVideoTrimMode: UseLightboxVideoModeReturn['isVideoTrimMode'];

   144→  isVideoEditModeActive: UseLightboxVideoModeReturn['isVideoEditModeActive'];

   146→
   147→function useTrimPlaybackGuard({ trimVideoRef, trimState, isVideoTrimMode }: UseTrimPlaybackGuardInput): void {
   148→  useEffect(() => {
   149→    const video = trimVideoRef.current;
   150→    if (!video || !isVideoTrimMode) {
   151→      return;
   152→    }
   153→
   154→    const keepStart = trimState.startTrim;
   155→    const keepEnd = trimState.videoDuration - trimState.endTrim;
   156→    if (video.currentTime < keepStart || video.currentTime >= keepEnd) {
   157→      video.currentTime = keepStart;
   158→    }
   159→
   160→    if (video.paused) {
   161→      video.play().catch(() => {});
   162→    }
   163→  }, [isVideoTrimMode, trimState.startTrim, trimState.endTrim, trimState.videoDuration, trimVideoRef]);
   164→}

   185→    modeHandlers,
   186→    isVideoTrimMode,
   187→    isInVideoEditMode,
   188→    isVideoTrimModeActive,
   189→    isVideoEditModeActive,
   190→  } = input;
   191→
   192→  return {
   193→    trimVideoRef,
   194→    trimState,

   196→    setTrimCurrentTime,
   197→    trimmedDuration,
   198→    hasTrimChanges,
   199→    setStartTrim,

   202→    setVideoDuration,

   204→    trimSaveProgress,
   205→    trimSaveError,
   206→    trimSaveSuccess,
   207→    saveTrimmedVideo,
   208→    videoEditing,
   209→    videoEnhance: {
   210→      settings: videoEnhance.settings,
   211→      updateSetting: videoEnhance.updateSetting,
   212→      handleGenerate: videoEnhance.handleGenerate,
   213→      isGenerating: videoEnhance.isGenerating,
   214→      generateSuccess: videoEnhance.generateSuccess,
   215→      canSubmit: videoEnhance.canSubmit,
   216→    },
   217→    handleEnterVideoEditMode: modeHandlers.handleEnterVideoEditMode,
   218→    handleExitVideoEditMode: modeHandlers.handleExitVideoEditMode,
   219→    handleEnterVideoTrimMode: modeHandlers.handleEnterVideoTrimMode,
   220→    handleEnterVideoReplaceMode: modeHandlers.handleEnterVideoReplaceMode,
   221→    handleEnterVideoRegenerateMode: modeHandlers.handleEnterVideoRegenerateMode,
   222→    handleEnterVideoEnhanceMode: modeHandlers.handleEnterVideoEnhanceMode,
   223→    handleExitVideoTrimMode: modeHandlers.handleExitVideoTrimMode,
   224→    isVideoTrimMode,
   225→    isInVideoEditMode,
   226→    isVideoTrimModeActive,
   227→    isVideoEditModeActive,
   228→  };
   229→}
   230→
   231→export function useLightboxVideoMode(props: UseLightboxVideoModeProps): UseLightboxVideoModeReturn {
   232→  const {
   233→    onTrimModeChange,
   234→  } = props;
   235→  const {
   236→    media,
   237→    isVideo,
   238→    selectedProjectId,
   239→    projectAspectRatio,
   240→    shotId,
   241→    actualGenerationId,
   242→    effectiveVideoUrl,
   243→  } = props.core;
   244→  const { activeVariant, setActiveVariantId, refetchVariants } = props.variants;
   245→  const {
   246→    videoEditSubMode,
   247→    setVideoEditSubMode, // The wrapper is passed in from the caller (handles both local state + persistence)
   248→    persistedVideoEditSubMode,
   249→    setPersistedPanelMode,
   250→  } = props.editState;
   251→  const {
   252→    settings: enhanceSettings,
   253→    setSettings: setEnhanceSettings,
   254→    canRegenerate,
   255→  } = props.enhance;
   256→
   257→  // Refs
   258→  const trimVideoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
   259→
   260→  // Trim current time state
   261→  const [trimCurrentTime, setTrimCurrentTime] = useState(0);
   262→
   263→  // Video trimming hook - manage trim state
   264→  const trimmingHook = useVideoTrimming();
   265→  const {
   266→    trimState,
   267→    setStartTrim,
   268→    setEndTrim,
   269→    resetTrim,
   270→    setVideoDuration,
   271→    trimmedDuration,
   272→    hasTrimChanges,
   273→  } = trimmingHook;
   274→
   275→  // Derived states
   276→  const isVideoTrimMode = videoEditSubMode === 'trim';
   277→  const isInVideoEditMode = videoEditSubMode !== null;
   278→
   279→  useTrimPlaybackGuard({ trimVideoRef, trimState, isVideoTrimMode });
   280→
   281→  // Trim save hook
   282→  // Use getGenerationId to get actual generations.id
   283→  // media.id from shot queries is shot_generations.id, not generations.id
   284→  const trimSaveHook = useTrimSave({
   285→    generationId: getGenerationId(media),
   286→    projectId: selectedProjectId,
   287→    sourceVideoUrl: effectiveVideoUrl,
   288→    trimState,
   289→    sourceVariantId: activeVariant?.id,
   290→    onSuccess: (newVariantId) => {
   291→      resetTrim();
   292→      refetchVariants();
   293→      setActiveVariantId(newVariantId);
   294→      setVideoEditSubMode(null);
   295→      onTrimModeChange?.(false);
   296→    },
   297→  });
   298→  const {
   299→    isSaving: isSavingTrim,
   300→    saveProgress: trimSaveProgress,
   301→    saveError: trimSaveError,
   302→    saveSuccess: trimSaveSuccess,
   303→    saveTrimmedVideo,
   304→  } = trimSaveHook;
   305→
   306→  // Video editing hook (replace mode)
   307→  const videoEditing = useVideoEditing({
   308→    media,
   309→    selectedProjectId,
   310→    projectAspectRatio,
   311→    isVideo,
   312→    videoDuration: trimState.videoDuration,
   313→    videoUrl: effectiveVideoUrl,
   314→    onExitVideoEditMode: () => {
   315→      onTrimModeChange?.(false);
   316→    },
   317→  });
   318→
   319→  // Video enhance hook
   320→  const videoEnhance = useVideoEnhance({
   321→    projectId: selectedProjectId ?? undefined,
   322→    videoUrl: effectiveVideoUrl,
   323→    shotId,
   324→    generationId: actualGenerationId || undefined,
   325→    activeVariantId: activeVariant?.id,
   326→    settings: enhanceSettings,
   327→    updateSettings: setEnhanceSettings,
   328→  });
   329→
   330→  // Video edit mode handlers
   331→  const videoEditModeHandlers = useVideoEditModeHandlers({
   332→    setVideoEditSubMode,
   333→    persistedVideoEditSubMode,
   334→    canRegenerate,
   335→    setPersistedPanelMode,
   336→    videoEditingSetIsVideoEditMode: videoEditing.setIsVideoEditMode,
   337→    onTrimModeChange,
   338→    resetTrim,
   339→    setVideoDuration,
   340→  });
   341→  const isVideoTrimModeActive = isVideo && isVideoTrimMode;
   342→  const isVideoEditModeActive = isVideo && videoEditing.isVideoEditMode;
   343→
   344→  return buildLightboxVideoModeReturn({
   345→    trimVideoRef,
   346→    trimState,
   347→    trimCurrentTime,
   348→    setTrimCurrentTime,
   349→    trimmedDuration,
   350→    hasTrimChanges,
   351→    setStartTrim,
   352→    setEndTrim,
   353→    resetTrim,
   354→    setVideoDuration,
   355→    isSavingTrim,
   356→    trimSaveProgress,
   357→    trimSaveError,
   358→    trimSaveSuccess,
   359→    saveTrimmedVideo,
   360→    videoEditing,
   361→    videoEnhance,
   362→    modeHandlers: videoEditModeHandlers,
   363→    isVideoTrimMode,
   364→    isInVideoEditMode,
   365→    isVideoTrimModeActive,
   366→    isVideoEditModeActive,
   367→  });
   368→}
```

```
    31→export function getSupabaseClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {

    33→  return result.ok ? result : { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(result.error) };
```

```
     5→
     6→type SupabaseClientInstance = SupabaseClient<Database>;
     7→const SUPABASE_RUNTIME_NOT_INITIALIZED_MESSAGE =
     8→  'Supabase runtime is not initialized. Call initializeSupabaseClientRuntime() during app bootstrap.';
     9→
    10→let runtimeClient: SupabaseClientInstance | null = null;
    11→let runtimeError: Error | null = null;
    12→
    13→export type SupabaseClientAccessResult =
    14→  | { ok: true; client: SupabaseClientInstance }
    15→  | { ok: false; error: Error };
    16→
    17→export function normalizeSupabaseError(error: unknown): Error {
    18→  return error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseClientRuntime(): SupabaseClientInstance {
    22→  if (runtimeClient) {
    23→    return runtimeClient;
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  try {
    27→    const client = createSupabaseClient();
    28→    initializeSupabaseRuntime(client);
    29→    runtimeClient = client;
    30→    runtimeError = null;
    31→    return client;
    32→  } catch (error) {
    33→    const normalized = normalizeSupabaseError(error);
    34→    runtimeClient = null;
    35→    runtimeError = normalized;
    36→    throw normalized;
    37→  }
    38→}
    39→
    40→export function getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    41→  if (runtimeClient) {
    42→    return { ok: true, client: runtimeClient };
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  if (runtimeError) {
    46→    return { ok: false, error: runtimeError };
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    ok: false,
    51→    error: new Error(SUPABASE_RUNTIME_NOT_INITIALIZED_MESSAGE),
    52→  };
    53→}
    54→
    55→export function getSupabaseRuntimeClient(): SupabaseClientInstance {
    56→  const result = getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult();
    57→  if (!result.ok) {
    58→    throw result.error;
    59→  }
    60→  return result.client;
    61→}
```

```
    32→  optimisticUnpositionedIds?: Set<string>;
    33→  onNavigateToShot?: (shot: Shot, options?: { isNewlyCreated?: boolean }) => void;
    34→  onClose: () => void;
    35→  // CRITICAL: targetShotId is the shot selected in the DROPDOWN, not the shot being viewed
    36→  onAddToShot?: (targetShotId: string, generationId: string, imageUrl?: string, thumbUrl?: string) => Promise<boolean>;
    37→  onAddToShotWithoutPosition?: (targetShotId: string, generationId: string, imageUrl?: string, thumbUrl?: string) => Promise<boolean>;
    38→  onShowTick?: (imageId: string) => void;
    39→  onShowSecondaryTick?: (imageId: string) => void;
    40→  onOptimisticPositioned?: (mediaId: string, shotId: string) => void;
    41→  onOptimisticUnpositioned?: (mediaId: string, shotId: string) => void;
    42→}
    43→
    44→interface UseShotPositioningReturn {
    45→  isAlreadyPositionedInSelectedShot: boolean;
    46→  isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition: boolean;
    47→  handleAddToShot: () => Promise<void>;
    48→  handleAddToShotWithoutPosition: () => Promise<void>;
    49→}
    50→
    51→/**
    52→ * Hook for managing shot positioning logic
    53→ * Handles checking if media is positioned/associated with shots and navigation
    54→ */
    55→export const useShotPositioning = ({
    56→  media,
    57→  selectedShotId,
    58→  allShots,
    59→  positionedInSelectedShot,
    60→  associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot,
    61→  optimisticPositionedIds,
    62→  optimisticUnpositionedIds,
    63→  onNavigateToShot,
    64→  onClose,
    65→  onAddToShot,
    66→  onAddToShotWithoutPosition,
    67→  onShowTick,
    68→  onShowSecondaryTick,
    69→  onOptimisticPositioned,
    70→  onOptimisticUnpositioned,
    71→}: UseShotPositioningProps): UseShotPositioningReturn => {
    72→  const { navigateToShot } = useShotNavigation();
    73→  
    74→  // IMPORTANT: Use generation_id (actual generations.id) when available, falling back to id
    75→  // For ShotImageManager/Timeline images, id is shot_generations.id but generation_id is the actual generation ID
    76→  const actualGenerationId = getGenerationId(media);
    77→  const generationIdForActions = actualGenerationId ?? media.id;
    78→
    79→  const isAlreadyPositionedInSelectedShot = useMemo(() => {
    80→    if (!selectedShotId || !media.id) return false;
    81→
    82→    const compositeKey = `${media.id}:${selectedShotId}`;
    83→
    84→    // Check optimistic state first (most up-to-date and shot-specific)
    85→    const hasComposite = optimisticPositionedIds?.has(compositeKey);
    86→    
    87→    // Optimistic state takes precedence - if we have a composite key match, trust it
    88→    if (hasComposite) {
    89→      return true;
    90→    }
    91→    
    92→    // CRITICAL: Don't trust simple keys when we have a selectedShotId - simple keys are not shot-specific!
    93→    // Simple keys mean "added to SOME shot" but we don't know which one, so they're ambiguous.
    94→    // Only use simple keys as a last resort if we can't determine shot-specific state.
    95→    
    96→    // Trust the override from parent component (ShotImageManagerDesktop)
    97→    // The parent already verified the media is in the selected shot using props.shotId comparison
    98→    // Don't re-verify using media.shot_id since the image objects may not have shot_id populated
    99→    if (typeof positionedInSelectedShot === 'boolean') {
   100→      return positionedInSelectedShot;
   101→    }
   102→    
   103→    // Check if this media is positioned in the selected shot
   104→    // First check single shot association
   105→    const mediaExt = media as GenerationRow & MediaWithShotFields;
   106→    if (mediaExt.shot_id === selectedShotId) {
   107→      const result = mediaExt.position !== null && mediaExt.position !== undefined;
   108→      return result;
   109→    }
   110→
   111→    // Check multiple shot associations
   112→    const allShotAssociations = mediaExt.all_shot_associations;
   113→    if (allShotAssociations && Array.isArray(allShotAssociations)) {
   114→      const matchingAssociation = allShotAssociations.find(
   115→        (assoc: ShotAssociation) => assoc.shot_id === selectedShotId
   116→      );
   117→      const result = !!(matchingAssociation &&
   118→             matchingAssociation.position !== null &&
   119→             matchingAssociation.position !== undefined);
   120→      return result;
   121→    }
   122→    
   123→    return false;
   124→  }, [selectedShotId, media, optimisticPositionedIds, positionedInSelectedShot]);
   125→
   126→  // Navigate to the selected shot (shared by both handlers)
   127→  const navigateToSelectedShot = () => {
   128→    if (!selectedShotId) return;
   129→    const targetShotOption = allShots.find(s => s.id === selectedShotId);
   130→    const minimalShot: Shot = {
   131→      id: targetShotOption?.id || selectedShotId,
   132→      name: targetShotOption?.name || 'Shot',
   133→      images: [],
   134→      position: 0,
   135→    };
   136→    if (onNavigateToShot) {
   137→      onNavigateToShot(minimalShot);
   138→    } else {
   139→      onClose();
   140→      navigateToShot(minimalShot);
   141→    }
   142→  };
   143→
   144→  // Resolve media URLs (shared by both handlers)
   145→  const resolveMediaUrls = () => {
   146→    const mediaWithUrls = media as GenerationRow & MediaWithShotFields;
   147→    const imageUrl = getMediaUrl(mediaWithUrls) || media.imageUrl;
   148→    const thumbUrl = getThumbnailUrl(mediaWithUrls) || media.thumbUrl || imageUrl;
   149→    return { imageUrl, thumbUrl };
   150→  };
   151→
   152→  // Internal helper shared by both add-to-shot handlers
   153→  const executeAddToShot = async (
   154→    addFn: ((targetShotId: string, generationId: string, imageUrl?: string, thumbUrl?: string) => Promise<boolean>) | undefined,
   155→    isAlreadyInShot: boolean,
   156→    onShowFeedback: ((imageId: string) => void) | undefined,
   157→    onOptimistic: ((mediaId: string, shotId: string) => void) | undefined,
   158→  ) => {
   159→    if (!addFn || !selectedShotId) return;
   160→
   161→    if (isAlreadyInShot) {
   162→      navigateToSelectedShot();
   163→      return;
   164→    }
   165→
   166→    const { imageUrl, thumbUrl } = resolveMediaUrls();
   167→
   168→    // CRITICAL: Pass selectedShotId (the dropdown value) as targetShotId
   169→    // Use actualGenerationId (generations.id) not media.id (which might be shot_generations.id)
   170→    const success = await addFn(selectedShotId, generationIdForActions, imageUrl, thumbUrl);
   171→    if (success) {
   172→      onShowFeedback?.(generationIdForActions);
   173→      // Pass selectedShotId so optimistic state can use composite keys (mediaId:shotId)
   174→      onOptimistic?.(generationIdForActions, selectedShotId);
   175→    }
   176→  };
   177→
   178→  const handleAddToShot = () => executeAddToShot(
   179→    onAddToShot, isAlreadyPositionedInSelectedShot, onShowTick, onOptimisticPositioned
   180→  );
   181→
   182→  // Check if image is already associated with the selected shot WITHOUT position
   183→  const isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition = useMemo(() => {
   184→    if (!selectedShotId || !media.id) return false;
   185→
   186→    // Prefer override from gallery source
   187→    if (typeof associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot === 'boolean') {
   188→      // Check for composite key (mediaId:shotId) first, then fallback to simple mediaId
   189→      const compositeKey = `${media.id}:${selectedShotId}`;
   190→      const hasComposite = optimisticUnpositionedIds?.has(compositeKey);
   191→      const hasSimple = optimisticUnpositionedIds?.has(media.id);
   192→      return associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot || !!hasComposite || !!hasSimple;
   193→    }
   194→    
   195→    // Check optimistic state first - try composite key (mediaId:shotId), then fallback to simple mediaId
   196→    const compositeKey = `${media.id}:${selectedShotId}`;
   197→    if (optimisticUnpositionedIds?.has(compositeKey)) return true;
   198→    if (optimisticUnpositionedIds?.has(media.id)) return true;
   199→    
   200→    // Check if this media is associated with the selected shot without position
   201→    // First check single shot association
   202→    const mediaExtAssoc = media as GenerationRow & MediaWithShotFields;
   203→    if (mediaExtAssoc.shot_id === selectedShotId) {
   204→      return mediaExtAssoc.position === null || mediaExtAssoc.position === undefined;
   205→    }
   206→
   207→    // Check multiple shot associations
   208→    const assocShotAssociations = mediaExtAssoc.all_shot_associations;
   209→    if (assocShotAssociations && Array.isArray(assocShotAssociations)) {
   210→      const matchingAssociation = assocShotAssociations.find(
   211→        (assoc: ShotAssociation) => assoc.shot_id === selectedShotId
   212→      );
   213→      return !!(matchingAssociation &&
   214→             (matchingAssociation.position === null || matchingAssociation.position === undefined));
   215→    }
   216→    
   217→    return false;
   218→  }, [selectedShotId, media, optimisticUnpositionedIds, associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot]);
   219→
   220→  const handleAddToShotWithoutPosition = () => executeAddToShot(
   221→    onAddToShotWithoutPosition, isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition, onShowSecondaryTick, onOptimisticUnpositioned
   222→  );
   223→
   224→  return {
   225→    isAlreadyPositionedInSelectedShot,
   226→    isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition,
   227→    handleAddToShot,
   228→    handleAddToShotWithoutPosition,
   229→  };
   230→};
   231→
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Autoplay Monitor - Tracks autoplay state changes over time
     3→ * 
     4→ * This utility periodically monitors video autoplay states to help
     5→ * identify when and why autoplay permissions change.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→let monitoringActive = false;
     9→
    10→interface VideoState {
    11→  element: HTMLVideoElement;
    12→  src: string;
    13→  paused: boolean;
    14→  currentTime: number;
    15→  readyState: number;
    16→  isGallery: boolean;
    17→  isLightbox: boolean;
    18→}
    19→
    20→let previousVideoStates: VideoState[] = [];
    21→
    22→const captureVideoStates = (): VideoState[] => {
    23→  const videos = document.querySelectorAll('video');
    24→  return Array.from(videos).map(video => ({
    25→    element: video,
    26→    src: video.src?.substring(video.src.lastIndexOf('/') + 1) || 'no-src',
    27→    paused: video.paused,
    28→    currentTime: video.currentTime,
    29→    readyState: video.readyState,
    30→    isGallery: !!video.getAttribute('data-video-id'),
    31→    isLightbox: !!video.getAttribute('data-lightbox-video')
    32→  }));
    33→};
    34→
    35→const compareVideoStates = (current: VideoState[], previous: VideoState[]): boolean => {
    36→  if (current.length !== previous.length) return true;
    37→  
    38→  return current.some((curr, index) => {
    39→    const prev = previous[index];
    40→    if (!prev) return true;
    41→    
    42→    return curr.paused !== prev.paused || 
    43→           Math.abs(curr.currentTime - prev.currentTime) > 0.1 ||
    44→           curr.readyState !== prev.readyState;
    45→  });
    46→};
    47→
    48→interface VideoStateChange {
    49→  type: string;
    50→  video?: string;
    51→  isLightbox?: boolean;
    52→  isGallery?: boolean;
    53→  from: number | string;
    54→  to: number | string;
    55→}
    56→
    57→const logVideoStateChanges = (current: VideoState[], previous: VideoState[]) => {
    58→  const changes: VideoStateChange[] = [];
    59→  
    60→  // Check for new/removed videos
    61→  if (current.length !== previous.length) {
    62→    changes.push({
    63→      type: 'count_change',
    64→      from: previous.length,
    65→      to: current.length
    66→    });
    67→  }
    68→  
    69→  // Check for state changes in existing videos
    70→  current.forEach((curr, index) => {
    71→    const prev = previous[index];
    72→    if (!prev) return;
    73→    
    74→    if (curr.paused !== prev.paused) {
    75→      changes.push({
    76→        type: 'play_state_change',
    77→        video: curr.src,
    78→        isLightbox: curr.isLightbox,
    79→        isGallery: curr.isGallery,
    80→        from: prev.paused ? 'paused' : 'playing',
    81→        to: curr.paused ? 'paused' : 'playing'
    82→      });
    83→    }
    84→    
    85→    if (curr.readyState !== prev.readyState) {
    86→      changes.push({
    87→        type: 'ready_state_change',
    88→        video: curr.src,
    89→        from: prev.readyState,
    90→        to: curr.readyState
    91→      });
    92→    }
    93→  });
    94→  
    95→};
    96→
    97→export const startAutoplayMonitoring = () => {
    98→  if (monitoringActive || !import.meta.env.DEV) return;
    99→  
   100→  monitoringActive = true;
   101→  previousVideoStates = captureVideoStates();
   102→
   103→  setInterval(() => {
   104→    const currentStates = captureVideoStates();
   105→    
   106→    if (compareVideoStates(currentStates, previousVideoStates)) {
   107→      logVideoStateChanges(currentStates, previousVideoStates);
   108→      previousVideoStates = currentStates;
   109→    }
   110→  }, 1000); // Check every second
   111→};
   112→
```

```
    54→  activePairData: PairData | null;

    63→  openImageGenerationId?: string;
    64→  openImageVariantId?: string;
    65→  openSegmentSlot?: string;
    66→  fromShotClick?: boolean;
    67→}
    68→
    69→interface SegmentSlotParser {
    70→  asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    71→  asString(value: unknown): string | undefined;
    72→}
    73→
    74→const defaultParser: SegmentSlotParser = {
    75→  asRecord(value) {
    76→    return value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
    77→      ? (value as Record<string, unknown>)
    78→      : undefined;
    79→  },
    80→  asString(value) {
    81→    return typeof value === 'string' ? value : undefined;
    82→  },
    83→};
    84→
    85→export function parseSegmentSlotLocationState(
    86→  state: unknown,
    87→  parser: SegmentSlotParser = defaultParser,
    88→): SegmentSlotLocationState {
    89→  const record = parser.asRecord(state);
    90→  if (!record) return {};
    91→  return {
    92→    openImageGenerationId: parser.asString(record.openImageGenerationId),
    93→    openImageVariantId: parser.asString(record.openImageVariantId),
    94→    openSegmentSlot: parser.asString(record.openSegmentSlot),
    95→    fromShotClick: record.fromShotClick === true,
    96→  };
    97→}

   100→  frameCountDebounceRef: MutableRefObject<NodeJS.Timeout | null>,
   101→) => SegmentSlotModeData | null;
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Image Preloading Configuration
     3→ *
     4→ * Pure function to detect device capabilities and return appropriate config.
     5→ * No side effects, no state - just returns a config object.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import type { PreloadConfig } from './types';
     9→
    10→/**
    11→ * Detect device capabilities and return appropriate preload configuration.
    12→ */
    13→export function getPreloadConfig(): PreloadConfig {
    14→  // Check if we're on mobile
    15→  const isMobile = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth <= 768;
    16→
    17→  // Check connection speed (if available)
    18→  const connection =
    19→    typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && 'connection' in navigator
    20→      ? (navigator as { connection?: { effectiveType?: string } }).connection
    21→      : null;
    22→  const hasSlowConnection =
    23→    connection && ['2g', 'slow-2g'].includes(connection.effectiveType || '');
    24→
    25→  // Check memory (if available)
    26→  const hasLowMemory =
    27→    typeof navigator !== 'undefined' &&
    28→    'deviceMemory' in navigator &&
    29→    (navigator as { deviceMemory?: number }).deviceMemory !== undefined &&
    30→    ((navigator as { deviceMemory: number }).deviceMemory <= 4);
    31→
    32→  // Slow connection: minimal preloading
    33→  if (hasSlowConnection) {
    34→    return {
    35→      maxConcurrent: 1,
    36→      debounceMs: 300,
    37→      maxImagesPerPage: 3,
    38→      preloadThumbnailsOnly: true,
    39→    };
    40→  }
    41→
    42→  // Mobile or low memory: conservative preloading
    43→  if (isMobile || hasLowMemory) {
    44→    return {
    45→      maxConcurrent: 2,
    46→      debounceMs: 200,
    47→      maxImagesPerPage: 6,
    48→      preloadThumbnailsOnly: true,

    55→    debounceMs: 150,
    56→    maxImagesPerPage: 10,
    57→    preloadThumbnailsOnly: false,
    58→  };
```

```
     3→
     4→const getTrackerConfig = (): TrackerLimits => {

    20→const loadedImagesByUrl = new Map<

    28→/**
    29→ * Evict oldest entries from a Map until it's under the limit.
    30→ * Maps maintain insertion order, so we delete from the beginning.
    31→ */
    32→const evictOldestEntries = <K, V>(
    33→  map: Map<K, V>,
    34→  maxSize: number,
    35→  name: string
    36→): number => {
    37→  if (map.size <= maxSize) return 0;
    38→
    39→  const toEvict = map.size - maxSize;
    40→  const keys = Array.from(map.keys()).slice(0, toEvict);
    41→
    42→  keys.forEach((key) => map.delete(key));
    43→
    44→  if (shouldLogTrackerDebug()) {
    45→    console.log(
    46→      `[ImageLoadTracker] Evicted ${toEvict} oldest entries from ${name}, new size: ${map.size}`
    47→    );
    48→  }
    49→  return toEvict;
    50→};
    51→
    52→const enforceLoadTrackerLimits = (): void => {
    53→  const config = getTrackerConfig();
    54→  evictOldestEntries(loadedImagesById, config.maxImages, 'loadedImagesById');
    55→  evictOldestEntries(loadedImagesByUrl, config.maxUrls, 'loadedImagesByUrl');
    56→};

    58→export const setImageLoadStatus = (
    59→  image: TrackableImage,
    60→  isLoaded: boolean = true
    61→): void => {
    62→  const imageId = image.id;
    63→  if (!imageId) {
    64→    return;
    65→  }
    66→
    67→  // Update tracker
    68→  loadedImagesById.set(imageId, isLoaded);
    69→
    70→  // Keep legacy field in sync while older call sites are still present.
    71→  image.__memoryCached = isLoaded;
    72→
    73→  // Enforce limits in coarse batches to avoid per-write overhead.
    74→  if (isLoaded && loadedImagesById.size % 50 === 0) {
    75→    enforceLoadTrackerLimits();
    76→  }
    77→};

    80→  let removedCount = 0;
    81→
    82→  imageIds.forEach((imageId) => {
    83→    if (loadedImagesById.has(imageId)) {
    84→      loadedImagesById.delete(imageId);
    85→      removedCount++;
    86→    }
    87→  });
    88→
    89→  return removedCount;
    90→};
    91→
    92→export const clearLoadedImages = (images: Array<{ id: string }>): number => {
    93→  const imageIds = images.map((img) => img.id).filter((id) => id);
    94→
    95→  return removeLoadedImages(imageIds);
    96→};
    97→
    98→export const clearAllLoadedImages = (
    99→  reason: string = 'project switch'

   129→  return isLoaded;

   160→  };
   161→};
   162→
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Global Settings Write Queue
     3→ *
     4→ * Prevents network exhaustion by serializing and coalescing settings writes.
     5→ *
     6→ * Features:
     7→ * - Global concurrency limit (default: 1 in-flight write)
     8→ * - Per-target debouncing (coalesces rapid updates)
     9→ * - Merge-on-write (latest patch wins per field)
    10→ * - Optional AbortSignal passthrough for caller cancellation
    11→ * - Best-effort flush on page unload
    12→ *
    13→ * @see settings_system.md for the full settings architecture
    14→ */
    15→
    16→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    17→
    18→export interface QueuedWrite {
    19→  scope: 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
    20→  entityId: string;
    21→  toolId: string;
    22→  patch: Record<string, unknown>;
    23→  signal?: AbortSignal;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface PendingWrite {
    27→  write: QueuedWrite;
    28→  resolvers: Array<{ resolve: (value: unknown) => void; reject: (error: unknown) => void }>;
    29→  timerId: NodeJS.Timeout | null;
    30→  enqueuedAt: number;
    31→}
    32→
    33→// Configuration
    34→const DEBOUNCE_MS = 300;
    35→const MAX_CONCURRENT = 1;
    36→
    37→// State
    38→const pendingByTarget = new Map<string, PendingWrite>();
    39→let inFlightCount = 0;
    40→const flushQueue: Array<{ targetKey: string; pending: PendingWrite }> = [];
    41→
    42→// The actual write function - injected to avoid circular imports
    43→let writeFunction: ((write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) | null = null;
    44→
    45→function createAbortError(): Error {
    46→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    47→    return new DOMException('Request was cancelled', 'AbortError');
    48→  }
    49→  const error = new Error('Request was cancelled');
    50→  error.name = 'AbortError';
    51→  return error;
    52→}
    53→
    54→function throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {
    55→  if (signal?.aborted) {
    56→    throw createAbortError();
    57→  }
    58→}
    59→
    60→/**
    61→ * Set the write function that performs the actual DB update.
    62→ * Must be called once at app init (in useToolSettings.ts).
    63→ */
    64→export function setSettingsWriteFunction(fn: (write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) {
    65→  writeFunction = fn;
    66→}
    67→
    68→/**
    69→ * Create a unique key for deduplication
    70→ */
    71→function targetKey(write: QueuedWrite): string {
    72→  return `${write.scope}:${write.entityId}:${write.toolId}`;
    73→}
    74→
    75→/**
    76→ * Shallow merge (one level deep)
    77→ */
    78→function shallowMergePatch(existing: Record<string, unknown>, incoming: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
    79→  return { ...existing, ...incoming };
    80→}
    81→
    82→/**
    83→ * Process the next item in the flush queue
    84→ */
    85→async function processQueue() {
    86→  if (inFlightCount >= MAX_CONCURRENT || flushQueue.length === 0) {
    87→    return;
    88→  }
    89→
    90→  const next = flushQueue.shift();
    91→  if (!next) return;
    92→
    93→  const { targetKey: key, pending } = next;
    94→  
    95→  // Remove from pending map (we're about to process it)
    96→  pendingByTarget.delete(key);
    97→  
    98→  inFlightCount++;
    99→  
   100→  try {
   101→    if (!writeFunction) {
   102→      throw new Error('[SettingsWriteQueue] Write function not initialized');
   103→    }
   104→
   105→    throwIfAborted(pending.write.signal);
   106→    const result = await writeFunction(pending.write);
   107→    
   108→    // Resolve all waiters
   109→    for (const { resolve } of pending.resolvers) {
   110→      resolve(result);
   111→    }
   112→  } catch (error) {
   113→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'SettingsWriteQueue', showToast: false });
   114→
   115→    // Reject all waiters
   116→    for (const { reject } of pending.resolvers) {
   117→      reject(error);
   118→    }
   119→  } finally {
   120→    inFlightCount--;
   121→    
   122→    // Process next item
   123→    processQueue();
   124→  }
   125→}
   126→
   127→/**
   128→ * Schedule a pending write for flush
   129→ */
   130→function scheduleFlush(key: string, pending: PendingWrite) {
   131→  // Clear existing timer
   132→  if (pending.timerId) {
   133→    clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   134→    pending.timerId = null;
   135→  }
   136→  
   137→  // Add to flush queue and process
   138→  flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   139→  processQueue();
   140→}
   141→
   142→/**
   143→ * Enqueue a settings write.
   144→ * 
   145→ * Returns a promise that resolves when the write completes.
   146→ * Multiple writes to the same target within the debounce window are merged.
   147→ * 
   148→ * @param write - The write to enqueue
   149→ * @param mode - 'debounced' (default) waits for debounce window; 'immediate' flushes now
   150→ */
   151→export function enqueueSettingsWrite(
   152→  write: QueuedWrite,
   153→  mode: 'debounced' | 'immediate' = 'debounced'
   154→): Promise<unknown> {
   155→  const key = targetKey(write);
   156→
   157→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   158→    if (write.signal?.aborted) {
   159→      reject(createAbortError());
   160→      return;
   161→    }
   162→
   163→    const existing = pendingByTarget.get(key);
   164→
   165→    if (existing) {
   166→      // Merge with existing pending write
   167→      existing.write.patch = shallowMergePatch(existing.write.patch, write.patch);
   168→      if (write.signal) {
   169→        existing.write.signal = write.signal;
   170→      }
   171→      existing.resolvers.push({ resolve, reject });
   172→
   173→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   174→        // Cancel debounce timer and flush now
   175→        scheduleFlush(key, existing);
   176→      }
   177→      // else: existing timer will handle it
   178→      
   179→    } else {
   180→      // Create new pending write
   181→      const pending: PendingWrite = {
   182→        write: { ...write, patch: { ...write.patch } },
   183→        resolvers: [{ resolve, reject }],
   184→        timerId: null,
   185→        enqueuedAt: Date.now(),
   186→      };
   187→
   188→      pendingByTarget.set(key, pending);
   189→
   190→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   191→        scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   192→      } else {
   193→        // Set debounce timer
   194→        pending.timerId = setTimeout(() => {
   195→          scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   196→        }, DEBOUNCE_MS);
   197→      }
   198→    }
   199→  });
   200→}
   201→
   202→
   203→/**
   204→ * Flush all pending writes immediately.
   205→ * Best-effort: returns without waiting.
   206→ */
   207→function flushAll(): void {
   208→  for (const [key, pending] of pendingByTarget.entries()) {
   209→    if (pending.timerId) {
   210→      clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   211→      pending.timerId = null;
   212→    }
   213→    flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   214→  }
   215→  pendingByTarget.clear();
   216→  processQueue();
   217→}
   218→
   219→// Best-effort flush on page unload and tab hide
   220→// Mobile browsers don't reliably fire beforeunload (e.g., tab switching on iOS Safari),
   221→// so we also flush on visibilitychange to prevent losing pending writes.
   222→if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
   223→  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
   224→    flushAll();
   225→  });
   226→
   227→  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
   228→    if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
   229→      flushAll();
   230→    }
   231→  });
   232→}
```

```
   199→/**

   214→  // Check in-memory cache first
   215→  if (cachedUser && (Date.now() - cachedUserAt) < USER_CACHE_MS) {

   235→type SettingsRow = { data: { settings: unknown } | null; error: unknown };

   238→  if (error instanceof Error && error.message) {
   239→    return error.message;
   240→  }
   241→  if (error && typeof error === 'object') {
   242→    const message = (error as { message?: unknown }).message;

   260→type AbortableQuery<T> = {
   261→  abortSignal?: (signal: AbortSignal) => T;

   263→
   264→function maybeAttachAbortSignal<T>(query: T, signal?: AbortSignal): T {
   265→  if (!signal) {
   266→    return query;
   267→  }
   268→
   269→  const abortable = query as AbortableQuery<T>;
   270→  if (typeof abortable.abortSignal === 'function') {
   271→    return abortable.abortSignal(signal);
   272→  }
   273→
   274→  return query;
   275→}
   276→
   277→async function raceWithAbort<T>(promise: Promise<T>, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<T> {
   278→  if (!signal) {
   279→    return promise;
   280→  }
   281→
   282→  throwIfAborted(signal);
   283→
   284→  return await new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
   285→    const onAbort = () => {
   286→      cleanup();
   287→      reject(new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   288→        recoverable: true,
   289→      }));

   294→    };
   295→
   296→    signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });

   298→      (value) => {
   299→        cleanup();
   300→        resolve(value);
   301→      },
   302→      (error) => {
   303→        cleanup();
   304→        reject(error);
   305→      },
   306→    );
   307→  });
   308→}

   310→/** Fetch settings from all three scopes (user, project, shot) in parallel. */
   311→function fetchAllScopes(
   312→  supabaseClient: ReturnType<typeof getSupabaseClient>,
   313→  userId: string,
   314→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   315→  signal?: AbortSignal,
   316→): Promise<[SettingsRow, SettingsRow, SettingsRow]> {
   317→  const userQuery = maybeAttachAbortSignal(
   318→    supabaseClient
   319→      .from('users')
   320→      .select('settings')
   321→      .eq('id', userId)
   322→      .maybeSingle(),
   323→    signal,
   324→  );
   325→
   326→  const projectQuery = ctx.projectId
   327→    ? maybeAttachAbortSignal(
   328→        supabaseClient
   329→          .from('projects')
   330→          .select('settings')
   331→          .eq('id', ctx.projectId)
   332→          .maybeSingle(),
   333→        signal,
   334→      )
   335→    : Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null });
   336→
   337→  const shotQuery = ctx.shotId
   338→    ? maybeAttachAbortSignal(
   339→        supabaseClient
   340→          .from('shots')
   341→          .select('settings')
   342→          .eq('id', ctx.shotId)
   343→          .maybeSingle(),
   344→        signal,
   345→      )
   346→    : Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null });
   347→
   348→  return Promise.all([
   349→    userQuery,
   350→    projectQuery,
   351→    shotQuery,
   352→  ]) as Promise<[SettingsRow, SettingsRow, SettingsRow]>;
   353→}

   355→/** Extract tool-specific settings from scope results and merge in priority order. */
   356→function extractAndMergeSettings(
   357→  userResult: SettingsRow,
   358→  projectResult: SettingsRow,
   359→  shotResult: SettingsRow,
   360→  toolId: string,
   361→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   362→): SettingsFetchResult {
   363→  if (userResult.error) {
   364→    throw new ToolSettingsError(
   365→      'scope_fetch_failed',
   366→      `Failed to load user settings: ${describeScopeError(userResult.error)}`,
   367→      { recoverable: true, cause: userResult.error, metadata: { scope: 'user' } },
   368→    );
   369→  }
   370→  if (ctx.projectId && projectResult.error) {
   371→    throw new ToolSettingsError(
   372→      'scope_fetch_failed',
   373→      `Failed to load project settings: ${describeScopeError(projectResult.error)}`,
   374→      { recoverable: true, cause: projectResult.error, metadata: { scope: 'project', projectId: ctx.projectId } },
   375→    );
   376→  }
   377→  if (ctx.shotId && shotResult.error) {
   378→    throw new ToolSettingsError(
   379→      'scope_fetch_failed',
   380→      `Failed to load shot settings: ${describeScopeError(shotResult.error)}`,
   381→      { recoverable: true, cause: shotResult.error, metadata: { scope: 'shot', shotId: ctx.shotId } },
   382→    );
   383→  }
   384→
   385→  const userSettingsData = userResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   386→  const projectSettingsData = projectResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   387→  const shotSettingsData = shotResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   388→  const userSettings = (userSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   389→  const projectSettings = (projectSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   390→  const shotSettings = (shotSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   391→  const defaultSettings = (toolDefaultsRegistry[toolId] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined) ?? {};
   392→
   393→  const hasShotSettings = shotSettings && Object.keys(shotSettings).length > 0;
   394→
   395→  // Merge in priority order: defaults -> user -> project -> shot
   396→  const merged = deepMerge(
   397→    {},
   398→    defaultSettings,
   399→    userSettings,
   400→    projectSettings,
   401→    shotSettings
   402→  );
   403→
   404→  return { settings: merged, hasShotSettings };
   405→}

   407→// ============================================================================
   408→// Settings fetch
   409→// ============================================================================
```
