   411→/**
   412→ * Fetch and merge tool settings from all scopes using direct Supabase calls.
   413→ *
   414→ * Pipeline: dedup → auth → fetchAllScopes → extractAndMerge.
   415→ * Uses single-flight deduplication for concurrent identical requests.
   416→ *
   417→ * @returns `{ settings, hasShotSettings }` wrapper
   418→ */
   419→export async function fetchToolSettingsSupabase(
   420→  toolId: string,
   421→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   422→  signal?: AbortSignal
   423→): Promise<OperationResult<SettingsFetchResult>> {
   424→  try {
   425→    reportUnknownSettingsId(toolId);
   426→
   427→    // Check if request was cancelled before starting
   428→    if (signal?.aborted) {
   429→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   430→        recoverable: true,
   431→      }));
   432→    }
   433→
   434→    // Single-flight dedupe key for concurrent identical requests
   435→    const singleFlightKey = JSON.stringify({ toolId, projectId: ctx.projectId ?? null, shotId: ctx.shotId ?? null });
   436→    const existingPromise = inflightSettingsFetches.get(singleFlightKey);
   437→    if (existingPromise) {
   438→      const value = await raceWithAbort(existingPromise as Promise<SettingsFetchResult>, signal);
   439→      return operationSuccess(value);
   440→    }
   441→
   442→    const promise = (async (): Promise<SettingsFetchResult> => {
   443→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   444→
   445→      const { data: { user } } = await getUserWithTimeout();
   446→
   447→      if (!user) {
   448→        throw new ToolSettingsError('auth_required', 'Authentication required');
   449→      }
   450→
   451→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   452→
   453→      const supabaseClient = getSupabaseClient();
   454→      const [userResult, projectResult, shotResult] = await fetchAllScopes(supabaseClient, user.id, ctx, signal);
   455→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   456→      return extractAndMergeSettings(userResult, projectResult, shotResult, toolId, ctx);
   457→    })();
   458→
   459→    inflightSettingsFetches.set(singleFlightKey, promise);
   460→    // The .finally cleanup promise is intentionally not awaited or returned.
   461→    // Suppress its rejection to avoid unhandled rejection warnings — the original
   462→    // `promise` reference (returned below) handles propagation to the caller.
   463→    promise.finally(() => {
   464→      inflightSettingsFetches.delete(singleFlightKey);
   465→    }).catch(() => {});
   466→    const value = await raceWithAbort(promise, signal);
   467→    return operationSuccess(value);
   468→
   469→  } catch (error: unknown) {
   470→    if (isToolSettingsError(error) && error.code === 'cancelled') {
   471→      return toOperationFailure(error);
   472→    }
   473→    if (isCancellationError(error)) {
   474→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   475→        recoverable: true,
   476→        cause: error,
   477→      }));
   478→    }
   479→    // Build context info without calling getSession() — can block during token refresh
   480→    const errorMsg = getErrorMessage(error);
   481→    const contextInfo = {
   482→      visibilityState: typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.visibilityState : 'unknown',
   483→      hidden: typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.hidden : false,
   484→      online: typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.onLine : true,
   485→    };
   486→
   487→    if (errorMsg.includes('Auth timeout') || errorMsg.includes('Auth request was cancelled')) {
   488→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   489→        context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase.authTimeout',
   490→        showToast: false,
   491→        logData: contextInfo,
   492→      });
   493→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError(
   494→        'network',

     2→ * useTaskPlaceholder — Collapse placeholder lifecycle to one call.
     3→ *
     4→ * Every task-creation callsite needs the same 5-step ceremony:
     5→ *   addIncomingTask → create → resolveTaskIds → refetch → removeIncomingTask
     6→ * This hook wraps that into a single `run()` function.
     7→ *
     8→ * Also handles mid-flight cancellation: if cancelAllIncoming() is called
     9→ * while create() is in flight, the newly created tasks are cancelled in DB.
    10→ */
    11→
    12→import { useCallback } from 'react';
    13→import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    14→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    15→import { useIncomingTasks } from '@/shared/contexts/IncomingTasksContext';
    16→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    17→import { taskQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/tasks';
    18→
    19→export interface TaskPlaceholderOptions {
    20→  taskType: string;
    21→  label: string;
    22→  expectedCount?: number;
    23→  context: string;
    24→  toastTitle: string;
    25→  create: () => Promise<unknown>;
    26→  /** Extra work after task IDs are resolved (e.g. invalidateQueries). */
    27→  onSuccess?: (taskIds: string[]) => void | Promise<void>;
    28→}
    29→
    30→/**
    31→ * Extract task IDs from whatever shape the create() function returns.
    32→ *
    33→ * Handles:
    34→ *  - string                        → raw task_id
    35→ *  - string[]                      → array of raw task_ids
    36→ *  - { task_id: string }           → single TaskCreationResult
    37→ *  - Array<{ task_id: string }>    → batch results
    38→ *  - mixed arrays of strings and objects
    39→ *  - void/null/undefined           → [] (graceful degradation)
    40→ */
    41→export function extractTaskIds(result: unknown): string[] {
    42→  if (result == null) return [];
    43→
    44→  if (typeof result === 'string') return [result];
    45→
    46→  if (Array.isArray(result)) {
    47→    return result.flatMap(item => {
    48→      if (typeof item === 'string') return [item];
    49→      if (item != null && typeof item === 'object' && 'task_id' in item) {
    50→        const id = (item as { task_id: unknown }).task_id;
    51→        if (typeof id === 'string') return [id];
    52→      }
    53→      return [];
    54→    });
    55→  }
    56→
    57→  if (typeof result === 'object' && 'task_id' in result) {
    58→    const id = (result as { task_id: unknown }).task_id;
    59→    if (typeof id === 'string') return [id];
    60→  }
    61→
    62→  return [];
    63→}
    64→
    65→/** Cancel specific task IDs in the database (used for mid-flight cancellation). */
    66→async function cancelTasksByIds(taskIds: string[]): Promise<void> {
    67→  if (taskIds.length === 0) return;
    68→  await supabase().from('tasks')
    69→    .update({ status: 'Cancelled', updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
    70→    .in('id', taskIds);
    71→}
    72→
    73→export type RunTaskPlaceholder = (options: TaskPlaceholderOptions) => Promise<void>;
    74→
    75→/**
    76→ * Returns a stable `run` function that wraps the full placeholder lifecycle.
    77→ *
    78→ * Usage:
    79→ * ```ts
    80→ * const run = useTaskPlaceholder();
    81→ * await run({
    82→ *   taskType: 'image-upscale', label: 'Upscale 2x',
    83→ *   context: 'useUpscale', toastTitle: 'Upscale failed',
    84→ *   create: () => createImageUpscaleTask(params),
    85→ * });
    86→ * ```
    87→ */
    88→export function useTaskPlaceholder(): RunTaskPlaceholder {
    89→  const { addIncomingTask, removeIncomingTask, resolveTaskIds, wasCancelled, acknowledgeCancellation } = useIncomingTasks();
    90→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    91→
    92→  return useCallback(async (options: TaskPlaceholderOptions) => {
    93→    const incomingTaskId = addIncomingTask({
    94→      taskType: options.taskType,
    95→      label: options.label,
    96→      expectedCount: options.expectedCount,
    97→    });
    98→
    99→    try {
   100→      const result = await options.create();
   101→      const taskIds = extractTaskIds(result);
   102→
   103→      // If cancelled while create() was in flight, cancel the newly created tasks.
   104→      if (wasCancelled(incomingTaskId)) {
   105→        if (taskIds.length > 0) {
   106→          await cancelTasksByIds(taskIds);
   107→        }
   108→        acknowledgeCancellation(incomingTaskId);
   109→        return; // finally block still runs for refetch + cleanup
   110→      }
   111→
   112→      if (taskIds.length > 0) {
   113→        resolveTaskIds(incomingTaskId, taskIds);
   114→      }
   115→
   116→      await options.onSuccess?.(taskIds);
   117→    } catch (error) {
   118→      if (wasCancelled(incomingTaskId)) {
   119→        acknowledgeCancellation(incomingTaskId);
   120→        return; // Swallow errors from cancelled tasks
   121→      }
   122→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: options.context, toastTitle: options.toastTitle });
   123→    } finally {
   124→      await queryClient.refetchQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   125→      await queryClient.refetchQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   126→      // Safe even if already removed by cancelAllIncoming — filter is a no-op
   127→      removeIncomingTask(incomingTaskId);
   128→    }
   129→  }, [addIncomingTask, removeIncomingTask, resolveTaskIds, queryClient, wasCancelled, acknowledgeCancellation]);
   130→}

1→type ManagedDebugGlobalKey =
     2→  | '__supabase_client__'
     3→  | 'supabase'
     4→  | '__RECONNECT_SCHEDULER__'
     5→  | '__DATA_FRESHNESS_MANAGER__';
     6→
     7→interface ActiveRegistration {
     8→  owner: string;
     9→  value: unknown;
    10→}
    11→
    12→const activeRegistrations = new Map<ManagedDebugGlobalKey, ActiveRegistration>();
    13→
    14→function hasWindow(): boolean {
    15→  return typeof window !== 'undefined';
    16→}
    17→
    18→export function registerDebugGlobal<K extends ManagedDebugGlobalKey>(
    19→  key: K,
    20→  value: NonNullable<Window[K]>,
    21→  owner: string,
    22→): () => void {
    23→  if (!hasWindow()) {
    24→    return () => {};
    25→  }
    26→
    27→  const globalWindow = window as Window;
    28→  const hadPrevious = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(globalWindow, key);
    29→  const previousValue = globalWindow[key];
    30→  const previousRegistration = activeRegistrations.get(key) ?? null;
    31→
    32→  globalWindow[key] = value;
    33→  activeRegistrations.set(key, { owner, value });
    34→
    35→  let disposed = false;
    36→  return () => {
    37→    if (disposed || !hasWindow()) {
    38→      return;
    39→    }
    40→    disposed = true;
    41→
    42→    const currentRegistration = activeRegistrations.get(key);
    43→    if (!currentRegistration || currentRegistration.value !== value) {
    44→      return;
    45→    }
    46→
    47→    if (previousRegistration) {
    48→      globalWindow[key] = previousRegistration.value as Window[K];
    49→      activeRegistrations.set(key, previousRegistration);
    50→      return;
    51→    }
    52→
    53→    if (hadPrevious) {
    54→      globalWindow[key] = previousValue as Window[K];
    55→    } else {
    56→      delete (globalWindow as Partial<Record<ManagedDebugGlobalKey, unknown>>)[key];
    57→    }
    58→
    59→    activeRegistrations.delete(key);
    60→  };
    61→}
    62→
    63→export function getDebugGlobal<K extends ManagedDebugGlobalKey>(key: K): Window[K] | undefined {
    64→  if (!hasWindow()) {
    65→    return undefined;
    66→  }
    67→  return (window as Window)[key];
    68→}
    69→
    70→export function getDebugGlobalOwner([REDACTED]): string | null {
    71→  return activeRegistrations.get(key)?.owner ?? null;
    72→}
    73→

     2→
     3→export interface OperationSuccess<T> {
     4→  ok: true;
     5→  value: T;
     6→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
     7→  recoverable: false;
     8→}
     9→
    10→export interface OperationFailure {
    11→  ok: false;
    12→  error: Error;
    13→  message: string;
    14→  recoverable: boolean;
    15→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    16→  errorCode: string;
    17→  cause?: unknown;
    18→}
    19→
    20→export type OperationResult<T> = OperationSuccess<T> | OperationFailure;
    21→
    22→export class OperationResultError extends Error {
    23→  errorCode: string;
    24→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    25→  recoverable: boolean;
    26→  cause?: unknown;
    27→
    28→  constructor(options: {
    29→    message: string;
    30→    errorCode: string;
    31→    policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    32→    recoverable: boolean;
    33→    cause?: unknown;
    34→    sourceError?: Error;
    35→  }) {
    36→    super(options.message);
    37→    this.name = 'OperationResultError';
    38→    this.errorCode = options.errorCode;
    39→    this.policy = options.policy;
    40→    this.recoverable = options.recoverable;
    41→    this.cause = options.cause;
    42→
    43→    // Preserve the original stack for easier debugging when available.
    44→    if (options.sourceError?.stack) {
    45→      this.stack = options.sourceError.stack;
    46→    }
    47→  }
    48→}
    49→
    50→interface OperationSuccessOptions {
    51→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    52→}
    53→
    54→interface OperationFailureOptions {
    55→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    56→  recoverable?: boolean;
    57→  errorCode?: string;
    58→  message?: string;
    59→  cause?: unknown;
    60→}
    61→
    62→export function operationSuccess<T>(value: T, options?: OperationSuccessOptions): OperationSuccess<T> {
    63→  return {
    64→    ok: true,
    65→    value,
    66→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    67→    recoverable: false,
    68→  };
    69→}
    70→
    71→export function operationFailure(error: unknown, options?: OperationFailureOptions): OperationFailure {
    72→  const normalizedError = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    73→  return {
    74→    ok: false,
    75→    error: normalizedError,
    76→    message: options?.message ?? normalizedError.message,
    77→    recoverable: options?.recoverable ?? true,
    78→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    79→    errorCode: options?.errorCode ?? 'operation_failed',
    80→    ...(options?.cause !== undefined ? { cause: options.cause } : {}),
    81→  };
    82→}
    83→
    84→/**
    85→ * Convert a structured operation failure into an Error while preserving machine-readable metadata.
    86→ */
    87→export function toOperationResultError(failure: OperationFailure): OperationResultError {
    88→  return new OperationResultError({
    89→    message: failure.message,
    90→    errorCode: failure.errorCode,
    91→    policy: failure.policy,
    92→    recoverable: failure.recoverable,
    93→    cause: failure.cause,
    94→    sourceError: failure.error,
    95→  });
    96→}

     4→// Lightweight logging helper that can be enabled/disabled via Vite env
     5→// Usage:
     6→//   import { log, time, timeEnd } from '@/shared/lib/logger';
     7→//   log('MyTag', 'Some message', optionalData);
     8→//   time('MyTag', 'expensive-operation');
     9→//   ...do work...
    10→//   timeEnd('MyTag', 'expensive-operation');
    11→//
    12→// Logs are only printed when `VITE_DEBUG_LOGS` is set to `true`.
    13→// This avoids polluting the console in production while still allowing
    14→// rich diagnostics for performance investigations.
    15→//
    16→// Log persistence (to system_logs table):
    17→//   Set `VITE_PERSIST_LOGS=true` to buffer and send logs to system_logs.
    18→//   When enabled, ALL console.log/warn/error calls are captured automatically.
    19→//   Logs are batched and flushed every 10s or when buffer hits 50 entries.
    20→//   Query with: SELECT * FROM system_logs WHERE source_type = 'browser'
    21→//   Or use: debug.py logs --latest
    22→//
    23→// All logs share the same shape so they can be filtered easily.
    24→// Tag format guideline (keep short & consistent):
    25→//   [Area][Specific] e.g. [TaskPoller], [Render:GenerationsPane]
    26→
    27→// ===== CONFIGURATION =====
    28→
    29→const FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS = 10000; // Flush every 10 seconds
    30→const FLUSH_BUFFER_SIZE = 100;   // Flush when buffer hits this size
    31→
    32→function generateSessionId(): string {
    33→  const timestamp = Date.now();
    34→  const runtimeCrypto = globalThis.crypto;
    35→
    36→  if (runtimeCrypto?.randomUUID) {
    37→    return `browser-${timestamp}-${runtimeCrypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    38→  }
    39→
    40→  if (runtimeCrypto?.getRandomValues) {
    41→    const randomBytes = new Uint8Array(4);
    42→    runtimeCrypto.getRandomValues(randomBytes);
    43→    const randomHex = Array.from(randomBytes, (byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    44→    return `browser-${timestamp}-${randomHex}`;
    45→  }
    46→
    47→  return `browser-${timestamp}-no-crypto`;
    48→}
    49→
    50→const SESSION_ID = generateSessionId();

    26→    // Auth operations (supabase.auth.*) are unaffected.
    27→    let cachedToken: string | null = readAccessTokenFromStorage();

    51→    // replacement takes effect immediately without recreating any clients.
    52→    const dataFetch = async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    53→      const headers = new Headers(init.headers ?? {});
    54→      if (!headers.has('apikey')) headers.set('apikey', key);
    55→      if (!headers.has('Authorization')) {

    57→      }

1→/**
     2→ * Shared Supabase session helpers for reading auth data from localStorage.
     3→ *
     4→ * Supabase stores the session JSON under `sb-${projectRef}-auth-token`.
     5→ * Reading localStorage is synchronous and never contends with the
     6→ * navigator.locks used by GoTrueClient's getSession()/getUser().
     7→ * During token refresh Supabase holds an EXCLUSIVE lock, so all shared-lock
     8→ * requests queue behind it (600ms-16s). These helpers avoid that entirely.
     9→ *
    10→ * Used by: taskCreation.ts, invokeWithTimeout.ts, toolSettingsService.ts,
    11→ *          createSupabaseClient.ts.
    12→ */
    13→
    14→import { getSupabaseUrl } from '@/integrations/supabase/config/env';
    15→import {
    16→  operationFailure,
    17→  operationSuccess,
    18→  type OperationResult,
    19→} from '@/shared/lib/operationResult';
    20→
    21→/**
    22→ * Parse the Supabase project ref from the configured URL.
    23→ * The ref is the first segment of the hostname (e.g. "abcdef" from "abcdef.supabase.co").
    24→ */
    25→function getProjectRef(): string {
    26→  return new URL(getSupabaseUrl()).hostname.split('.')[0];
    27→}
    28→
    29→/**
    30→ * Read the raw Supabase session JSON from localStorage.
    31→ * Returns null if no session exists or if running in a non-browser environment.
    32→ */
    33→function readRawSession(): Record<string, unknown> | null {
    34→  const probe = probeRawSession();
    35→  return probe.ok ? probe.value : null;
    36→}
    37→
    38→function probeRawSession(): OperationResult<Record<string, unknown> | null> {
    39→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    40→    return operationSuccess(null, { policy: 'best_effort' });
    41→  }
    42→  try {
    43→    const raw = localStorage.getItem(`sb-${getProjectRef()}-auth-token`);
    44→    if (!raw) {
    45→      return operationSuccess(null, { policy: 'best_effort' });
    46→    }
    47→
    48→    try {
    49→      return operationSuccess(JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, unknown>, {
    50→        policy: 'best_effort',
    51→      });
    52→    } catch (parseError) {
    53→      return operationFailure(parseError, {
    54→        policy: 'degrade',
    55→        recoverable: true,
    56→        errorCode: 'session_storage_parse_failed',
    57→        message: 'Failed to parse cached Supabase session.',
    58→        cause: parseError,
    59→      });
    60→    }
    61→  } catch (storageError) {
    62→    return operationFailure(storageError, {
    63→      policy: 'degrade',
    64→      recoverable: true,
    65→      errorCode: 'session_storage_unavailable',
    66→      message: 'Unable to access localStorage for cached Supabase session.',
    67→      cause: storageError,
    68→    });
    69→  }
    70→}
    71→
    72→function readString(value: unknown): string | null {
    73→  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : null;
    74→}
    75→
    76→/**
    77→ * Read the access token directly from localStorage -- synchronous, no navigator.locks.
    78→ * Returns null if no session exists in storage (user is signed out).
    79→ */
    80→export function readAccessTokenFromStorage(): string | null {
    81→  const parsed = readRawSession();
    82→  if (!parsed) return null;
    83→  return readString(parsed.access_token);
    84→}
    85→
    86→/**
    87→ * Read the user ID directly from localStorage -- synchronous, no navigator.locks.
    88→ * Returns null if no session exists in storage (user is signed out).
    89→ */
    90→export function readUserIdFromStorage(): string | null {
    91→  const parsed = readRawSession();
    92→  if (!parsed) return null;
    93→  const user = parsed.user;
    94→  if (!user || typeof user !== 'object') return null;
    95→  return readString((user as Record<string, unknown>).id);
    96→}
    97→
    98→export function hasStoredSessionToken(): boolean {
    99→  return readAccessTokenFromStorage() !== null;
   100→}
   101→
   102→export function probeStoredSessionToken(): OperationResult<boolean> {
   103→  const rawSessionProbe = probeRawSession();
   104→  if (!rawSessionProbe.ok) {
   105→    return rawSessionProbe;
   106→  }
   107→
   108→  return operationSuccess(
   109→    readString(rawSessionProbe.value?.access_token) !== null,
   110→    { policy: rawSessionProbe.policy },
   111→  );
   112→}
   113→

    16→ * even if those defaults are empty (e.g., prompts: [], batchVideoPrompt: '').
    17→ * This makes the "contract" of what gets persisted clear and self-documenting.
    18→ * 
    19→ * @param value - The current state value to infer an empty value from
    20→ * @returns An appropriate empty value based on the type of the input
    21→ */
    22→function inferEmptyValue(value: unknown): unknown {
    23→  if (Array.isArray(value)) return [];
    24→  if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null) return {};
    25→  if (typeof value === 'string') return '';
    26→  if (typeof value === 'number') return 0;
    27→  if (typeof value === 'boolean') return false;
    28→  return undefined;
    29→}
    30→
    31→type StateSetter<T> = React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<T>>;
    32→type StateMapping<T extends object> = {
    33→  [K in keyof T]: [T[K], StateSetter<T[K]>];
    34→};
    35→
    36→interface UsePersistentToolStateOptions {
    37→  debounceMs?: number;
    38→  scope?: SettingsScope;
    39→  /**
    40→   * If false, the hook will skip fetching/saving settings and immediately report ready=true.
    41→   * Useful when the relevant entity (e.g. project) has not been selected yet.
    42→   */
    43→  enabled?: boolean;
    44→  /**
    45→   * Explicit defaults for fields that aren't in the tools manifest.
    46→   * Use this for non-tool callers (e.g. PromptEditorModal) to avoid
    47→   * the "no default value" warning and ensure correct reset behavior.
    48→   */
    49→  defaults?: Record<string, unknown>;
    50→}
    51→
    52→interface UsePersistentToolStateResult {
    53→  ready: boolean;
    54→  isSaving: boolean;
    55→  saveError?: Error;
    56→  hasUserInteracted: boolean;
    57→  markAsInteracted: () => void;
    58→}
    59→
    60→/**
    61→ * Hook that synchronizes existing `useState` variables with persistent tool settings.
    62→ *
    63→ * Unlike `useAutoSaveSettings` which owns its own state, this hook binds to
    64→ * pre-existing `[value, setter]` pairs -- useful when the form already manages
    65→ * its own `useState` and you want to add persistence without restructuring.
    66→ *
    67→ * Key difference from `useAutoSaveSettings`: the `markAsInteracted()` guard.
    68→ * Settings are only saved after the user explicitly interacts, preventing
    69→ * auto-initialization effects from being persisted as user choices.
    70→ *
    71→ * For new features, prefer `useAutoSaveSettings` unless you specifically need
    72→ * the bind-to-existing-useState pattern or the interaction guard.
    73→ *
    74→ * @param toolId - The tool identifier (e.g., 'image-generation', 'video-travel')
    75→ * @param context - Context for settings resolution (projectId, shotId, etc.)
    76→ * @param stateMapping - Object mapping setting keys to [value, setter] tuples
    77→ * @param options - Additional options for behavior customization
    78→ * @returns Object with ready state, saving state, and interaction tracking
    79→ *
    80→ * @see docs/structure_detail/settings_system.md for the full settings hook decision tree
    81→ *
    82→ * @example
    83→ * const { ready, isSaving, markAsInteracted } = usePersistentToolState(
    84→ *   'image-generation',
    85→ *   { projectId },
    86→ *   {
    87→ *     generationMode: [generationMode, setGenerationMode],
    88→ *     imagesPerPrompt: [imagesPerPrompt, setImagesPerPrompt],
    89→ *   }
    90→ * );
    91→ * // Call markAsInteracted() in onChange handlers to enable persistence
    92→ */
    93→export function usePersistentToolState<T extends object>(
    94→  toolId: string,
    95→  context: { projectId?: string; shotId?: string },
    96→  stateMapping: StateMapping<T>,
    97→  options: UsePersistentToolStateOptions = {}
    98→): UsePersistentToolStateResult {
    99→  const { debounceMs = 500, scope = 'project', enabled = true, defaults: explicitDefaults } = options;
   100→  const warnedMissingDefaultsRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());
   101→  const persistenceScope: 'shot' | 'project' = scope === 'shot' ? 'shot' : 'project';
   102→
   103→  // Track hydration and interaction state
   104→  const hasHydratedRef = useRef(false);
   105→  const userHasInteractedRef = useRef(false);
   106→  const lastSyncedSettingsRef = useRef<T | null>(null);
   107→  const hydratedForEntityRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
   108→
   109→  // Public state for consumers
   110→  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
   111→  const [hasUserInteracted, setHasUserInteracted] = useState(false);
   112→
   113→  // Get a unique key for the current entity (project/shot)
   114→  const [REDACTED] === 'shot' ? context.shotId : context.projectId;
   115→  const normalizedProjectId = context.projectId ?? null;
   116→  const normalizedShotId = context.shotId ?? null;
   117→
   118→  useRenderLogger(`PersistentToolState:${toolId}`, { entityKey, enabled });
   119→
   120→  const resolvedDefaults = useMemo(() => {
   121→    const fromRegistry = explicitDefaults || toolDefaultsRegistry[toolId] || {};
   122→    const merged: Record<string, unknown> = { ...fromRegistry };
   123→
   124→    Object.entries(stateMapping).forEach(([key, mapping]) => {
   125→      const [currentValue] = mapping as [T[keyof T], React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<T[keyof T]>>];
   126→      if (merged[key] !== undefined) return;
   127→      const inferred = inferEmptyValue(currentValue);
   128→      merged[key] = inferred;
   129→
   130→      if (import.meta.env.DEV) {
   131→        const warningKey = `${toolId}:${key}`;
   132→        if (!warnedMissingDefaultsRef.current.has(warningKey)) {
   133→          warnedMissingDefaultsRef.current.add(warningKey);
   134→          console.warn(
   135→            `[usePersistentToolState] Field "${key}" in tool "${toolId}" has no default value. ` +
   136→            `Inferring empty value (${JSON.stringify(inferred)}). ` +
   137→            `Consider adding explicit default in settings.ts`
   138→          );
   139→        }
   140→      }
   141→    });
   142→
   143→    return merged as T;
   144→  }, [explicitDefaults, stateMapping, toolId]);
   145→
   146→  const autoSave = useAutoSaveSettings<Record<string, unknown>>({
   147→    toolId,
   148→    shotId: normalizedShotId,
   149→    projectId: normalizedProjectId,
   150→    scope: persistenceScope,
   151→    defaults: resolvedDefaults as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
   152→    enabled: enabled && !!entityKey,
   153→    // Preserve existing behavior: this adapter intentionally keeps a short debounce.
   154→    debounceMs: Math.min(debounceMs, 100),
   155→  });
   156→  const autoSaveStatus = autoSave.status;
   157→  const autoSaveSettings = autoSave.settings as Partial<T>;
   158→  const autoSaveUpdateFields = autoSave.updateFields as (updates: Partial<T>) => void;
   159→  const autoSaveError = autoSave.error;
   160→
   161→  // Reset hydration when entity changes
   162→  useEffect(() => {
   163→    if (entityKey !== hydratedForEntityRef.current) {
   164→      hasHydratedRef.current = false;
   165→      userHasInteractedRef.current = false;
   166→      lastSyncedSettingsRef.current = null;
   167→      hydratedForEntityRef.current = entityKey || null;
   168→      setReady(false);
   169→      setHasUserInteracted(false);
   170→    }
   171→  }, [entityKey, toolId]);
   172→
   173→  // Hydrate external state setters from persisted settings once entity is ready.
   174→  useEffect(() => {
   175→    if (!enabled || !entityKey || hasHydratedRef.current || autoSaveStatus !== 'ready') return;
   176→
   177→    const effectiveSettings = (autoSaveSettings || resolvedDefaults) as Partial<T>;
   178→    Object.entries(stateMapping).forEach(([key, mapping]) => {
   179→      const [, setter] = mapping as [T[keyof T], React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<T[keyof T]>>];
   180→      setter(effectiveSettings[key as keyof T] as T[keyof T]);
   181→    });
   182→
   183→    hasHydratedRef.current = true;
   184→    userHasInteractedRef.current = false;
   185→    setReady(true);
   186→  }, [autoSaveSettings, autoSaveStatus, enabled, entityKey, resolvedDefaults, stateMapping]);
   187→
   188→  // Collect current state values from the mapping
   189→  const getCurrentState = useCallback((): T => {
   190→    const currentState: Record<string, unknown> = {};
   191→    Object.entries(stateMapping as Record<string, [unknown, React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<unknown>>]>).forEach(([key, [value]]) => {
   192→      currentState[key] = value;
   193→    });
   194→    return currentState as T;
   195→  }, [stateMapping]);
   196→
   197→  // Function to mark that user has interacted
   198→  const markAsInteracted = useCallback(() => {
   199→    if (!enabled) return;
   200→    userHasInteractedRef.current = true;
   201→    setHasUserInteracted(true);
   202→  }, [enabled]);
   203→
   204→  const noopMarkAsInteracted = useCallback(() => {}, []);
   205→  const stateValuesSignature = useMemo(() => {
   206→    const stateValues: Record<string, unknown> = {};
   207→    Object.entries(stateMapping as Record<string, [unknown, React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<unknown>>]>).forEach(([key, [value]]) => {
   208→      stateValues[key] = value;
   209→    });
   210→    return JSON.stringify(stateValues);
   211→  }, [stateMapping]);
   212→
   213→  // Push external state updates into the canonical auto-save hook after user interaction.
   214→  useEffect(() => {
   215→    if (
   216→      !enabled ||
   217→      !entityKey ||
   218→      !hasHydratedRef.current ||
   219→      !userHasInteractedRef.current ||
   220→      autoSaveStatus === 'loading'
   221→    ) {
   222→      return;
   223→    }
   224→
   225→    const currentState = getCurrentState();
   226→
   227→    if (
   228→      lastSyncedSettingsRef.current &&
   229→      deepEqual(
   230→        sanitizeSettings(currentState),
   231→        sanitizeSettings(lastSyncedSettingsRef.current)
   232→      )
   233→    ) {
   234→      return;
   235→    }
   236→
   237→    if (deepEqual(sanitizeSettings(currentState), sanitizeSettings(autoSaveSettings))) {
   238→      return;
   239→    }
   240→
   241→    lastSyncedSettingsRef.current = currentState;
   242→    autoSaveUpdateFields(currentState);
   243→  }, [
   244→    autoSaveSettings,
   245→    autoSaveStatus,
   246→    autoSaveUpdateFields,
   247→    enabled,
   248→    entityKey,
   249→    getCurrentState,
   250→    stateValuesSignature,
   251→  ]);
   252→
   253→  return {
   254→    ready: enabled ? !!entityKey && ready : true,
   255→    isSaving: enabled ? autoSaveStatus === 'saving' : false,
   256→    saveError: enabled ? autoSaveError ?? undefined : undefined,
   257→    hasUserInteracted: enabled ? hasUserInteracted : false,
   258→    markAsInteracted: enabled ? markAsInteracted : noopMarkAsInteracted,
   259→  };
   260→}
   261→

1→import { isPastRemovalTarget, type DeprecationPolicy } from '@/shared/lib/governance/deprecationPolicy';
     2→import {
     3→  normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow,
     4→  normalizeAndPresentError,
     5→} from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     6→
     7→const signaledDeprecations = new Set<string>();
     8→
     9→interface DeprecationSignalOptions {
    10→  alias: string;
    11→  policy: DeprecationPolicy;
    12→  remediation?: string;
    13→  enforcement?: 'warn' | 'throw' | 'auto';
    14→}
    15→
    16→function resolveEnforcementMode(mode: DeprecationSignalOptions['enforcement']): 'warn' | 'throw' {
    17→  if (mode === 'warn' || mode === 'throw') {
    18→    return mode;
    19→  }
    20→
    21→  const metaEnv = typeof import.meta !== 'undefined'
    22→    ? (import.meta as unknown as { env?: Record<string, string | undefined> }).env
    23→    : undefined;
    24→  const nodeEnv = typeof process !== 'undefined' ? process.env?.NODE_ENV : undefined;
    25→  const isTestMode = nodeEnv === 'test' || metaEnv?.MODE === 'test' || metaEnv?.VITEST === 'true';
    26→  const explicit = metaEnv?.VITE_DEPRECATION_ENFORCEMENT;
    27→
    28→  if (explicit === 'throw') {
    29→    return isTestMode ? 'warn' : 'throw';
    30→  }
    31→  if (explicit === 'warn') {
    32→    return 'warn';
    33→  }
    34→
    35→  if (isTestMode) {
    36→    return 'warn';
    37→  }
    38→
    39→  return nodeEnv === 'production' ? 'warn' : 'throw';
    40→}
    41→
    42→/**
    43→ * Emits a one-time runtime signal when a legacy alias is used past its removal target.
    44→ * Returns true when the usage is past target, false otherwise.
    45→ */
    46→export function signalPastRemovalTargetUsage({
    47→  alias,
    48→  policy,
    49→  remediation,
    50→  enforcement = 'auto',
    51→}: DeprecationSignalOptions): boolean {
    52→  if (!isPastRemovalTarget(policy)) {
    53→    return false;
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  const key = `${alias}:${policy.removeBy}`;
    57→  if (signaledDeprecations.has(key)) {
    58→    return true;
    59→  }
    60→
    61→  signaledDeprecations.add(key);
    62→  const suffix = remediation ? ` ${remediation}` : '';
    63→  const message = `[deprecation] ${alias} is past removal target ${policy.removeBy} (owner: ${policy.owner}).${suffix}`;
    64→  const mode = resolveEnforcementMode(enforcement);
    65→  const logData = {
    66→    alias,
    67→    owner: policy.owner,
    68→    removeBy: policy.removeBy,
    69→    mode,
    70→  };
    71→
    72→  if (mode === 'throw') {
    73→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error(message), {
    74→      context: 'deprecationEnforcement.signalPastRemovalTargetUsage',
    75→      showToast: false,
    76→      logData,
    77→    });
    78→  }
    79→
    80→  normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(message), {
    81→    context: 'deprecationEnforcement.signalPastRemovalTargetUsage',
    82→    showToast: false,
    83→    logData,
    84→  });
    85→  return true;
    86→}
    87→

     3→ *
     4→ * This provider:

     6→ * 2. Wires raw events from connection → processor → invalidation

     9→ */

    11→import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
    12→import { useProject } from '@/shared/contexts/ProjectContext';
    13→import { realtimeConnection } from '@/shared/realtime/RealtimeConnection';
    14→import { realtimeEventProcessor } from '@/shared/realtime/RealtimeEventProcessor';
    15→import { dataFreshnessManager } from '@/shared/realtime/DataFreshnessManager';

    18→
    19→// =============================================================================
    20→// Context
    21→// =============================================================================

    23→interface RealtimeContextValue {
    24→  /** Current connection status */
    25→  status: ConnectionStatus;
    26→  /** Whether currently connected */
    27→  isConnected: boolean;
    28→  /** Whether connection is in progress */
    29→  isConnecting: boolean;
    30→  /** Whether in a failed state (exhausted retries) */
    31→  isFailed: boolean;
    32→  /** Error message if any */
    33→  error: string | null;
    34→  /** Current reconnect attempt (0 if not reconnecting) */
    35→  reconnectAttempt: number;
    36→  /** Manually trigger reconnection */
    37→  reconnect: () => void;
    38→}
    39→
    40→const RealtimeContext = createContext<RealtimeContextValue>({
    41→  status: 'disconnected',
    42→  isConnected: false,
    43→  isConnecting: false,
    44→  isFailed: false,
    45→  error: null,
    46→  reconnectAttempt: 0,
    47→  reconnect: () => {},
    48→});
    49→
    50→export const useRealtime = () => useContext(RealtimeContext);
    51→
    52→// =============================================================================
    53→// Provider
    54→// =============================================================================
    55→
    56→interface RealtimeProviderProps {
    57→  children: React.ReactNode;
    58→}
    59→
    60→export function RealtimeProvider({ children }: RealtimeProviderProps) {
    61→  const { selectedProjectId } = useProject();
    62→  const [connectionState, setConnectionState] = useState<ConnectionState>(
    63→    realtimeConnection.getState()
    64→  );
    65→
    66→  // Set up the invalidation hook (subscribes to processed events)
    67→  useRealtimeInvalidation();
    68→
    69→  // Wire connection events → processor
    70→  useEffect(() => {
    71→    const unsubscribe = realtimeConnection.onEvent((event) => {
    72→      realtimeEventProcessor.process(event);
    73→    });
    74→    return unsubscribe;
    75→  }, []);
    76→
    77→  // Subscribe to connection status changes
    78→  useEffect(() => {
    79→    const unsubscribe = realtimeConnection.onStatusChange((state) => {
    80→      setConnectionState(state);
    81→    });
    82→    return unsubscribe;
    83→  }, []);
    84→
    85→  // Connect/disconnect when project changes
    86→  useEffect(() => {
    87→    if (!selectedProjectId) {
    88→      realtimeConnection.disconnect();
    89→      dataFreshnessManager.reset();
    90→      return;
    91→    }
    92→
    93→    realtimeConnection.connect(selectedProjectId);
    94→
    95→    return () => {
    96→      // Don't disconnect on cleanup - let the next effect handle it
    97→      // This prevents disconnect/reconnect when the component re-renders
    98→    };
    99→  }, [selectedProjectId]);
   100→
   101→  // Clean up on unmount
   102→  useEffect(() => {
   103→    return () => {
   104→      realtimeEventProcessor.clear();
   105→    };
   106→  }, []);
   107→
   108→  // Manual reconnect function
   109→  const reconnect = useCallback(() => {
   110→    if (selectedProjectId) {
   111→      realtimeConnection.reset();
   112→      realtimeConnection.connect(selectedProjectId);
   113→    }
   114→  }, [selectedProjectId]);
   115→
   116→  // Derive context value from connection state
   117→  const contextValue: RealtimeContextValue = {
   118→    status: connectionState.status,
   119→    isConnected: connectionState.status === 'connected',
   120→    isConnecting: connectionState.status === 'connecting',
   121→    isFailed: connectionState.status === 'failed',
   122→    error: connectionState.error,
   123→    reconnectAttempt: connectionState.reconnectAttempt,
   124→    reconnect,
   125→  };
   126→
   127→  return (
   128→    <RealtimeContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
   129→      {children}
   130→    </RealtimeContext.Provider>
   131→  );
   132→}

   524→

   540→    magic,
   541→    reposition,
   542→    img2img,
   543→    starToggle,
   544→    handleDownload,
   545→  });
   546→

   334→// Helper to add raw console args to buffer (extracts tag if present)
   335→function addToBufferRaw(level: BufferedLog['log_level'], args: unknown[]): void {
   336→  if (!shouldPersist() || args.length === 0) return;
   337→  
   338→  // Try to extract a tag from the first arg if it looks like [Tag] or [Tag:Sub]
   339→  let tag = 'console';
   340→  let messageArgs = args;
   341→  
   342→  const firstArg = args[0];
   343→  if (typeof firstArg === 'string') {
   344→    const tagMatch = firstArg.match(/^\[([^\]]+)\]$/);
   345→    if (tagMatch) {
   346→      tag = tagMatch[1];
   347→      messageArgs = args.slice(1);
   348→    } else if (firstArg.startsWith('[') && firstArg.includes(']')) {
   349→      // Handle "[Tag] message" format
   350→      const fullMatch = firstArg.match(/^\[([^\]]+)\]\s*(.*)/);
   351→      if (fullMatch) {
   352→        tag = fullMatch[1];
   353→        messageArgs = fullMatch[2] ? [fullMatch[2], ...args.slice(1)] : args.slice(1);
   354→      }
   355→    }
   356→  }
   357→  
   358→  // Serialize args safely
   359→  const message = `[${tag}] ${messageArgs.map(arg => {
   360→    try {
   361→      if (typeof arg === 'string') return arg;
   362→      if (arg instanceof Error) return `${arg.name}: ${arg.message}`;
   363→      return JSON.stringify(arg);
   364→    } catch {
   365→      return String(arg);
   366→    }
   367→  }).join(' ')}`;
   368→  
   369→  logBuffer.push({
   370→    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
   371→    source_type: 'browser',
   372→    source_id: SESSION_ID,
   373→    log_level: level,
   374→    message: message.slice(0, 2000), // Truncate very long messages
   375→    task_id: null,
   376→    metadata: {
   377→      user_id: getUserId(),
   378→      url: typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.pathname : null,
   379→    }
   380→  });
   381→  
   382→  // Flush if buffer is full
   383→  if (logBuffer.length >= FLUSH_BUFFER_SIZE) {
   384→    flushLogs();
   385→  } else if (!isFlushScheduled) {
   386→    scheduleFlush();
   387→  }
   388→}
   389→

    91→/**
    92→ * Unified edit settings persistence hook
    93→ *
    94→ * Coordinates:
    95→ * 1. Per-generation settings (generations.params.ui.editSettings)
    96→ * 2. "Last used" settings (useToolSettings + localStorage)
    97→ *
    98→ * Loading behavior:
    99→ * - If generation has persisted settings → use those (including prompt)
   100→ * - If no persisted settings → use "last used" (prompt = '')
   101→ *
   102→ * Saving behavior:
   103→ * - All changes save to generation
   104→ * - Non-prompt changes also update "last used"
   105→ */
   106→export function useEditSettingsPersistence({
   107→  generationId,
   108→  projectId,
   109→  enabled = true,
   110→}: UseEditSettingsPersistenceProps): UseEditSettingsPersistenceReturn {
   111→  // Per-generation settings
   112→  const generationSettings = useGenerationEditSettings({
   113→    generationId,
   114→    enabled,
   115→  });
   116→
   117→  // "Last used" settings
   118→  const lastUsedSettings = useLastUsedEditSettings({
   119→    projectId,
   120→    enabled,
   121→  });
   122→
   123→  // Track initialization state
   124→  const hasInitializedRef = useRef(false);
   125→  const lastGenerationIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
   126→  const [isReady, setIsReady] = useState(false);
   127→
   128→  // Reset initialization on generation change
   129→  useEffect(() => {
   130→    if (generationId !== lastGenerationIdRef.current) {
   131→      hasInitializedRef.current = false;
   132→      lastGenerationIdRef.current = generationId;
   133→      setIsReady(false);
   134→    }
   135→  }, [generationId]);
   136→
   137→  // Extract stable references for the initialization effect
   138→  const { isLoading: genIsLoading, hasPersistedSettings, initializeFromLastUsed } = generationSettings;
   139→  const { lastUsed } = lastUsedSettings;
   140→
   141→  // Initialize from "last used" when generation loads without persisted settings
   142→  useEffect(() => {
   143→    if (!genIsLoading && !hasInitializedRef.current && !hasPersistedSettings && generationId) {
   144→      hasInitializedRef.current = true;
   145→      // Apply "last used" settings (without prompt)
   146→      initializeFromLastUsed(lastUsed);
   147→      setIsReady(true);
   148→    } else if (!genIsLoading && !hasInitializedRef.current && hasPersistedSettings) {
   149→      hasInitializedRef.current = true;
   150→      setIsReady(true);
   151→    }
   152→  }, [generationId, genIsLoading, hasPersistedSettings, initializeFromLastUsed, lastUsed]);
   153→
   154→  // Compute effective values
   155→  // editMode is ALWAYS from lastUsed (user-level, not per-generation) so it stays consistent across images/videos
   156→  // Other settings like prompt, loraMode are per-generation
   157→  const effectiveSettings = useMemo(() => {
   158→    if (generationSettings.isLoading) {
   159→      // Still loading, use defaults but editMode from lastUsed
   160→      return {
   161→        ...DEFAULT_EDIT_SETTINGS,
   162→        editMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.editMode,
   163→      };
   164→    }
   165→
   166→    if (generationSettings.hasPersistedSettings) {
   167→      // Has persisted settings, use them BUT override editMode with lastUsed (user-level)
   168→      return {
   169→        ...generationSettings.settings,
   170→        editMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.editMode,
   171→      };
   172→    }
   173→
   174→    // No persisted settings yet.
   175→    // Before the coordinator finishes initialization, we use lastUsed as defaults.
   176→    // After initialization, always prefer the live generationSettings state so controls
   177→    // (like the Img2Img strength slider) never feel "locked" while the debounced save runs.
   178→    if (!isReady) {
   179→      return {
   180→        editMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.editMode,
   181→        loraMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.loraMode,
   182→        customLoraUrl: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.customLoraUrl,
   183→        numGenerations: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.numGenerations,
   184→        prompt: generationSettings.settings.prompt || '',
   185→        img2imgPrompt: generationSettings.settings.img2imgPrompt || '',
   186→        img2imgPromptHasBeenSet: generationSettings.settings.img2imgPromptHasBeenSet || false,
   187→        img2imgStrength: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.img2imgStrength,
   188→        img2imgEnablePromptExpansion: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.img2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   189→        advancedSettings: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.advancedSettings ?? DEFAULT_ADVANCED_SETTINGS,
   190→        enhanceSettings: generationSettings.settings.enhanceSettings ?? DEFAULT_ENHANCE_SETTINGS,
   191→        qwenEditModel: generationSettings.settings.qwenEditModel ?? DEFAULT_EDIT_SETTINGS.qwenEditModel,
   192→        createAsGeneration: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.createAsGeneration,
   193→      };
   194→    }
   195→
   196→    // Initialized: use the live per-generation state BUT override editMode with lastUsed (user-level)
   197→    return {
   198→      ...generationSettings.settings,
   199→      editMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.editMode,
   200→    };
   201→  }, [
   202→    isReady,
   203→    generationSettings.isLoading,
   204→    generationSettings.hasPersistedSettings,
   205→    generationSettings.settings,
   206→    lastUsedSettings.lastUsed,
   207→  ]);
   208→
   209→  // Extract stable function references to avoid recreating callbacks on every render
   210→  // (the parent objects are recreated each render, but these functions are stable)
   211→  const { updateLastUsed } = lastUsedSettings;
   212→  const {
   213→    setLoraMode: genSetLoraMode,
   214→    setCustomLoraUrl: genSetCustomLoraUrl,
   215→    setNumGenerations: genSetNumGenerations,
   216→    setPrompt: genSetPrompt,
   217→    setQwenEditModel: genSetQwenEditModel,
   218→    setImg2imgPrompt: genSetImg2imgPrompt,
   219→    setImg2imgStrength: genSetImg2imgStrength,
   220→    setImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion: genSetImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   221→    setAdvancedSettings: genSetAdvancedSettings,
   222→    setEnhanceSettings: genSetEnhanceSettings,
   223→    setCreateAsGeneration: genSetCreateAsGeneration,
   224→  } = generationSettings;
   225→
   226→  // Wrapper setters that also update "last used" (except prompt)
   227→  // editMode is user-level only (not per-generation) so it stays consistent across images/videos
   228→  const setEditMode = useCallback((mode: EditMode) => {
   229→    updateLastUsed({ editMode: mode });
   230→  }, [updateLastUsed]);
   231→
   232→  const setLoraMode = useCallback((mode: LoraMode) => {
   233→    genSetLoraMode(mode);
   234→    updateLastUsed({ loraMode: mode });
   235→  }, [genSetLoraMode, updateLastUsed]);
   236→
   237→  const setCustomLoraUrl = useCallback((url: string) => {
   238→    genSetCustomLoraUrl(url);
   239→    updateLastUsed({ customLoraUrl: url });
   240→  }, [genSetCustomLoraUrl, updateLastUsed]);
   241→
   242→  const setNumGenerations = useCallback((num: number) => {
   243→    genSetNumGenerations(num);
   244→    updateLastUsed({ numGenerations: num });
   245→  }, [genSetNumGenerations, updateLastUsed]);
   246→
   247→  // Prompt only saves to generation (never to "last used")
   248→  const setPrompt = useCallback((prompt: string) => {
   249→    genSetPrompt(prompt);
   250→  }, [genSetPrompt]);
   251→
   252→  // Model selection (saves to generation, cloud mode only)
   253→  const setQwenEditModel = useCallback((model: QwenEditModel) => {
   254→    genSetQwenEditModel(model);
   255→  }, [genSetQwenEditModel]);
   256→
   257→  // Img2Img prompt only saves to generation (never to "last used")
   258→  const setImg2imgPrompt = useCallback((prompt: string) => {
   259→    genSetImg2imgPrompt(prompt);
   260→  }, [genSetImg2imgPrompt]);
   261→
   262→  // Img2Img setters (save to both generation and "last used")
   263→  const setImg2imgStrength = useCallback((strength: number) => {
   264→    genSetImg2imgStrength(strength);
   265→    updateLastUsed({ img2imgStrength: strength });
   266→  }, [genSetImg2imgStrength, updateLastUsed]);
   267→
   268→  const setImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion = useCallback((enabled: boolean) => {
   269→    genSetImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion(enabled);
   270→    updateLastUsed({ img2imgEnablePromptExpansion: enabled });
   271→  }, [genSetImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion, updateLastUsed]);
   272→
   273→  // Advanced settings setter (merges with existing, saves to both generation and "last used")
   274→  const setAdvancedSettings = useCallback((updates: Partial<EditAdvancedSettings>) => {
   275→    genSetAdvancedSettings(updates);
   276→    // Merge updates with current advancedSettings for lastUsed
   277→    const currentAdvanced = effectiveSettings.advancedSettings ?? DEFAULT_ADVANCED_SETTINGS;
   278→    updateLastUsed({ advancedSettings: { ...currentAdvanced, ...updates } });
   279→  }, [genSetAdvancedSettings, updateLastUsed, effectiveSettings.advancedSettings]);
   280→
   281→  // Video enhance settings setter (per-generation only, not "last used")
   282→  const setEnhanceSettings = useCallback((updates: Partial<VideoEnhanceSettings>) => {
   283→    genSetEnhanceSettings(updates);
   284→  }, [genSetEnhanceSettings]);
   285→
   286→  // Generation options setter (saves to both generation and "last used")
   287→  const setCreateAsGeneration = useCallback((value: boolean) => {
   288→    genSetCreateAsGeneration(value);
   289→    updateLastUsed({ createAsGeneration: value });
   290→  }, [genSetCreateAsGeneration, updateLastUsed]);
   291→
   292→  // Video/Panel mode setters (only save to "last used", not per-generation)
   293→  const setVideoEditSubMode = useCallback((mode: VideoEditSubMode) => {
   294→    updateLastUsed({ videoEditSubMode: mode });
   295→  }, [updateLastUsed]);
   296→
   297→  const setPanelMode = useCallback((mode: PanelMode) => {
   298→    updateLastUsed({ panelMode: mode });
   299→  }, [updateLastUsed]);
   300→
   301→  // Computed LoRAs based on mode (replaces useEditModeLoRAs logic)
   302→  const loraMode = effectiveSettings.loraMode;
   303→  const customLoraUrl = effectiveSettings.customLoraUrl;
   304→  const editModeLoRAs = useMemo(() => {
   305→
   306→    switch (loraMode) {
   307→      case 'in-scene':
   308→        return [{ url: LORA_URLS['in-scene'], strength: 1.0 }];
   309→      case 'next-scene':
   310→        return [{ url: LORA_URLS['next-scene'], strength: 1.0 }];
   311→      case 'custom':
   312→        return customLoraUrl.trim()
   313→          ? [{ url: customLoraUrl.trim(), strength: 1.0 }]
   314→          : undefined;
   315→      case 'none':
   316→      default:
   317→        return undefined;
   318→    }
   319→  }, [loraMode, customLoraUrl]);
   320→
   321→  // Legacy compatibility
   322→  const isInSceneBoostEnabled = effectiveSettings.loraMode !== 'none';
   323→  const setIsInSceneBoostEnabled = (enabled: boolean) => {
   324→    setLoraMode(enabled ? 'in-scene' : 'none');
   325→  };
   326→
   327→  return {
   328→    // Current values (using effective settings to avoid race condition)
   329→    editMode: effectiveSettings.editMode,
   330→    loraMode: effectiveSettings.loraMode,
   331→    customLoraUrl: effectiveSettings.customLoraUrl,
   332→    numGenerations: effectiveSettings.numGenerations,
   333→    prompt: effectiveSettings.prompt,
   334→    // Img2Img values
   335→    img2imgPrompt: effectiveSettings.img2imgPrompt,

   339→    // Advanced settings (hires fix config)

   347→

   353→    setPrompt,
   354→    setQwenEditModel,
   355→    // Img2Img setters

   358→    setImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   359→    // Advanced settings setter
   360→    setAdvancedSettings,
   361→    // Video enhance settings setter

   363→    // Generation options setter

   365→
   366→    // Video/Panel mode (from "last used")
   367→    videoEditSubMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.videoEditSubMode,
   368→    panelMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.panelMode,
   369→    setVideoEditSubMode,

   378→
   379→    // State
   380→    isLoading: generationSettings.isLoading,
   381→    isReady,
   382→    hasPersistedSettings: generationSettings.hasPersistedSettings,
   383→  };
   384→}
   385→

     6→  collectUnhandledRejectionInfo,

    10→  parsePhoenixMessage,

    12→import {
    13→  installGlobalErrorPatchers,
    14→  installWebSocketProbe,
    15→  type InstrumentedWindow,
    16→} from './globalPatchers';
    17→
    18→function installCorruptionTracePatchers(instrumentedWindow: InstrumentedWindow): void {
    19→  installGlobalErrorPatchers({
    20→    instrumentedWindow,
    21→    onWindowError: (message, source, lineno, colno, error) => {
    22→      const errorInfo = collectWindowErrorInfo({
    23→        message,
    24→        source,
    25→        lineno,
    26→        colno,
    27→        error: error ?? null,
    28→      });
    29→
    30→      if (isKnownSupabaseSourceLine(source, lineno)) {
    31→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('[RealtimeCorruptionTrace] Supabase error captured'), {
    32→          context: 'WindowInstrumentation',
    33→          showToast: false,
    34→          logData: {
    35→            ...errorInfo,
    36→            realtimeSnapshot: captureRealtimeSnapshot(),
    37→            corruptionTimeline: [...__CORRUPTION_TIMELINE__],
    38→          },
    39→        });
    40→        addCorruptionEvent('SUPABASE_ERROR_2372', errorInfo);
    41→      } else if (isSupabaseRealtimeRelated(message)) {
    42→        addCorruptionEvent('RELATED_ERROR', errorInfo);
    43→      }
    44→    },
    45→    onUnhandledRejection: (event) => {
    46→      const rejectionInfo = collectUnhandledRejectionInfo(event);
    47→      if (isSupabaseRealtimeRelated(event.reason)) {
    48→        addCorruptionEvent('UNHANDLED_REJECTION', rejectionInfo);
    49→      }
    50→    },
    51→  });
    52→}
    53→
    54→function installWebSocketInstrumentation(instrumentedWindow: InstrumentedWindow): void {
    55→  installWebSocketProbe({
    56→    instrumentedWindow,
    57→    onTrackedSocketMessage: ({ event }) => {
    58→      try {
    59→        const parsed = parsePhoenixMessage(event.data);
    60→        if (parsed) {
    61→          addCorruptionEvent('PHOENIX_MESSAGE', parsed);
    62→        }
    63→
    64→        const snapshot = instrumentedWindow.__REALTIME_SNAPSHOT__ || {};
    65→        instrumentedWindow.__REALTIME_SNAPSHOT__ = {
    66→          ...snapshot,
    67→          lastPhoenixMsgAt: Date.now(),
    68→        };
    69→      } catch {
    70→        // Ignore instrumentation parse failures so realtime flow remains unaffected.
    71→      }
    72→    },
    73→  });
    74→}
    75→
    76→export function installWindowOnlyInstrumentation() {
    77→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    78→    return;
    79→  }
    80→
    81→  const instrumentedWindow = window as InstrumentedWindow;
    82→
    83→  if (__CORRUPTION_TRACE_ENABLED__) {

    85→  }
    86→
    87→  if (__WS_INSTRUMENTATION_ENABLED__) {
    88→    installWebSocketInstrumentation(instrumentedWindow);
    89→  }
    90→}

1→/**
     2→ * Canonical eligibility contract for "timeline-positioned images":
     3→ * - positioned frame (timeline_frame >= 0)
     4→ * - not a video media item
     5→ */
     6→
     7→const VIDEO_EXTENSIONS = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov'] as const;
     8→const VIDEO_TYPES = new Set(['video', 'video_travel_output']);
     9→
    10→export interface TimelineEligibilityInput {
    11→  timeline_frame?: number | null;
    12→  type?: string | null;
    13→  location?: string | null;
    14→  imageUrl?: string | null;
    15→  url?: string | null;
    16→  generation?: {
    17→    type?: string | null;
    18→    location?: string | null;
    19→  } | null;
    20→}
    21→
    22→export function hasTimelineVideoExtension(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
    23→  if (!url) return false;
    24→  const lower = url.toLowerCase();
    25→  return VIDEO_EXTENSIONS.some((ext) => lower.endsWith(ext));
    26→}
    27→
    28→export function isTimelineVideoType(type: string | null | undefined): boolean {
    29→  if (!type) return false;
    30→  return VIDEO_TYPES.has(type);
    31→}
    32→
    33→export function isTimelineVideoLike(input: Pick<TimelineEligibilityInput, 'type' | 'location' | 'imageUrl' | 'url' | 'generation'>): boolean {
    34→  if (isTimelineVideoType(input.type)) return true;
    35→  if (hasTimelineVideoExtension(input.location)) return true;
    36→  if (hasTimelineVideoExtension(input.imageUrl)) return true;
    37→  if (hasTimelineVideoExtension(input.url)) return true;
    38→  if (isTimelineVideoType(input.generation?.type)) return true;
    39→  if (hasTimelineVideoExtension(input.generation?.location)) return true;
    40→  return false;
    41→}
    42→
    43→export function hasPositionedTimelineFrame(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): boolean {
    44→  return timelineFrame != null && timelineFrame >= 0;
    45→}
    46→
    47→export function isTimelineEligiblePositionedImage(input: TimelineEligibilityInput): boolean {
    48→  if (!hasPositionedTimelineFrame(input.timeline_frame)) {
    49→    return false;
    50→  }
    51→  return !isTimelineVideoLike(input);
    52→}
    53→
    54→export function filterTimelineEligiblePositionedImages<T extends TimelineEligibilityInput>(
    55→  rows: T[],
    56→): T[] {
    57→  return rows.filter((row) => isTimelineEligiblePositionedImage(row));
    58→}
    59→

     5→type InvokeOptions = {
     6→  body?: unknown;
     7→  headers?: Record<string, string>;
     8→  timeoutMs?: number;
     9→  signal?: AbortSignal;
    10→};
    11→
    12→/**
    13→ * Calls a Supabase edge function with a client-side timeout and abort propagation.
    14→ * Reads the access token directly from localStorage to avoid navigator.locks contention.
    15→ * Ensures long-running invocations do not stall the UI indefinitely.
    16→ */
    17→export async function invokeWithTimeout<T = unknown>(functionName: string, options: InvokeOptions = {}): Promise<T> {
    18→  const { body, headers, timeoutMs = 20000, signal } = options;
    19→
    20→  const controller = new AbortController();
    21→  let didTimeout = false;
    22→  const signals: AbortSignal[] = [];
    23→  if (signal) signals.push(signal);
    24→  signals.push(controller.signal);
    25→
    26→  // Compose signals: abort if any provided signal aborts
    27→  const composed = new AbortController();
    28→  const onAbort = () => composed.abort();
    29→  signals.forEach(s => {
    30→    if (s.aborted) composed.abort();
    31→    else s.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    32→  });
    33→
    34→  const tid = setTimeout(() => {
    35→    didTimeout = true;
    36→    try { controller.abort(); } catch { /* intentionally ignored */ }
    37→  }, timeoutMs);
    38→
    39→  try {
    40→    const [REDACTED]();

    42→    const [REDACTED]();

    44→    const response = await fetch(url, {
    45→      method: 'POST',
    46→      headers: {
    47→        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    48→        Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken ?? anonKey}`,
    49→        apikey: anonKey,
    50→        ...(headers ?? {}),
    51→      },
    52→      body: body !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
    53→      signal: composed.signal,
    54→    });
    55→
    56→    if (!response.ok) {
    57→      const errorText = await response.text().catch(() => '');
    58→      throw new Error(errorText || `Function ${functionName} failed with status ${response.status}`);
    59→    }
    60→
    61→    const data = await response.json() as T;
    62→    return data;
    63→  } catch (err: unknown) {

    70→    throw err;
    71→  } finally {

1→/**
     2→ * useVideoEditModeHandlers Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Provides handlers for entering/exiting video edit modes.
     5→ * Separated from state management to allow proper hook ordering -
     6→ * state is defined early in component, handlers are defined after
     7→ * all dependencies (videoEditing, resetTrim, etc.) are available.
     8→ */
     9→
    10→import { useCallback } from 'react';
    11→
    12→export type VideoEditSubMode = 'trim' | 'replace' | 'regenerate' | 'enhance' | null;
    13→
    14→interface UseVideoEditModeHandlersProps {
    15→  /** Setter for video edit sub-mode (combines local state + persistence) */
    16→  setVideoEditSubMode: (mode: VideoEditSubMode) => void;
    17→  /** Persisted video edit sub-mode (for restoring on enter) */
    18→  persistedVideoEditSubMode: VideoEditSubMode | undefined;
    19→  /** Whether regenerate mode is available (has segment data) */
    20→  canRegenerate: boolean;
    21→  /** Setter to persist panel mode (edit/info) */
    22→  setPersistedPanelMode: (mode: 'edit' | 'info') => void;
    23→  /** Setter from videoEditing hook to toggle its internal mode */
    24→  videoEditingSetIsVideoEditMode: (value: boolean) => void;
    25→  /** Callback when trim mode changes */
    26→  onTrimModeChange?: (isTrimMode: boolean) => void;
    27→  /** Reset trim state */
    28→  resetTrim: () => void;
    29→  /** Set video duration for trim controls */
    30→  setVideoDuration: (duration: number) => void;
    31→}
    32→
    33→interface UseVideoEditModeHandlersReturn {
    34→  /** Enter video edit mode - restores last used sub-mode */
    35→  handleEnterVideoEditMode: () => void;
    36→  /** Exit video edit mode entirely */
    37→  handleExitVideoEditMode: () => void;
    38→  /** Switch to trim sub-mode */
    39→  handleEnterVideoTrimMode: () => void;
    40→  /** Switch to replace (portion) sub-mode */
    41→  handleEnterVideoReplaceMode: () => void;
    42→  /** Switch to regenerate (full segment) sub-mode */
    43→  handleEnterVideoRegenerateMode: () => void;
    44→  /** Switch to enhance (interpolation/upscale) sub-mode */
    45→  handleEnterVideoEnhanceMode: () => void;
    46→  /** Legacy handler for exiting trim mode specifically */
    47→  handleExitVideoTrimMode: () => void;
    48→}
    49→
    50→/**
    51→ * Hook providing handlers for video edit mode transitions.
    52→ * Call this after videoEditing and useVideoTrimming hooks are initialized.
    53→ */
    54→export function useVideoEditModeHandlers({
    55→  setVideoEditSubMode,
    56→  persistedVideoEditSubMode,
    57→  canRegenerate,
    58→  setPersistedPanelMode,
    59→  videoEditingSetIsVideoEditMode,
    60→  onTrimModeChange,
    61→  resetTrim,
    62→  setVideoDuration,
    63→}: UseVideoEditModeHandlersProps): UseVideoEditModeHandlersReturn {
    64→
    65→  // Helper to capture video duration from DOM
    66→  const captureVideoDuration = useCallback(() => {
    67→    setTimeout(() => {
    68→      const videoElements = document.querySelectorAll('video');
    69→      videoElements.forEach((video) => {
    70→        if (Number.isFinite(video.duration) && video.duration > 0) {
    71→          setVideoDuration(video.duration);
    72→        }
    73→      });
    74→    }, 100);
    75→  }, [setVideoDuration]);
    76→
    77→  // Handle entering video edit mode (unified) - restores last used sub-mode
    78→  const handleEnterVideoEditMode = useCallback(() => {
    79→    // Restore from persisted value (defaults to 'trim' if not set)
    80→    let restoredMode: VideoEditSubMode = persistedVideoEditSubMode || 'trim';
    81→
    82→    // Auto-fallback: if restoring to 'regenerate' but it's not available, use 'trim' instead
    83→    if (restoredMode === 'regenerate' && !canRegenerate) {
    84→      restoredMode = 'trim';
    85→    }
    86→
    87→    setVideoEditSubMode(restoredMode);
    88→    setPersistedPanelMode('edit');
    89→
    90→    // Set the appropriate mode flags based on restored sub-mode
    91→    if (restoredMode === 'trim') {
    92→      videoEditingSetIsVideoEditMode(false);
    93→      onTrimModeChange?.(true);
    94→    } else if (restoredMode === 'replace') {
    95→      videoEditingSetIsVideoEditMode(true);
    96→      resetTrim();
    97→    } else if (restoredMode === 'regenerate') {
    98→      videoEditingSetIsVideoEditMode(false);
    99→      resetTrim();
   100→    } else if (restoredMode === 'enhance') {
   101→      videoEditingSetIsVideoEditMode(false);
   102→      resetTrim();
   103→    }
   104→
   105→    // Try to capture video duration from already-loaded video element
   106→    captureVideoDuration();
   107→  }, [
   108→    persistedVideoEditSubMode,
   109→    canRegenerate,
   110→    setVideoEditSubMode,
   111→    setPersistedPanelMode,
   112→    videoEditingSetIsVideoEditMode,
   113→    onTrimModeChange,
   114→    resetTrim,
   115→    captureVideoDuration,
   116→  ]);
   117→
   118→  // Handle exiting video edit mode entirely
   119→  const handleExitVideoEditMode = useCallback(() => {
   120→    setVideoEditSubMode(null);
   121→    setPersistedPanelMode('info');
   122→    resetTrim();
   123→    videoEditingSetIsVideoEditMode(false);
   124→    onTrimModeChange?.(false);
   125→  }, [setVideoEditSubMode, setPersistedPanelMode, resetTrim, videoEditingSetIsVideoEditMode, onTrimModeChange]);
   126→
   127→  // Handle switching to trim sub-mode
   128→  const handleEnterVideoTrimMode = useCallback(() => {
   129→    setVideoEditSubMode('trim');
   130→    videoEditingSetIsVideoEditMode(false);
   131→    onTrimModeChange?.(true);
   132→
   133→    // Try to capture video duration
   134→    captureVideoDuration();
   135→  }, [setVideoEditSubMode, videoEditingSetIsVideoEditMode, onTrimModeChange, captureVideoDuration]);
   136→
   137→  // Handle switching to replace (portion) sub-mode
   138→  const handleEnterVideoReplaceMode = useCallback(() => {
   139→    setVideoEditSubMode('replace');
   140→    videoEditingSetIsVideoEditMode(true);
   141→    resetTrim();
   142→  }, [setVideoEditSubMode, videoEditingSetIsVideoEditMode, resetTrim]);
   143→
   144→  // Handle switching to regenerate (full segment) sub-mode
   145→  const handleEnterVideoRegenerateMode = useCallback(() => {
   146→    setVideoEditSubMode('regenerate');
   147→    videoEditingSetIsVideoEditMode(false);
   148→    resetTrim();
   149→  }, [setVideoEditSubMode, videoEditingSetIsVideoEditMode, resetTrim]);
   150→
   151→  // Handle switching to enhance (interpolation/upscale) sub-mode
   152→  const handleEnterVideoEnhanceMode = useCallback(() => {
   153→    setVideoEditSubMode('enhance');
   154→    videoEditingSetIsVideoEditMode(false);
   155→    resetTrim();
   156→  }, [setVideoEditSubMode, videoEditingSetIsVideoEditMode, resetTrim]);
   157→
   158→  // Legacy handler for exiting trim mode specifically
   159→  const handleExitVideoTrimMode = useCallback(() => {
   160→    setVideoEditSubMode(null);
   161→    resetTrim();
   162→    onTrimModeChange?.(false);
   163→  }, [setVideoEditSubMode, resetTrim, onTrimModeChange]);
   164→
   165→  return {
   166→    handleEnterVideoEditMode,
   167→    handleExitVideoEditMode,
   168→    handleEnterVideoTrimMode,
   169→    handleEnterVideoReplaceMode,
   170→    handleEnterVideoRegenerateMode,
   171→    handleEnterVideoEnhanceMode,
   172→    handleExitVideoTrimMode,
   173→  };
   174→}

    11→// WHY THIS EXISTS (instead of React Query):
    12→// This hook reads a single key from `users.settings.ui`, but many instances
    13→// mount concurrently for different keys (generationMethods, privacyDefaults,

    15→// `SELECT settings FROM users WHERE id = ?` query.
    16→//
    17→// WHY NOT React Query: The hook's read path has complex per-key logic
    18→// (fallback merging, normalization, auto-backfill of missing DB fields)
    19→// that runs after fetching the raw settings row. Migrating to React Query
    20→// would require either (a) a single shared query that all instances subscribe
    21→// to (losing per-key granularity for loading/error states), or (b) per-key
    22→// queries that each fetch the same row (defeating deduplication). The current
    23→// approach deduplicates at the network layer while keeping per-key logic local.
    24→//
    25→// WRITES already go through useToolSettings' global write queue, so there is

   111→async function cancelPendingTasks(projectId: string): Promise<CancelAllPendingTasksResponse> {
   112→  // First, get all pending tasks to check for orchestrators
   113→  const { data: pendingTasks, error: fetchError } = await supabase().from('tasks')
   114→    .select('id, task_type')
   115→    .eq('project_id', projectId)
   116→    .in('status', ['Queued']);
   117→
   118→  if (fetchError) {
   119→    throw new Error(`Failed to fetch pending tasks: ${fetchError.message}`);
   120→  }
   121→
   122→  // Collect all task IDs to cancel (including subtasks)
   123→  const tasksToCancel = new Set<string>();
   124→
   125→  // Add all pending tasks
   126→  pendingTasks?.forEach(task => tasksToCancel.add(task.id));
   127→
   128→  // Find orchestrator tasks
   129→  const orchestratorIds = pendingTasks
   130→    ?.filter(task => task.task_type?.includes('orchestrator'))
   131→    .map(task => task.id) || [];
   132→
   133→  // If there are orchestrators, find their subtasks
   134→  if (orchestratorIds.length > 0) {
   135→    const { data: allProjectTasks, error: allTasksError } = await supabase().from('tasks')
   136→      .select('id, params')
   137→      .eq('project_id', projectId)
   138→      .in('status', ['Queued']);
   139→
   140→    if (!allTasksError && allProjectTasks) {
   141→      allProjectTasks.forEach(task => {
   142→        const params = task.params as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   143→        const orchestratorRef = params?.orchestrator_task_id_ref || params?.orchestrator_task_id;
   144→
   145→        if (typeof orchestratorRef === 'string' && orchestratorIds.includes(orchestratorRef)) {
   146→          tasksToCancel.add(task.id);
   147→        }
   148→      });
   149→    }
   150→  }
   151→
   152→  // Cancel all collected tasks
   153→  const taskIdsArray = Array.from(tasksToCancel);
   154→
   155→  if (taskIdsArray.length > 0) {
   156→    const { error: cancelError } = await supabase().from('tasks')
   157→      .update({
   158→        status: 'Cancelled',
   159→        updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
   160→      })
   161→      .in('id', taskIdsArray);
   162→
   163→    if (cancelError) {
   164→      throw new Error(`Failed to cancel tasks: ${cancelError.message}`);
   165→    }
   166→  }
   167→
   168→  return {
   169→    cancelledCount: taskIdsArray.length,
   170→    message: `${taskIdsArray.length} tasks cancelled (including subtasks)`,
   171→  };
   172→}
   173→
   174→// Hook to cancel pending tasks using Supabase

     2→ * Centralized task configuration system
     3→ * 
     4→ * This module provides synchronous access to task type configuration.

     9→import { getTaskTypeConfigCache, isTaskTypeConfigCacheInitialized, type TaskTypeInfo } from '@/shared/hooks/tasks/useTaskType';
    10→import {

    14→
    15→interface TaskTypeConfig {
    16→  /** Whether this task type should be visible in the UI */
    17→  isVisible: boolean;
    18→  /** Display name for the task type (overrides the raw taskType) */
    19→  displayName?: string;
    20→  /** Whether this task type supports progress checking */
    21→  supportsProgress?: boolean;
    22→  /** Whether this task type can be manually cancelled by users */
    23→  canCancel?: boolean;
    24→  /** Category for grouping related task types */
    25→  category?: 'generation' | 'processing' | 'orchestration' | 'utility';
    26→  /** Description for documentation/debugging */
    27→  description?: string;
    28→}
    29→
    30→/**
    31→ * Convert database TaskTypeInfo to TaskTypeConfig format
    32→ */
    33→function dbConfigToTaskConfig(dbConfig: TaskTypeInfo): TaskTypeConfig {
    34→  return {
    35→    isVisible: dbConfig.is_visible ?? false,
    36→    displayName: dbConfig.display_name,
    37→    supportsProgress: dbConfig.supports_progress ?? false,
    38→    canCancel: true, // Default all tasks to cancellable
    39→    category: dbConfig.category as TaskTypeConfig['category'],
    40→  };
    41→}
    42→
    43→/**
    44→ * Get configuration for a specific task type
    45→ * Checks the database cache first, falls back to hardcoded defaults
    46→ */
    47→function getTaskConfig(taskType: string): TaskTypeConfig {
    48→  // Check database cache first (populated by useAllTaskTypesConfig hook)
    49→  if (isTaskTypeConfigCacheInitialized()) {
    50→    const cache = getTaskTypeConfigCache();
    51→    const dbConfig = cache[taskType];
    52→    if (dbConfig) {
    53→      return dbConfigToTaskConfig(dbConfig);
    54→    }
    55→  }
    56→  
    57→  // Fall back to the shared fallback snapshot.
    58→  const fallbackConfig = getTaskTypeConfigFallback(taskType);
    59→  if (fallbackConfig) {
    60→    return fallbackConfig;
    61→  }
    62→  
    63→  // Default for completely unknown task types
    64→  return {
    65→    isVisible: false, // Default to hidden for unknown types
    66→    canCancel: true,
    67→    category: 'utility'
    68→  };
    69→}
    70→
    71→/**
    72→ * Check if a task type should be visible in the UI
    73→ */
    74→function isTaskVisible(taskType: string): boolean {

    81→export function getTaskDisplayName(taskType: string): string {

    89→export function taskSupportsProgress(taskType: string): boolean {

    95→ * Uses database cache if available, falls back to hardcoded list

    97→function getTaskTypesByVisibility(visible: boolean): string[] {
    98→  if (isTaskTypeConfigCacheInitialized()) {
    99→    const cache = getTaskTypeConfigCache();
   100→    return Object.entries(cache)
   101→      .filter(([_, config]) => visible ? config.is_visible : !config.is_visible)
   102→      .map(([taskType]) => taskType);
   103→  }
   104→
   105→  // Fall back to the versioned fallback snapshot.
   106→  return getTaskTypeFallbackEntries()
   107→    .filter(([_, config]) => visible ? config.isVisible : !config.isVisible)
   108→    .map(([taskType]) => taskType);
   109→}
   110→
   111→/**
   112→ * Get all visible task types
   113→ */
   114→export function getVisibleTaskTypes(): string[] {

1→/**
     2→ * Segment Settings Migration
     3→ *
     4→ * Format conversion between old/new/legacy metadata formats.
     5→ *
     6→ * Extracted from segmentSettingsUtils.ts to separate the migration/compatibility
     7→ * layer from the public API (presets, helpers, task params).
     8→ *
     9→ * Functions here handle:
    10→ * - Reading settings from variant/generation params (multiple legacy formats)
    11→ * - Building metadata updates (writing new format + cleaning old fields)
    12→ * - Converting between lora formats (legacy object, pair array, ActiveLora)
    13→ *
    14→ * The PairMetadata type defines ALL known metadata shapes (new, deprecated pair_*,
    15→ * and legacy user_overrides) so callers can type-check against any format.
    16→ */
    17→
    18→import type { PhaseConfig } from '@/shared/types/phaseConfig';
    19→import type { ActiveLora } from '@/shared/hooks/useLoraManager';
    20→import { writeSegmentOverrides, type SegmentOverrides, type LoraConfig } from '@/shared/lib/settingsMigration';
    21→import type { SegmentSettings } from './segmentSettingsUtils';
    22→import { stripModeFromPhaseConfig } from './segmentSettingsUtils';
    23→import type { LegacyPairMetadataFields } from './segmentSettingsMigrationLegacy';
    24→
    25→// =============================================================================
    26→// PAIR METADATA TYPE (all known metadata shapes)
    27→// =============================================================================
    28→
    29→/**
    30→ * PairMetadata defines the shape of shot_generations.metadata.
    31→ * Includes new format (segmentOverrides), deprecated pair_* fields,
    32→ * and legacy user_overrides for backward compatibility.
    33→ */
    34→export interface PairMetadata extends LegacyPairMetadataFields {
    35→  // NEW FORMAT: Segment overrides in nested structure
    36→  segmentOverrides?: {
    37→    prompt?: string;
    38→    negativePrompt?: string;
    39→    motionMode?: 'basic' | 'advanced';
    40→    amountOfMotion?: number; // 0-100 scale
    41→    phaseConfig?: PhaseConfig;
    42→    selectedPhasePresetId?: string | null;
    43→    loras?: Array<{ path: string; strength: number; id?: string; name?: string }>;
    44→    numFrames?: number;
    45→    randomSeed?: boolean;
    46→    seed?: number;
    47→  };

    49→  enhanced_prompt?: string;
