    51→
    52→// =============================================================================
    53→// LORA FORMAT CONVERTERS
    54→// =============================================================================
    55→
    56→/** Convert legacy loras format (Record<url, strength>) to ActiveLora[] */
    57→function legacyLorasToArray(lorasObj: Record<string, number>): ActiveLora[] {
    58→  return Object.entries(lorasObj).map(([url, strength]) => {
    59→    const filename = url.split('/').pop()?.replace('.safetensors', '') || url;
    60→    return {
    61→      id: url,
    62→      name: filename,
    63→      path: url,
    64→      strength: typeof strength === 'number' ? strength : 1.0,
    65→    };
    66→  });
    67→}
    68→
    69→/** Convert pair_loras format (Array<{path, strength}>) to ActiveLora[] */
    70→function pairLorasToArray(pairLoras: Array<{ path: string; strength: number }>): ActiveLora[] {
    71→  return pairLoras.map((lora) => {
    72→    const filename = lora.path.split('/').pop()?.replace('.safetensors', '') || lora.path;
    73→    return {
    74→      id: lora.path,
    75→      name: filename,
    76→      path: lora.path,
    77→      strength: lora.strength,
    78→    };
    79→  });
    80→}
    81→
    82→// =============================================================================
    83→// EXTRACT SETTINGS FROM PARAMS
    84→// =============================================================================
    85→
    86→/**
    87→ * Extract SegmentSettings from variant/generation params.
    88→ * Used to populate the form with settings from an existing generation.
    89→ *
    90→ * Handles multiple legacy formats:
    91→ * - Top-level fields (base_prompt, amount_of_motion, etc.)
    92→ * - Nested orchestrator_details
    93→ * - Legacy additional_loras (object format)
    94→ * - New loras (array format)
    95→ */
    96→export function extractSettingsFromParams(
    97→  params: Record<string, unknown>,
    98→  defaults?: Partial<SegmentSettings>
    99→): SegmentSettings {
   100→
   101→  // Handle nested orchestrator_details (common in task params)
   102→  const orchDetails = (params.orchestrator_details || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   103→
   104→  // Extract prompt: base_prompt > prompt > orchestrator > default
   105→  const prompt = (params.base_prompt ?? params.prompt ?? orchDetails.base_prompt ?? defaults?.prompt ?? '') as string;
   106→
   107→  // Extract negative prompt
   108→  const negativePrompt = (params.negative_prompt ?? orchDetails.negative_prompt ?? defaults?.negativePrompt ?? '') as string;
   109→
   110→  // Extract num_frames
   111→  const numFrames = (params.num_frames ?? orchDetails.num_frames ?? defaults?.numFrames ?? 25) as number;
   112→
   113→  // Extract seed/randomSeed
   114→  const randomSeed = (params.random_seed ?? orchDetails.random_seed ?? defaults?.randomSeed ?? true) as boolean;
   115→  const seed = (params.seed ?? orchDetails.seed ?? defaults?.seed) as number | undefined;
   116→
   117→  // Extract motion settings
   118→  const motionMode = (params.motion_mode ?? orchDetails.motion_mode ?? defaults?.motionMode ?? 'basic') as 'basic' | 'advanced';
   119→  const amountOfMotion = params.amount_of_motion != null
   120→    ? Math.round((params.amount_of_motion as number) * 100) // Convert 0-1 to 0-100
   121→    : (orchDetails.amount_of_motion != null
   122→        ? Math.round((orchDetails.amount_of_motion as number) * 100)
   123→        : (defaults?.amountOfMotion ?? 50));
   124→
   125→  // Extract phase config (only if advanced mode)
   126→  let phaseConfig: PhaseConfig | undefined = undefined;
   127→  if (motionMode === 'advanced') {
   128→    phaseConfig = (params.phase_config ?? orchDetails.phase_config ?? defaults?.phaseConfig) as PhaseConfig | undefined;

   131→    }
   132→  }
   133→
   134→  // Extract selected preset ID
   135→  const selectedPhasePresetId = (params.selected_phase_preset_id ?? orchDetails.selected_phase_preset_id ?? defaults?.selectedPhasePresetId ?? null) as string | null;
   136→

   138→  let loras: ActiveLora[] = [];

   144→  // Format 2: additional_loras object at top level (legacy)
   145→  else if (params.additional_loras && typeof params.additional_loras === 'object' && Object.keys(params.additional_loras as Record<string, unknown>).length > 0) {
   146→    loras = legacyLorasToArray(params.additional_loras as Record<string, number>);
   147→  }
   148→  // Format 3: in orchestrator_details (either format)
   149→  else if (Array.isArray(orchDetails.loras) && orchDetails.loras.length > 0) {
   150→    loras = pairLorasToArray(orchDetails.loras as Array<{ path: string; strength: number }>);
   151→  }
   152→  else if (orchDetails.additional_loras && typeof orchDetails.additional_loras === 'object' && Object.keys(orchDetails.additional_loras as Record<string, unknown>).length > 0) {
   153→    loras = legacyLorasToArray(orchDetails.additional_loras as Record<string, number>);
   154→  }
   155→  // Format 4: use defaults if provided
   156→  else if (defaults?.loras) {
   157→    loras = defaults.loras;
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  const result = {
   161→    prompt,
   162→    negativePrompt,
   163→    motionMode,
   164→    amountOfMotion,
   165→    phaseConfig,
   166→    selectedPhasePresetId,
   167→    loras,
   168→    numFrames,
   169→    randomSeed,
   170→    seed,
   171→    makePrimaryVariant: defaults?.makePrimaryVariant ?? false,
   172→  };
   173→
   174→  return result;
   175→}
   176→
   177→// =============================================================================
   178→// BUILD METADATA UPDATE
   179→// =============================================================================
   180→
   181→/**
   182→ * Settings to save to pair metadata.
   183→ * Convention:
   184→ *   undefined = don't touch this field
   185→ *   null = explicitly clear (for nullable fields)
   186→ *   '' = explicitly clear override (for string fields)
   187→ *   value = set the override
   188→ */
   189→interface PairSettingsToSave {
   190→  prompt?: string;
   191→  negativePrompt?: string;
   192→  textBeforePrompts?: string;
   193→  textAfterPrompts?: string;
   194→  motionMode?: 'basic' | 'advanced';
   195→  amountOfMotion?: number;
   196→  phaseConfig?: PhaseConfig | null; // null means clear
   197→  loras?: ActiveLora[];
   198→  // Video settings
   199→  numFrames?: number;
   200→  randomSeed?: boolean;
   201→  seed?: number;
   202→  // UI state
   203→  selectedPhasePresetId?: string | null;
   204→  // Structure video overrides
   205→  structureMotionStrength?: number;
   206→  structureTreatment?: 'adjust' | 'clip';
   207→  structureUni3cEndPercent?: number;
   208→}
   209→
   210→type TextOverrideKey = 'prompt' | 'negativePrompt' | 'textBeforePrompts' | 'textAfterPrompts';
   211→
   212→function setTextOverride(
   213→  overrides: SegmentOverrides,
   214→  fieldsToClear: (keyof SegmentOverrides)[],
   215→  key: TextOverrideKey,
   216→  value: string | undefined
   217→): void {
   218→  if (value === undefined) return;
   219→  if (value === '') {
   220→    fieldsToClear.push(key);
   221→    return;
   222→  }
   223→  overrides[key] = value;
   224→}
   225→
   226→function setNullableOverride<K extends keyof SegmentOverrides>(
   227→  overrides: SegmentOverrides,
   228→  fieldsToClear: K[],
   229→  key: K,
   230→  value: SegmentOverrides[K] | null | undefined
   231→): void {
   232→  if (value === undefined) return;
   233→  if (value === null) {
   234→    fieldsToClear.push(key);
   235→    return;
   236→  }
   237→  overrides[key] = value;
   238→}
   239→
   240→function applyPairSettingsToOverrides(
   241→  settings: PairSettingsToSave,
   242→  overrides: SegmentOverrides,
   243→  fieldsToClear: (keyof SegmentOverrides)[]
   244→): void {
   245→  setTextOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'prompt', settings.prompt);
   246→  setTextOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'negativePrompt', settings.negativePrompt);
   247→  setTextOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'textBeforePrompts', settings.textBeforePrompts);
   248→  setTextOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'textAfterPrompts', settings.textAfterPrompts);
   249→
   250→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'motionMode', settings.motionMode);
   251→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'amountOfMotion', settings.amountOfMotion);
   252→
   253→  if (settings.phaseConfig !== undefined) {
   254→    if (settings.phaseConfig === null) {
   255→      fieldsToClear.push('phaseConfig');
   256→    } else {
   257→      overrides.phaseConfig = stripModeFromPhaseConfig(settings.phaseConfig);
   258→    }
   259→  }
   260→
   261→  if (settings.loras !== undefined) {
   262→    if (settings.loras === null) {
   263→      fieldsToClear.push('loras');
   264→    } else {
   265→      overrides.loras = settings.loras.map((l): LoraConfig => ({
   266→        id: l.id,
   267→        name: l.name,
   268→        path: l.path,
   269→        strength: l.strength,
   270→      }));
   271→    }
   272→  }
   273→
   274→  if (settings.randomSeed !== undefined) {
   275→    overrides.randomSeed = settings.randomSeed;
   276→  }
   277→  if (settings.seed !== undefined) {
   278→    overrides.seed = settings.seed;
   279→  }
   280→
   281→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'selectedPhasePresetId', settings.selectedPhasePresetId);
   282→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'structureMotionStrength', settings.structureMotionStrength);
   283→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'structureTreatment', settings.structureTreatment);
   284→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'structureUni3cEndPercent', settings.structureUni3cEndPercent);
   285→}
   286→
   287→function clearFields(
   288→  target: Record<string, unknown>,
   289→  fields: string[]
   290→): void {
   291→  fields.forEach((field) => {
   292→    delete target[field];
   293→  });
   294→}
   295→
   296→function cleanupLegacyPairMetadata(
   297→  metadata: Record<string, unknown>,
   298→  settings: PairSettingsToSave
   299→): void {
   300→  if (settings.prompt !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_prompt;
   301→  if (settings.negativePrompt !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_negative_prompt;
   302→  if (settings.motionMode !== undefined || settings.amountOfMotion !== undefined) {
   303→    delete metadata.pair_motion_settings;
   304→  }
   305→  if (settings.phaseConfig !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_phase_config;
   306→  if (settings.loras !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_loras;
   307→  if (settings.randomSeed !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_random_seed;
   308→  if (settings.seed !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_seed;
   309→  if (settings.selectedPhasePresetId !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_selected_phase_preset_id;
   310→}
   311→
   312→function cleanupLegacyUserOverrides(
   313→  metadata: Record<string, unknown>,
   314→  settings: PairSettingsToSave
   315→): void {
   316→  const userOverrides = metadata.user_overrides as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   317→  if (!userOverrides) return;
   318→
   319→  if (settings.motionMode !== undefined) delete userOverrides.motion_mode;
   320→  if (settings.amountOfMotion !== undefined) delete userOverrides.amount_of_motion;
   321→  if (settings.phaseConfig !== undefined) delete userOverrides.phase_config;
   322→  if (settings.loras !== undefined) delete userOverrides.additional_loras;
   323→
   324→  if (Object.keys(userOverrides).length === 0) {
   325→    delete metadata.user_overrides;
   326→  }
   327→}
   328→
   329→/**
   330→ * Build metadata update payload for saving pair settings.
   331→ *
   332→ * Writes to the new segmentOverrides format and cleans up old pair_* and
   333→ * legacy user_overrides fields from the metadata.
   334→ */
   335→export function buildMetadataUpdate(
   336→  currentMetadata: Record<string, unknown>,
   337→  settings: PairSettingsToSave
   338→): Record<string, unknown> {
   339→  const overrides: SegmentOverrides = {};
   340→  const fieldsToClear: (keyof SegmentOverrides)[] = [];
   341→  applyPairSettingsToOverrides(settings, overrides, fieldsToClear);
   342→
   343→  // Use writeSegmentOverrides to write to new format
   344→  const newMetadata = writeSegmentOverrides(currentMetadata, overrides);
   345→
   346→  // Access segmentOverrides as a mutable record for cleanup operations
   347→  const segOverrides = newMetadata.segmentOverrides as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   348→
   349→  // Handle explicit clear of phaseConfig (when switching to basic mode)
   350→  if (settings.phaseConfig === null && segOverrides) {
   351→    delete segOverrides.phaseConfig;
   352→    // Note: selectedPhasePresetId is handled independently via fieldsToClear.
   353→    // Don't cascade-delete it here — basic mode presets need to persist.
   354→  }
   355→
   356→  // Handle explicitly cleared fields ('' or null means remove override, use shot default)
   357→  if (fieldsToClear.length > 0 && segOverrides) {
   358→    clearFields(segOverrides, fieldsToClear as string[]);
   359→  }
   360→
   361→  cleanupLegacyPairMetadata(newMetadata, settings);
   362→  cleanupLegacyUserOverrides(newMetadata, settings);
   363→
   364→  return newMetadata;
   365→}
   366→

1→/**
     2→ * usePairMetadata - Query hook for segment pair metadata
     3→ *
     4→ * Fetches metadata from shot_generations table for a specific pair.
     5→ * This includes segment overrides, enhanced prompts, and other pair-level data.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     9→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    10→import { segmentQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/segments';
    11→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    12→import type { PairMetadata } from '@/shared/components/SegmentSettingsForm/segmentSettingsMigration';
    13→
    14→interface UsePairMetadataReturn {
    15→  data: PairMetadata | null | undefined;
    16→  isLoading: boolean;
    17→  error: Error | null;
    18→  refetch: () => Promise<unknown>;
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function usePairMetadata(
    22→  pairShotGenerationId: string | null | undefined
    23→): UsePairMetadataReturn {
    24→  const query = useQuery({
    25→    [REDACTED](pairShotGenerationId || ''),
    26→    queryFn: async (): Promise<PairMetadata | null> => {
    27→      if (!pairShotGenerationId) return null;
    28→
    29→      const { data, error } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    30→        .select('metadata')
    31→        .eq('id', pairShotGenerationId)
    32→        .single();
    33→
    34→      if (error) {
    35→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    36→          context: 'usePairMetadata.fetch',
    37→          showToast: false,
    38→          logData: { pairShotGenerationId },
    39→        });
    40→        throw error;
    41→      }
    42→
    43→      return (data?.metadata as PairMetadata) || null;
    44→    },
    45→    enabled: !!pairShotGenerationId,
    46→    staleTime: 10000,
    47→  });
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    data: query.data,
    51→    isLoading: query.isLoading,
    52→    error: query.error,
    53→    refetch: query.refetch,
    54→  };

1→/**
     2→ * useSegmentSettings - Composed hook for segment settings management
     3→ *
     4→ * Manages segment settings for video regeneration with:
     5→ * - Data fetching (pair metadata, shot settings)
     6→ * - Local editing with auto-save
     7→ * - Settings merging (segment overrides > shot defaults)
     8→ * - Override tracking
     9→ * - Persistence operations
    10→ *
    11→ * This hook composes:
    12→ * - usePairMetadata (query)
    13→ * - useShotVideoSettings (query)
    14→ * - useSegmentMutations (mutations)
    15→ * - useServerForm (local state + auto-save)
    16→ *
    17→ * @example
    18→ * ```tsx
    19→ * const { settings, updateSettings, saveSettings, isDirty } = useSegmentSettings({
    20→ *   pairShotGenerationId,
    21→ *   shotId,
    22→ *   defaults: { prompt: '', negativePrompt: '', numFrames: 25 },
    23→ * });
    24→ * ```
    25→ */
    26→
    27→import { useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
    28→import { useServerForm } from '../useServerForm';
    29→import { usePairMetadata } from './usePairMetadata';
    30→import { useShotVideoSettings } from './useShotVideoSettings';
    31→import { useSegmentMutations } from './useSegmentMutations';

    37→// =============================================================================

    41→/**
    42→ * Segment settings with nullable fields for "clear override" semantics.
    43→ *
    44→ * When a field is `null`, it means "remove the segment-level override and
    45→ * inherit from shot defaults". This is used by `createClearedSettings` and
    46→ * consumed by `buildMetadataUpdate` which interprets null as "delete this key".

    53→
    54→export interface UseSegmentSettingsOptions {

    82→/** Tracks which fields have pair-level overrides */

    95→  structureUni3cEndPercent: boolean;
    96→}
    97→
    98→/** Shot-level default values (for showing as placeholder) */
    99→interface ShotDefaults {
   100→  prompt: string;
   101→  negativePrompt: string;
   102→  motionMode: 'basic' | 'advanced';
   103→  amountOfMotion: number;
   104→  phaseConfig?: import('@/shared/types/phaseConfig').PhaseConfig;
   105→  loras: import('@/shared/types/segmentSettings').LoraConfig[];
   106→  selectedPhasePresetId: string | null;
   107→  textBeforePrompts: string;
   108→  textAfterPrompts: string;
   109→}
   110→
   111→interface UseSegmentSettingsReturn {
   112→  /** Current settings (merged from all sources + user edits) */
   113→  settings: SegmentSettings;
   114→  /** Update settings (local state only) */
   115→  updateSettings: (updates: Partial<SegmentSettings>) => void;
   116→  /** Save current settings to database */

   118→  /** Reset to merged defaults (discards local edits) */

   122→  /** Save a single field's current value as shot default */
   123→  saveFieldAsDefault: (field: keyof SegmentSettings, value: unknown) => Promise<boolean>;
   124→  /** Get effective settings for task creation (settings merged with shot defaults) */
   125→  getSettingsForTaskCreation: () => SegmentSettings;
   126→  /** Whether data is still loading */

   131→  pairMetadata: PairMetadata | null;
   132→  /** Raw shot batch settings (for debugging) */
   133→  shotBatchSettings: ShotBatchSettings | null;
   134→  /** Which fields have pair-level overrides */

   136→  /** Shot-level default values (for showing as placeholder) */

   149→
   150→// =============================================================================
   151→// HELPER FUNCTIONS
   152→// =============================================================================
   153→
   154→/**
   155→ * Detect which fields have segment-level overrides.
   156→ */
   157→function detectOverrides(
   158→  pairMetadata: PairMetadata | null | undefined,
   159→  localData: Partial<SegmentSettings> | null,
   160→  isLoading: boolean
   161→): FieldOverrides | undefined {
   162→  if (isLoading) return undefined;
   163→
   164→  const pairOverrides = readSegmentOverrides(pairMetadata as Record<string, unknown> | null);
   165→
   166→  const hasFieldOverride = (field: string): boolean => {
   167→    // Check local state first (for immediate UI feedback)
   168→    if (localData !== null && field in localData) {
   169→      return (localData as Record<string, unknown>)[field] !== undefined;
   170→    }
   171→    // Fall back to DB state
   172→    return (pairOverrides as Record<string, unknown>)[field] !== undefined;
   173→  };
   174→
   175→  return {
   176→    prompt: hasFieldOverride('prompt'),
   177→    negativePrompt: hasFieldOverride('negativePrompt'),
   178→    textBeforePrompts: hasFieldOverride('textBeforePrompts'),
   179→    textAfterPrompts: hasFieldOverride('textAfterPrompts'),
   180→    motionMode: hasFieldOverride('motionMode'),
   181→    amountOfMotion: hasFieldOverride('amountOfMotion'),
   182→    phaseConfig: hasFieldOverride('phaseConfig'),
   183→    loras: hasFieldOverride('loras'),
   184→    selectedPhasePresetId: hasFieldOverride('selectedPhasePresetId'),
   185→    structureMotionStrength: hasFieldOverride('structureMotionStrength'),
   186→    structureTreatment: hasFieldOverride('structureTreatment'),
   187→    structureUni3cEndPercent: hasFieldOverride('structureUni3cEndPercent'),
   188→  };
   189→}
   190→
   191→/**
   192→ * Build merged settings from segment overrides only.
   193→ * Returns settings with undefined for fields without overrides.
   194→ */
   195→function buildMergedSettings(
   196→  pairMetadata: PairMetadata | null | undefined,
   197→  defaults: UseSegmentSettingsOptions['defaults']
   198→): SegmentSettings {
   199→  const pairOverrides = readSegmentOverrides(pairMetadata as Record<string, unknown> | null);
   200→
   201→  return {
   202→    prompt: pairOverrides.prompt,
   203→    negativePrompt: pairOverrides.negativePrompt,
   204→    textBeforePrompts: pairOverrides.textBeforePrompts,
   205→    textAfterPrompts: pairOverrides.textAfterPrompts,
   206→    motionMode: pairOverrides.motionMode as 'basic' | 'advanced' | undefined,
   207→    amountOfMotion: pairOverrides.amountOfMotion,
   208→    phaseConfig: pairOverrides.phaseConfig,
   209→    selectedPhasePresetId: pairOverrides.selectedPhasePresetId,
   210→    loras: pairOverrides.loras,
   211→    numFrames: defaults.numFrames ?? 25,
   212→    randomSeed: pairOverrides.randomSeed ?? true,
   213→    seed: pairOverrides.seed,
   214→    makePrimaryVariant: defaults.makePrimaryVariant ?? true,
   215→    structureMotionStrength: pairOverrides.structureMotionStrength,
   216→    structureTreatment: pairOverrides.structureTreatment,
   217→    structureUni3cEndPercent: pairOverrides.structureUni3cEndPercent,
   218→  } as SegmentSettings;
   219→}
   220→
   221→/**
   222→ * Build shot defaults object for display.
   223→ */
   224→function buildShotDefaults(shotSettings: ShotVideoSettings | null | undefined): ShotDefaults {
   225→  return {
   226→    prompt: shotSettings?.prompt || '',
   227→    negativePrompt: shotSettings?.negativePrompt || '',
   228→    motionMode: shotSettings?.motionMode || 'basic',
   229→    amountOfMotion: shotSettings?.amountOfMotion ?? 50,
   230→    phaseConfig: shotSettings?.phaseConfig,
   231→    loras: shotSettings?.loras || [],
   232→    selectedPhasePresetId: shotSettings?.selectedPhasePresetId ?? null,
   233→    textBeforePrompts: shotSettings?.textBeforePrompts || '',
   234→    textAfterPrompts: shotSettings?.textAfterPrompts || '',
   235→  };
   236→}
   237→
   238→/**
   239→ * Create cleared settings for reset operation.
   240→ *
   241→ * Returns settings with nullable fields where `null` means "clear the override
   242→ * and inherit from shot defaults". The form's saveData and buildMetadataUpdate
   243→ * handle null values by removing the corresponding keys from storage.
   244→ */
   245→function createClearedSettings(
   246→  numFrames: number,
   247→  makePrimaryVariant: boolean
   248→): ClearableSegmentSettings {
   249→  return {
   250→    prompt: '',
   251→    negativePrompt: '',
   252→    textBeforePrompts: '',
   253→    textAfterPrompts: '',
   254→    motionMode: null,
   255→    amountOfMotion: null,
   256→    phaseConfig: null,
   257→    selectedPhasePresetId: null,
   258→    loras: null,
   259→    numFrames,
   260→    randomSeed: true,
   261→    seed: null,
   262→    makePrimaryVariant,
   263→    structureMotionStrength: null,
   264→    structureTreatment: null,
   265→    structureUni3cEndPercent: null,
   266→  };
   267→}
   268→
   269→// =============================================================================
   270→// MAIN HOOK
   271→// =============================================================================
   272→
   273→export function useSegmentSettings({
   274→  pairShotGenerationId,
   275→  shotId,
   276→  defaults,
   277→  structureVideoDefaults,
   278→  onUpdateStructureVideoDefaults,
   279→}: UseSegmentSettingsOptions): UseSegmentSettingsReturn {
   280→  // 1. Fetch server data
   281→  const { data: pairMetadata, isLoading: loadingPair } = usePairMetadata(pairShotGenerationId);
   282→  const { data: shotVideoSettings, isLoading: loadingShot } = useShotVideoSettings(shotId);
   283→
   284→  // 2. Get mutations
   285→  const mutations = useSegmentMutations({ pairShotGenerationId, shotId });
   286→
   287→  // 3. Compute merged settings from server data
   288→  const mergedSettings = useMemo(
   289→    () => buildMergedSettings(pairMetadata, defaults),
   290→    [pairMetadata, defaults]
   291→  );
   292→
   293→  // 4. Shot defaults for placeholders
   294→  const shotDefaults = useMemo(
   295→    () => buildShotDefaults(shotVideoSettings),
   296→    [shotVideoSettings]
   297→  );
   298→
   299→  // 5. Use server form pattern for local edits + auto-save
   300→  const form = useServerForm({
   301→    serverData: mergedSettings,
   302→    isLoading: loadingPair || loadingShot,
   303→    toLocal: (server) => server,
   304→    save: mutations.savePairMetadata,
   305→    autoSaveMs: 500,
   306→    [REDACTED] || undefined,
   307→    validate: (updates, current) => {
   308→      // Enforce: basic mode without a preset = no phase config.
   309→      // When a preset IS selected, its phaseConfig must be preserved.
   310→      if (updates.motionMode === 'basic') {
   311→        const hasPreset = updates.selectedPhasePresetId ?? current.selectedPhasePresetId;
   312→        if (!hasPreset) {
   313→          return { ...updates, phaseConfig: undefined };
   314→        }
   315→      }
   316→      return updates;
   317→    },
   318→  });
   319→
   320→  // 6. Compute overrides (considering local state for immediate UI feedback)
   321→  const hasOverride = useMemo(
   322→    () => detectOverrides(pairMetadata, form.localData, loadingPair),
   323→    [pairMetadata, form.localData, loadingPair]
   324→  );
   325→
   326→  // 7. Reset settings (clear all overrides)
   327→  const resetSettings = useCallback(async () => {
   328→    const cleared = createClearedSettings(
   329→      defaults.numFrames ?? 25,
   330→      defaults.makePrimaryVariant ?? true
   331→    );
   332→
   333→    // Save cleared settings, then clear enhanced prompt.
   334→    // ClearableSegmentSettings uses null to indicate "clear override" - the save
   335→    // function interprets nulls correctly via buildMetadataUpdate.
   336→    await form.saveData(cleared as SegmentSettings);
   337→    await mutations.clearEnhancedPrompt();
   338→    form.reset();
   339→  }, [form, mutations, defaults]);
   340→
   341→  // 8. Get effective settings for task creation (merges with shot defaults)
   342→  const getSettingsForTaskCreation = useCallback((): SegmentSettings => {
   343→    const currentSettings = form.data;
   344→    return {
   345→      prompt: currentSettings.prompt ?? shotDefaults.prompt,
   346→      negativePrompt: currentSettings.negativePrompt ?? shotDefaults.negativePrompt,
   347→      textBeforePrompts: currentSettings.textBeforePrompts ?? shotDefaults.textBeforePrompts,
   348→      textAfterPrompts: currentSettings.textAfterPrompts ?? shotDefaults.textAfterPrompts,
   349→      motionMode: currentSettings.motionMode ?? shotDefaults.motionMode,
   350→      amountOfMotion: currentSettings.amountOfMotion ?? shotDefaults.amountOfMotion,
   351→      phaseConfig: currentSettings.phaseConfig ?? shotDefaults.phaseConfig,
   352→      selectedPhasePresetId: currentSettings.selectedPhasePresetId ?? shotDefaults.selectedPhasePresetId,
   353→      loras: currentSettings.loras ?? shotDefaults.loras,
   354→      numFrames: currentSettings.numFrames,
   355→      randomSeed: currentSettings.randomSeed,
   356→      seed: currentSettings.seed,
   357→      makePrimaryVariant: currentSettings.makePrimaryVariant,
   358→      structureMotionStrength: currentSettings.structureMotionStrength,
   359→      structureTreatment: currentSettings.structureTreatment,
   360→      structureUni3cEndPercent: currentSettings.structureUni3cEndPercent,
   361→    };
   362→  }, [form.data, shotDefaults]);
   363→
   364→  // 9. Save as shot defaults with structure video handling
   365→  const saveAsShotDefaults = useCallback(async (): Promise<boolean> => {
   366→    const result = await mutations.saveAsShotDefaults(form.data, shotDefaults);
   367→
   368→    if (result && onUpdateStructureVideoDefaults) {
   369→      const hasStructureOverrides =
   370→        form.data.structureMotionStrength !== undefined ||
   371→        form.data.structureTreatment !== undefined ||
   372→        form.data.structureUni3cEndPercent !== undefined;
   373→
   374→      if (hasStructureOverrides) {
   375→        await onUpdateStructureVideoDefaults({
   376→          motionStrength:
   377→            form.data.structureMotionStrength ?? structureVideoDefaults?.motionStrength,
   378→          treatment: form.data.structureTreatment ?? structureVideoDefaults?.treatment,
   379→          uni3cEndPercent:
   380→            form.data.structureUni3cEndPercent ?? structureVideoDefaults?.uni3cEndPercent,
   381→        });
   382→
   383→        // Clear structure overrides from segment
   384→        form.update({
   385→          structureMotionStrength: undefined,
   386→          structureTreatment: undefined,
   387→          structureUni3cEndPercent: undefined,
   388→        });
   389→      }
   390→    }
   391→
   392→    return result;
   393→  }, [form, mutations, shotDefaults, onUpdateStructureVideoDefaults, structureVideoDefaults]);
   394→
   395→  // 9. Extract enhanced prompt from metadata
   396→  const enhancedPrompt =
   397→    ((pairMetadata as Record<string, unknown> | null)?.enhanced_prompt as string)?.trim() ||
   398→    undefined;
   399→  const basePromptForEnhancement =
   400→    ((pairMetadata as Record<string, unknown> | null)?.base_prompt_for_enhancement as string)?.trim() ||
   401→    undefined;
   402→  const enhancePromptEnabled = (pairMetadata as Record<string, unknown> | null)
   403→    ?.enhance_prompt_enabled as boolean | undefined;
   404→
   405→  // 10. Convert shot settings to legacy ShotBatchSettings format for compatibility
   406→  const shotBatchSettings = useMemo((): ShotBatchSettings | null => {
   407→    if (!shotVideoSettings) return null;
   408→    return {
   409→      amountOfMotion: shotVideoSettings.amountOfMotion / 100,
   410→      motionMode: shotVideoSettings.motionMode,
   411→      selectedLoras: shotVideoSettings.loras,
   412→      phaseConfig: shotVideoSettings.phaseConfig,
   413→      prompt: shotVideoSettings.prompt,
   414→      negativePrompt: shotVideoSettings.negativePrompt,
   415→    };
   416→  }, [shotVideoSettings]);
   417→
   418→  return {
   419→    // Form state
   420→    settings: form.data,
   421→    updateSettings: form.update,
   422→    saveSettings: form.save,
   423→    resetSettings,
   424→    isDirty: form.isDirty,
   425→    isLoading: form.isLoading,
   426→
   427→    // Override tracking
   428→    hasOverride,
   429→    shotDefaults,
   430→
   431→    // Shot-level operations
   432→    saveAsShotDefaults,
   433→    saveFieldAsDefault: mutations.saveFieldAsDefault,
   434→
   435→    // Task creation
   436→    getSettingsForTaskCreation,
   437→
   438→    // Enhanced prompt
   439→    enhancedPrompt,
   440→    basePromptForEnhancement,
   441→    clearEnhancedPrompt: mutations.clearEnhancedPrompt,
   442→    enhancePromptEnabled,
   443→    saveEnhancePromptEnabled: mutations.saveEnhancePromptEnabled,
   444→
   445→    // For debugging/compatibility
   446→    pairMetadata: pairMetadata ?? null,
   447→    shotBatchSettings,
   448→  };
   449→}

    43→function migrateLoraConfig(lora: Record<string, unknown>): LoraConfig {
    44→  return {
    45→    id: (lora.id as string) ?? (lora.path as string) ?? '',
    46→    name: (lora.name as string) ?? '',
    47→    path: (lora.path as string) ?? '',

    56→/**

    59→function migrateLoras(loras: Record<string, unknown>[] | undefined | null): LoraConfig[] {

## Thorough Analysis of PairMetadata and LegacyPairMetadataFields

Based on my comprehensive search of the codebase, here's what you need to know about the deprecated pattern:

### 1. **Type Definitions**

**PairMetadata** (defined in `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/SegmentSettingsForm/segmentSettingsMigration.ts` at line 34):
```typescript
export interface PairMetadata extends LegacyPairMetadataFields {
  // NEW FORMAT: Segment overrides in nested structure
  segmentOverrides?: {
    prompt?: string;
    negativePrompt?: string;
    motionMode?: 'basic' | 'advanced';
    amountOfMotion?: number; // 0-100 scale
    phaseConfig?: PhaseConfig;
    selectedPhasePresetId?: string | null;
    loras?: Array<{ path: string; strength: number; id?: string; name?: string }>;
    numFrames?: number;
    randomSeed?: boolean;
    seed?: number;
  };
  // AI-generated prompt (not user settings, kept separate)
  enhanced_prompt?: string;
}
```

**LegacyPairMetadataFields** (defined in `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/SegmentSettingsForm/segmentSettingsMigrationLegacy.ts`):
```typescript
export interface LegacyPairMetadataFields {
  pair_prompt?: string;
  pair_negative_prompt?: string;
  pair_phase_config?: PhaseConfig;
  pair_motion_settings?: {
    motion_mode?: 'basic' | 'advanced';
    amount_of_motion?: number;
  };
  pair_loras?: Array<{ path: string; strength: number }>;
  pair_num_frames?: number;
  pair_random_seed?: boolean;
  pair_seed?: number;
  pair_selected_phase_preset_id?: string | null;
  user_overrides?: {
    phase_config?: PhaseConfig;
    motion_mode?: 'basic' | 'advanced';
    amount_of_motion?: number;
    additional_loras?: Record<string, number>;
    [key: string]: unknown;
  };
}
```

### 2. **What is the Deprecated Pattern?**

**The Pattern**: `PairMetadata extends LegacyPairMetadataFields`

**Why It Exists**: The codebase has three metadata format generations:
- **Legacy** (`user_overrides`): Very old format, barely used anymore
- **Deprecated pair_*** fields: Mid-generation format (pair_prompt, pair_loras, etc.)
- **New format** (`segmentOverrides`): Current standard, nested structure

The `extends` pattern allows code to type-check data that could contain ANY of these formats when reading from the database, ensuring backward compatibility while migrating to the new format.

### 3. **Where PairMetadata is Used**

**Direct Imports (6 files)**:
1. `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/hooks/segments/usePairMetadata.ts` - Type annotation for query return
2. `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/hooks/segments/useSegmentSettings.ts` - Type annotation for pairMetadata field (2 usages)
3. `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/SegmentSettingsForm/segmentSettingsMigration.ts` - Type definition

**Related Functionality (no direct import but uses the fields)**:
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/SegmentSettingsForm/segmentSettingsMigration.ts` - Contains `cleanupLegacyPairMetadata()` and `cleanupLegacyUserOverrides()` functions
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/lib/settingsMigration.ts` - Contains `readSegmentOverrides()` that ONLY reads from `segmentOverrides` (doesn't read legacy fields)

### 4. **Fields Breakdown**

**NEW FORMAT (always used for writing)**:
- `segmentOverrides` object with: prompt, negativePrompt, motionMode, amountOfMotion, phaseConfig, selectedPhasePresetId, loras, numFrames, randomSeed, seed, structureMotionStrength, structureTreatment, structureUni3cEndPercent, textBeforePrompts, textAfterPrompts
- `enhanced_prompt` string

**DEPRECATED pair_* fields (read-only now, being cleaned up)**:
- `pair_prompt`, `pair_negative_prompt`, `pair_phase_config`
- `pair_motion_settings` (nested object with motion_mode, amount_of_motion)
- `pair_loras`, `pair_num_frames`, `pair_random_seed`, `pair_seed`, `pair_selected_phase_preset_id`

**LEGACY user_overrides (very old, rarely used)**:
- `user_overrides` object with phase_config, motion_mode, amount_of_motion, additional_loras

### 5. **What Does Cleanup Look Like?**

The right cleanup has **three parts**:

**Part A: Flatten the type union** 
Instead of:
```typescript
export interface PairMetadata extends LegacyPairMetadataFields {
  segmentOverrides?: {...};
  enhanced_prompt?: string;
}
```

Become:
```typescript
export interface PairMetadata {
  segmentOverrides?: {...};
  enhanced_prompt?: string;
  // Optional: list legacy fields with deprecation comments if needed for docs
}
```

OR delete PairMetadata entirely and replace usages with more specific types:
- For query returns: `SegmentOverrides` (from `settingsMigration`)
- For metadata records: `Record<string, unknown>`

**Part B: Remove the cleanup functions**
Delete these functions from `segmentSettingsMigration.ts`:
- `cleanupLegacyPairMetadata()` (lines 296-310)
- `cleanupLegacyUserOverrides()` (lines 312-327)

These only exist to remove the old pair_* and user_overrides fields. Once nothing writes those fields, they're not needed.

**Part C: Consolidate the migration layer**
- `segmentSettingsMigrationLegacy.ts` becomes unnecessary (no longer extended)
- Its content can be deleted or moved to a legacy-data documentation file if needed for future context

### 6. **How Many Files Need to Change?**

**Minimal impact (only 3-4 files if you do the careful approach)**:

1. `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/SegmentSettingsForm/segmentSettingsMigration.ts` - Remove extends, remove cleanup functions, update comments (34, 296-327 lines affected)
2. `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/hooks/segments/usePairMetadata.ts` - Change `PairMetadata` return type to `SegmentOverrides | null` (1 type change)
3. `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/hooks/segments/useSegmentSettings.ts` - Change `pairMetadata: PairMetadata | null` to `pairMetadata: SegmentOverrides | null` (3 type changes)
4. `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/SegmentSettingsForm/segmentSettingsMigrationLegacy.ts` - **Delete entirely** (or rename to `segmentSettingsMigrationHistory.md` if you want to keep it for documentation purposes)

**No changes needed** in:
- Tests (they already mock the types)
- `settingsMigration.ts` (doesn't use PairMetadata, only SegmentOverrides)
- Any components using these hooks (the return types stay compatible)

### 7. **The Safe Cleanup Strategy**

Since `readSegmentOverrides()` (in `settingsMigration.ts`) already only reads from `segmentOverrides` and ignores legacy fields, the cleanup is **safe**:

1. **Week 1**: Deploy code that stops WRITING pair_* fields (already done - `buildMetadataUpdate()` only writes `segmentOverrides`)
2. **Week 2+**: Once you're confident no old data is being read, remove the type extends and cleanup functions
3. **Later**: Remove imports of LegacyPairMetadataFields once PairMetadata no longer extends it

### 8. **Why the Pattern Exists (Context)**

From the codebase comments:
- Line 14-15 in `segmentSettingsMigration.ts`: *"The PairMetadata type defines ALL known metadata shapes (new, deprecated pair_*, and legacy user_overrides) so callers can type-check against any format."*
- Line 31-32: *"Includes new format (segmentOverrides), deprecated pair_* fields, and legacy user_overrides for backward compatibility."*

The pattern was defensive—ensuring that type-checking would catch any data shape that COULD exist in the database. Now that you've stopped writing the old fields, the type can be simplified.

```
1→# Frontend Architecture Patterns
     2→
     3→---
     4→
     5→## State Management
     6→
     7→No Redux/Zustand. State flows through specific layers:
     8→
     9→| Layer | Tool | Purpose |
    10→|-------|------|---------|
    11→| **Server state** | React Query | Remote data (shots, generations, settings) |
    12→| **Query keys** | `queryKeys` registry (`shared/lib/queryKeys.ts`) | Single source of truth for all cache keys |
    13→| **Global UI state** | React Context | Cross-component state (selected project, current shot) |
    14→| **Persisted UI state** | `useUserUIState` | Preferences saved to user settings |
    15→| **Local state** | `useState`/`useReducer` | Component-internal state |
    16→| **URL state** | React Router | Route params, query strings |
    17→
    18→### Query Key Convention
    19→
    20→Keys use **nouns**, **kebab-case** for multi-word, scoped **broad-to-specific**:
    21→`['shots', projectId]` not `[projectId, 'shots']`.
    22→
    23→All keys live in `queryKeys` object. Invalidation goes through hooks in `shared/hooks/invalidation/`, never raw `queryClient.invalidateQueries`.
    24→
    25→---
    26→
    27→## Contexts
    28→
    29→| Context | Provider location |
    30→|---------|-------------------|
    31→| `AuthContext` | `App.tsx` (top-level) |
    32→| `ProjectContext` | `App.tsx` (inside auth) |
    33→| `UserSettingsContext` | `App.tsx` (inside auth) |
    34→| `ShotsContext` | Project route layout |
    35→| `CurrentShotContext` | Shot route layout |
    36→| `PanesContext` | Shot route layout |
    37→| `GenerationTaskContext` | Tool pages |
    38→| `AIInputModeContext` | Tool pages |
    39→| `IncomingTasksContext` | Project route layout |
    40→| `ToolPageHeaderContext` | Tool page layout |
    41→| `LastAffectedShotContext` | Project route layout |
    42→
    43→### Provider nesting order matters
    44→
    45→See `App.tsx` for the hierarchy. Providers that depend on others must be nested inside them (e.g., `ProjectContext` inside `AuthContext`).
    46→
    47→---
    48→
    49→## Cross-Cutting Systems (details in dedicated docs)
    50→
    51→| System | Doc |
    52→|--------|-----|
    53→| Settings (scope cascade, persistence) | [settings_system.md](settings_system.md) |
    54→| Error handling (typed errors, `handleError()`) | [error_handling.md](error_handling.md) |
    55→| Realtime (subscriptions, batching, invalidation) | [realtime_system.md](realtime_system.md) |
    56→| Performance (memoization, preloading, debouncing) | [performance_system.md](performance_system.md) |
    57→| Task creation (validate, transform, insert) | [unified_task_creation.md](unified_task_creation.md) |
    58→| Image loading (progressive, lazy, preload) | [image_loading_system.md](image_loading_system.md) |
    59→| Tool module structure | [adding_new_tool.md](../adding_new_tool.md) |
    60→| Shared utilities (ModalContainer, ConfirmDialog) | [shared_utilities.md](shared_utilities.md) |
    61→
    62→---
    63→
    64→## Shared Components Worth Knowing
    65→
    66→`ModalContainer`, `ConfirmDialog` -- See [shared_utilities.md](shared_utilities.md).
    67→
    68→---
    69→
    70→## Feature Checklist
    71→
    72→When building a new feature:
    73→
    74→- [ ] **Context needed?** Only if state is used by 3+ unrelated components.
    75→- [ ] **Hook extraction?** If logic is reused or complex (>20 lines)
    76→- [ ] **Query keys?** Add to `queryKeys` registry in `shared/lib/queryKeys.ts`
    77→- [ ] **Invalidation?** Use hooks from `shared/hooks/invalidation/`
    78→- [ ] **Error handling?** Use `handleError()` with typed errors
    79→- [ ] **Settings?** Use `useToolSettings` with scope cascade
    80→- [ ] **Types?** Add to `src/types/` if used across files
```

## Assessment Summary

**Score: 82.5 / 100**

The codebase has a well-structured explicit bootstrap chain (`bootstrap.tsx` -> `initializeAppEnvironment()`) and the critical Supabase client uses a proper lazy-initialization pattern with clear error messages. However, there are several repeated instances of import-time coupling that prevent a higher score.

### Key Strengths

1. **Explicit bootstrap orchestration**: `initializeAppEnvironment()` in `bootstrap.tsx` has idempotency guards and a clear initialization sequence (logger -> toast -> error presenter -> viewport lock -> supabase).
2. **Supabase client lazy-init**: The `supabaseRuntime.ts` module uses an explicit `initializeSupabaseClientRuntime()` function rather than module-level instantiation, with clear error messages when accessed before bootstrap.
3. **Lazy singletons where it matters**: `ReconnectScheduler`, `NetworkStatusManager`, and `AuthStateManager` all use lazy getter functions rather than module-level `new`.
4. **Dev-only tools via dynamic import**: Debug tools (autoplayMonitor, simpleCacheValidator, debugPolling) are loaded via `import()` in bootstrap, keeping them out of production bundles.

### Key Weaknesses

1. **Three realtime singletons instantiate at import time** (RealtimeConnection, DataFreshnessManager, RealtimeEventProcessor), with cross-dependencies between them.
2. **PreloadingService subscribes to DataFreshnessManager in its constructor**, which runs at import time -- creating a hidden initialization-order dependency.
3. **TaskTypeConfigInitializer renders outside AuthGate**, firing a Supabase query before authentication is verified.
4. **Two debug globals leak to production** (debugConfig and preloadingService) because they lack `import.meta.env.DEV` guards that other debug tools consistently use.
5. **settingsWriteQueue registers event listeners at import time** before the write function is injected.

---

**Assessment Summary**

Starting from 100, I subtracted for the following evidence-based issues:

- **-8**: The `ImageEditState` god-context pattern with duplicated 60+ field assembly in two files (useImageEditOrchestrator and useInlineEditState). This is a clear violation of single responsibility and creates maintenance burden.

- **-5**: The `useSharedLightboxState` over-facaded architecture (812 lines, 20 exports, alias exports, sub-facades used only internally). The facade pattern here obscures rather than simplifies.

- **-4**: `SegmentSlotModeData` mega-interface with ~40 fields mixing 5+ concerns. Consumers must thread the entire interface even when needing a subset.

- **-3**: `useEditSettingsPersistence` mixing per-generation settings, last-used settings, video settings, panel mode, and LoRA resolution in a single 387-line hook returning 35+ fields.

- **-2**: `buildLightboxVideoModeReturn` is a pure passthrough function that copies every field without transformation -- unnecessary indirection.

- **-2**: `SharedGenerationView` mixing auth logic, RPC calls, data transforms, and rendering in a single 467-line component.

- **-1.5**: `FinalVideoSection` with 3 competing data pathways and 2^4 behavior mode matrix from combined controlled/uncontrolled/preloaded/readOnly branching.

- **-1**: Trivial `setPayloadField` helpers that wrap single-line property assignments with function calls.

- **-0.5**: DOM querying for video duration in `useVideoEditModeHandlers` instead of using an existing ref.

- **-0.5**: `cancelPendingTasks` duplicate database query with identical filters.

The codebase shows clear effort toward decomposition (sub-contexts for ImageEdit, hook composition for reposition mode, task placeholder pattern) but the abstractions frequently don't earn their weight: facades that add indirection without simplifying, builder functions that copy fields unchanged, and mega-interfaces that bundle unrelated concerns. The lightbox system in particular has grown into a deep hook hierarchy where state must be threaded through 4-5 layers of composition hooks, making it hard to trace where a value comes from or who changes it.

Here is the complete assessment of the **cross_module_architecture** dimension.

## Summary

The codebase has a clear intended architecture: `shared/` provides common code, `tools/` provides tool-specific implementations, `features/` provides domain slices, `domains/` provides core entity types, and `supabase/functions/` handles server-side logic. Several boundaries are well-maintained -- for example, no tool imports from another tool, no shared code imports from pages/app, and edge functions properly isolate through `_shared/`. However, there are recurring structural issues that erode trust in the boundaries.

### Key Structural Issues

**1. Bidirectional shared <-> features dependency (Critical)**
`src/shared/` (1621 files) and `src/features/` (34 files) import from each other freely. Features was likely an attempt to extract domain-specific code, but with only 34 files extracted while shared still contains massive domain-specific modules (MediaLightbox at 232 files), the extraction is incomplete and the bidirectional dependency defeats its purpose.

**2. Indirect shared -> tools dependency chain (Critical)**
`shared/lib/toolSettingsService.ts` imports from `@/tooling/toolDefaultsRegistry.ts`, which imports settings from 5 different `@/tools/` modules. This creates a `shared -> tooling -> tools` dependency chain that violates the core architectural principle.

**3. Tool-specific code proliferation in shared/ (Significant)**
`JoinClipsSettingsForm/` (15+ files), `travelBetweenImages/` task builders (9 files), tool-specific TaskDetails views, tool-specific settings/hooks -- all living in shared. Segment hooks hardcode `TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES` four times.

**4. Layer inversions within shared/ (Significant)**
- `lib/taskConfig.ts` imports from `hooks/tasks/useTaskType` (lib should not depend on hooks)
- `lib/generationTransformers.ts` imports types from `components/MediaGallery/types.ts`
- `hooks/useLoraManager.tsx` renders JSX (importing and using a component)
- Multiple hooks import types owned by component directories (SegmentSettingsForm, VariantSelector, MediaGallery)

**5. MediaLightbox as a hidden mega-module (Significant)**
At 232 files, it is essentially a feature module disguised as a shared component, with its own hooks, components, contexts, utils, and tool-specific logic. The `features/image-edit/` barrel file is a 79-line passthrough that just re-exports MediaLightbox internals.

### What Works Well

- **tools/ encapsulation**: Tools don't import from each other; pages import from components (correct direction); components don't import from pages.
- **domains/ layer**: Clean and small (1 domain: generation), with correct dependency direction (domains imports from shared, shared imports domain types).
- **Edge function isolation**: Functions use `_shared/` properly, no cross-function imports.
- **No upward imports**: Neither shared nor tools import from pages/app.
- **TOOL_IDS constants**: Using canonical IDs rather than string literals (even if the references in shared code are still tool-specific).

### Score: 73.5 / 100

The boundaries exist and are partially respected, but recurring drift in 3-4 hotspot areas (shared-features cycle, tooling registry chain, MediaLightbox mega-module, layer inversions in lib/hooks/components) indicates structural boundary debt that goes beyond isolated issues. The architecture is coherent enough to navigate but not trusted enough that a developer can rely on layer constraints without verifying.

   494→
   495→export function useInlineEditState(
   496→  media: GenerationRow,
   497→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>,
   498→): InlineEditStateResult {
   499→  const env = useInlineEditEnvironment(media);
   500→  const persistence = useInlineEditPersistence(env.actualGenerationId, env.selectedProjectId);
   501→  const activeVariant = persistence.variants.activeVariant;
   502→  const effectiveImageUrl = activeVariant?.location || env.effectiveImageUrl;
   503→
   504→  useEffect(() => {
   505→    env.setUpscaleActiveVariant(activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id);
   506→  }, [env, activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id]);
   507→
   508→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   509→  const { inpainting, magic } = useInlineEditInpaintingAndMagic(media, env, persistence);
   510→  const reposition = useInlineEditReposition(media, env, inpainting, persistence);
   511→  const img2img = useInlineEditImg2Img(media, env, persistence, availableLoras);
   512→
   513→  useInlineEditSettingsSync(env.actualGenerationId, persistence.editSettings, inpainting);
   514→
   515→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   516→    media,
   517→    onOpenExternalGeneration: onNavigateToGeneration
   518→      ? async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id)
   519→      : undefined,
   520→  });
   521→
   522→  const starToggle = useStarToggle({ media });
   523→
   524→  const handleDownload = async () => {
   525→    await downloadMedia(effectiveImageUrl, media.id, env.isVideo, media.contentType);
   526→  };
   527→
   528→  const {
   529→    inpaintingState,
   530→    transformState,
   531→    generationState,
   532→    imageEditValue,
   533→  } = buildInlineEditStateModels({
   534→    env,
   535→    persistence,
   536→    inpainting,
   537→    magic,
   538→    reposition,
   539→    img2img,
   540→    starToggle,
   541→    handleDownload,
   542→  });
   543→
   544→  return {
   545→    media,
   546→    canvasEnvironment: {
   547→      isMobile: env.isMobile,
   548→      selectedProjectId: env.selectedProjectId,
   549→      isCloudMode: env.isCloudMode,
   550→      isVideo: env.isVideo,
   551→      imageContainerRef: env.imageContainerRef,
   552→      effectiveImageUrl,
   553→      imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions,
   554→      setImageDimensions: env.setImageDimensions,
   555→      isUpscaling: env.isUpscaling,
   556→      handleUpscale: env.handleUpscale,
   557→    },
   558→    inpaintingState,
   559→    transformState,
   560→    generationState,
   561→    variants: {
   562→      variants: persistence.variants.variants,
   563→      activeVariant: persistence.variants.activeVariant,
   564→      isLoading: persistence.variants.isLoading,
   565→      setActiveVariantId: persistence.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   566→      setPrimaryVariant: persistence.variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   567→      deleteVariant: persistence.variants.deleteVariant,
   568→    },
   569→    sourceGenerationData,
   570→    availableLoras,
   571→    imageEditValue,
   572→  } satisfies InlineEditStateResult;
   573→}
   574→

     9→ * The split reduces re-renders: canvas components don't re-render when the user
    10→ * types in a prompt field, and form components don't re-render on brush strokes.
    11→ *
    12→ * ImageEditState still exists as a composed type. Components should use the
    13→ * specific sub-context hooks (useImageEditCanvasSafe, useImageEditFormSafe,
    14→ * useImageEditStatusSafe) for optimal performance.
    15→ */

    17→import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
    18→
    19→// Sub-contexts
    20→import {
    21→  ImageEditCanvasProvider,

    42→// Composed Type (backward-compatible)
    43→// ============================================================================
    44→
    45→/**
    46→ * Full image edit state, composed from the three sub-contexts.
    47→ * Consumers that need fields from only one concern should use the
    48→ * sub-context hooks directly for better performance.
    49→ */
    50→export type ImageEditState =
    51→  ImageEditCanvasState &

    24→type TreeProvider = React.ComponentType<{ children: React.ReactNode }>;
    25→
    26→function composeProviders(providers: TreeProvider[]): TreeProvider {
    27→  return function ProviderTree({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    28→    return providers.reduceRight(
    29→      (acc, Provider) => <Provider>{acc}</Provider>,
    30→      children
    31→    );
    32→  };
    33→}
    34→
    35→const AppProviderTree = composeProviders([
    36→  AuthProvider,
    37→  AuthGate,
    38→  UserSettingsProvider,
    39→  ProjectProvider,
    40→  RealtimeProvider,
    41→  ShotsProvider,
    42→  GenerationTaskProvider,

    44→  PanesProvider,
    45→  ShotAdditionSelectionProvider,
    46→  LastAffectedShotProvider,
    47→  CurrentShotProvider,
    48→  ToolPageHeaderProvider,
    49→]);
    50→
    51→export function AppProviders({ children }: AppProvidersProps) {
    52→  return (
    53→    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
    54→      <TooltipProvider delayDuration={300}>
    55→        <TaskTypeConfigInitializer />
    56→        <AppProviderTree>{children}</AppProviderTree>
    57→      </TooltipProvider>
    58→    </QueryClientProvider>
    59→  );

1→/**
     2→ * Global Settings Write Queue
     3→ *
     4→ * Prevents network exhaustion by serializing and coalescing settings writes.
     5→ *
     6→ * Features:
     7→ * - Global concurrency limit (default: 1 in-flight write)
     8→ * - Per-target debouncing (coalesces rapid updates)
     9→ * - Merge-on-write (latest patch wins per field)
    10→ * - Optional AbortSignal passthrough for caller cancellation
    11→ * - Best-effort flush on page unload
    12→ *
    13→ * @see settings_system.md for the full settings architecture
    14→ */
    15→
    16→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    17→
    18→export interface QueuedWrite {
    19→  scope: 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
    20→  entityId: string;
    21→  toolId: string;
    22→  patch: Record<string, unknown>;
    23→  signal?: AbortSignal;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface PendingWrite {
    27→  write: QueuedWrite;
    28→  resolvers: Array<{ resolve: (value: unknown) => void; reject: (error: unknown) => void }>;
    29→  timerId: NodeJS.Timeout | null;
    30→  enqueuedAt: number;
    31→}
    32→
    33→// Configuration
    34→const DEBOUNCE_MS = 300;
    35→const MAX_CONCURRENT = 1;
    36→
    37→// State
    38→const pendingByTarget = new Map<string, PendingWrite>();
    39→let inFlightCount = 0;
    40→const flushQueue: Array<{ targetKey: string; pending: PendingWrite }> = [];
    41→
    42→// The actual write function - injected to avoid circular imports
    43→let writeFunction: ((write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) | null = null;
    44→
    45→function createAbortError(): Error {
    46→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    47→    return new DOMException('Request was cancelled', 'AbortError');
    48→  }
    49→  const error = new Error('Request was cancelled');
    50→  error.name = 'AbortError';
    51→  return error;
    52→}
    53→
    54→function throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {
    55→  if (signal?.aborted) {
    56→    throw createAbortError();
    57→  }
    58→}
    59→
    60→/**
    61→ * Set the write function that performs the actual DB update.
    62→ * Must be called once at app init (in useToolSettings.ts).
    63→ */
    64→export function setSettingsWriteFunction(fn: (write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) {
    65→  writeFunction = fn;
    66→}
    67→
    68→/**
    69→ * Create a unique key for deduplication
    70→ */
    71→function targetKey(write: QueuedWrite): string {
    72→  return `${write.scope}:${write.entityId}:${write.toolId}`;
    73→}
    74→
    75→/**
    76→ * Shallow merge (one level deep)
    77→ */
    78→function shallowMergePatch(existing: Record<string, unknown>, incoming: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
    79→  return { ...existing, ...incoming };
    80→}
    81→
    82→/**
    83→ * Process the next item in the flush queue
    84→ */
    85→async function processQueue() {
    86→  if (inFlightCount >= MAX_CONCURRENT || flushQueue.length === 0) {
    87→    return;
    88→  }
    89→
    90→  const next = flushQueue.shift();
    91→  if (!next) return;
    92→
    93→  const { targetKey: key, pending } = next;
    94→  
    95→  // Remove from pending map (we're about to process it)
    96→  pendingByTarget.delete(key);
    97→  
    98→  inFlightCount++;
    99→  
   100→  try {
   101→    if (!writeFunction) {
   102→      throw new Error('[SettingsWriteQueue] Write function not initialized');
   103→    }
   104→
   105→    throwIfAborted(pending.write.signal);
   106→    const result = await writeFunction(pending.write);
   107→    
   108→    // Resolve all waiters
   109→    for (const { resolve } of pending.resolvers) {
   110→      resolve(result);
   111→    }
   112→  } catch (error) {
   113→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'SettingsWriteQueue', showToast: false });
   114→
   115→    // Reject all waiters
   116→    for (const { reject } of pending.resolvers) {
   117→      reject(error);
   118→    }
   119→  } finally {
   120→    inFlightCount--;
   121→    
   122→    // Process next item
   123→    processQueue();
   124→  }
   125→}
   126→
   127→/**
   128→ * Schedule a pending write for flush
   129→ */
   130→function scheduleFlush(key: string, pending: PendingWrite) {
   131→  // Clear existing timer
   132→  if (pending.timerId) {
   133→    clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   134→    pending.timerId = null;
   135→  }
   136→  
   137→  // Add to flush queue and process
   138→  flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   139→  processQueue();
   140→}
   141→
   142→/**
   143→ * Enqueue a settings write.
   144→ * 
   145→ * Returns a promise that resolves when the write completes.
   146→ * Multiple writes to the same target within the debounce window are merged.
   147→ * 
   148→ * @param write - The write to enqueue
   149→ * @param mode - 'debounced' (default) waits for debounce window; 'immediate' flushes now
   150→ */
   151→export function enqueueSettingsWrite(
   152→  write: QueuedWrite,
   153→  mode: 'debounced' | 'immediate' = 'debounced'
   154→): Promise<unknown> {
   155→  const key = targetKey(write);
   156→
   157→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   158→    if (write.signal?.aborted) {
   159→      reject(createAbortError());
   160→      return;
   161→    }
   162→
   163→    const existing = pendingByTarget.get(key);
   164→
   165→    if (existing) {
   166→      // Merge with existing pending write
   167→      existing.write.patch = shallowMergePatch(existing.write.patch, write.patch);
   168→      if (write.signal) {
   169→        existing.write.signal = write.signal;
   170→      }
   171→      existing.resolvers.push({ resolve, reject });
   172→
   173→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   174→        // Cancel debounce timer and flush now
   175→        scheduleFlush(key, existing);
   176→      }
   177→      // else: existing timer will handle it
   178→      
   179→    } else {
   180→      // Create new pending write
   181→      const pending: PendingWrite = {
   182→        write: { ...write, patch: { ...write.patch } },
   183→        resolvers: [{ resolve, reject }],
   184→        timerId: null,
   185→        enqueuedAt: Date.now(),
   186→      };
   187→
   188→      pendingByTarget.set(key, pending);
   189→
   190→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   191→        scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   192→      } else {
   193→        // Set debounce timer
   194→        pending.timerId = setTimeout(() => {
   195→          scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   196→        }, DEBOUNCE_MS);
   197→      }
   198→    }
   199→  });
   200→}
   201→
   202→
   203→/**
   204→ * Flush all pending writes immediately.
   205→ * Best-effort: returns without waiting.
   206→ */
   207→function flushAll(): void {
   208→  for (const [key, pending] of pendingByTarget.entries()) {
   209→    if (pending.timerId) {
   210→      clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   211→      pending.timerId = null;
   212→    }
   213→    flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   214→  }
   215→  pendingByTarget.clear();
   216→  processQueue();
   217→}
   218→
   219→// Best-effort flush on page unload and tab hide
   220→// Mobile browsers don't reliably fire beforeunload (e.g., tab switching on iOS Safari),
   221→// so we also flush on visibilitychange to prevent losing pending writes.
   222→if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
   223→  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
   224→    flushAll();
   225→  });
   226→
   227→  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
   228→    if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
   229→      flushAll();
   230→    }
   231→  });
   232→}
   233→
