    10→async function cancelTask(taskId: string): Promise<void> {
    11→  // First, get the task to check if it's an orchestrator
    12→  const { data: task, error: fetchError } = await supabase().from('tasks')
    13→    .select('*')
    14→    .eq('id', taskId)
    15→    .single();
    16→
    17→  if (fetchError) {
    18→    throw new Error(`Failed to fetch task: ${fetchError.message}`);
    19→  }
    20→
    21→  // Check if task can be cancelled (only Queued tasks can be cancelled from UI)
    22→  if (task.status !== 'Queued' && task.status !== 'In Progress') {
    23→    throw new Error(`Task is already ${task.status}`);
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  // Cancel the main task - use .select() to verify the update happened
    27→  const { data: updatedTask, error: cancelError } = await supabase().from('tasks')
    28→    .update({
    29→      status: 'Cancelled',
    30→      updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
    31→    })
    32→    .eq('id', taskId)
    33→    .select('id, status')
    34→    .single();
    35→
    36→  if (cancelError) {
    37→    throw new Error(`Failed to cancel task: ${cancelError.message}`);
    38→  }
    39→
    40→  // Verify the update actually happened
    41→  if (!updatedTask || updatedTask.status !== 'Cancelled') {
    42→    const err = new Error('Task cancellation failed - status not updated');
    43→    normalizeAndPresentError(err, { context: 'useCancelTask', showToast: false, logData: { updatedTask } });
    44→    throw err;
    45→  }
    46→
    47→  // If it's an orchestrator task, cancel all subtasks
    48→  if (task && task.task_type?.includes('orchestrator')) {
    49→    // Find all subtasks that reference this orchestrator
    50→    const { data: subtasks, error: subtaskFetchError } = await supabase().from('tasks')
    51→      .select('id, params')
    52→      .eq('project_id', task.project_id)
    53→      .in('status', ['Queued']);
    54→
    55→    if (!subtaskFetchError && subtasks) {

    60→      }).map(subtask => subtask.id);
    61→
    62→      if (subtaskIds.length > 0) {

    64→        const { error: subtaskCancelError } = await supabase().from('tasks')

    72→          normalizeAndPresentError(subtaskCancelError, { context: 'useCancelTask', showToast: false });
    73→        }
    74→      }
    75→    }
    76→  }
    77→}

    51→export function setTaskLineageFields(

    61→  setPayloadFieldIfTruthy(payload, 'tool_type', fields.toolType);

   115→
   116→interface UseTrimPlaybackGuardInput {
   117→  trimVideoRef: React.RefObject<HTMLVideoElement>;
   118→  trimState: UseLightboxVideoModeReturn['trimState'];
   119→  isVideoTrimMode: boolean;
   120→}
   121→
   122→function useTrimPlaybackGuard({ trimVideoRef, trimState, isVideoTrimMode }: UseTrimPlaybackGuardInput): void {
   123→  useEffect(() => {
   124→    const video = trimVideoRef.current;
   125→    if (!video || !isVideoTrimMode) {
   126→      return;
   127→    }
   128→
   129→    const keepStart = trimState.startTrim;
   130→    const keepEnd = trimState.videoDuration - trimState.endTrim;
   131→    if (video.currentTime < keepStart || video.currentTime >= keepEnd) {
   132→      video.currentTime = keepStart;
   133→    }
   134→
   135→    if (video.paused) {
   136→      video.play().catch(() => {});
   137→    }
   138→  }, [isVideoTrimMode, trimState.startTrim, trimState.endTrim, trimState.videoDuration, trimVideoRef]);
   139→}
   140→
   141→export function useLightboxVideoMode(props: UseLightboxVideoModeProps): UseLightboxVideoModeReturn {
   142→  const {
   143→    onTrimModeChange,
   144→  } = props;
   145→  const {
   146→    media,
   147→    isVideo,
   148→    selectedProjectId,
   149→    projectAspectRatio,
   150→    shotId,
   151→    actualGenerationId,
   152→    effectiveVideoUrl,
   153→  } = props.core;
   154→  const { activeVariant, setActiveVariantId, refetchVariants } = props.variants;
   155→  const {
   156→    videoEditSubMode,
   157→    setVideoEditSubMode, // The wrapper is passed in from the caller (handles both local state + persistence)
   158→    persistedVideoEditSubMode,
   159→    setPersistedPanelMode,
   160→  } = props.editState;
   161→  const {
   162→    settings: enhanceSettings,
   163→    setSettings: setEnhanceSettings,
   164→    canRegenerate,
   165→  } = props.enhance;
   166→
   167→  // Refs
   168→  const trimVideoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
   169→
   170→  // Trim current time state
   171→  const [trimCurrentTime, setTrimCurrentTime] = useState(0);
   172→
   173→  // Video trimming hook - manage trim state
   174→  const trimmingHook = useVideoTrimming();
   175→  const {
   176→    trimState,
   177→    setStartTrim,
   178→    setEndTrim,
   179→    resetTrim,
   180→    setVideoDuration,
   181→    trimmedDuration,
   182→    hasTrimChanges,
   183→  } = trimmingHook;
   184→
   185→  // Derived states
   186→  const isVideoTrimMode = videoEditSubMode === 'trim';
   187→  const isInVideoEditMode = videoEditSubMode !== null;
   188→
   189→  useTrimPlaybackGuard({ trimVideoRef, trimState, isVideoTrimMode });
   190→
   191→  // Trim save hook
   192→  // Use getGenerationId to get actual generations.id
   193→  // media.id from shot queries is shot_generations.id, not generations.id
   194→  const trimSaveHook = useTrimSave({
   195→    generationId: getGenerationId(media),
   196→    projectId: selectedProjectId,
   197→    sourceVideoUrl: effectiveVideoUrl,
   198→    trimState,
   199→    sourceVariantId: activeVariant?.id,
   200→    onSuccess: (newVariantId) => {
   201→      resetTrim();
   202→      refetchVariants();
   203→      setActiveVariantId(newVariantId);
   204→      setVideoEditSubMode(null);
   205→      onTrimModeChange?.(false);
   206→    },
   207→  });
   208→  const {
   209→    isSaving: isSavingTrim,
   210→    saveProgress: trimSaveProgress,
   211→    saveError: trimSaveError,
   212→    saveSuccess: trimSaveSuccess,
   213→    saveTrimmedVideo,
   214→  } = trimSaveHook;
   215→
   216→  // Video editing hook (replace mode)
   217→  const videoEditing = useVideoEditing({
   218→    media,
   219→    selectedProjectId,
   220→    projectAspectRatio,
   221→    isVideo,
   222→    videoDuration: trimState.videoDuration,
   223→    videoUrl: effectiveVideoUrl,
   224→    onExitVideoEditMode: () => {
   225→      onTrimModeChange?.(false);
   226→    },
   227→  });
   228→
   229→  // Video enhance hook
   230→  const videoEnhance = useVideoEnhance({
   231→    projectId: selectedProjectId ?? undefined,
   232→    videoUrl: effectiveVideoUrl,
   233→    shotId,
   234→    generationId: actualGenerationId || undefined,
   235→    activeVariantId: activeVariant?.id,
   236→    settings: enhanceSettings,
   237→    updateSettings: setEnhanceSettings,
   238→  });
   239→
   240→  // Video edit mode handlers
   241→  const videoEditModeHandlers = useVideoEditModeHandlers({
   242→    setVideoEditSubMode,
   243→    persistedVideoEditSubMode,
   244→    canRegenerate,
   245→    setPersistedPanelMode,
   246→    videoEditingSetIsVideoEditMode: videoEditing.setIsVideoEditMode,
   247→    onTrimModeChange,
   248→    resetTrim,
   249→    setVideoDuration,
   250→    trimVideoRef,
   251→  });
   252→  const isVideoTrimModeActive = isVideo && isVideoTrimMode;
   253→  const isVideoEditModeActive = isVideo && videoEditing.isVideoEditMode;
   254→
   255→  return {
   256→    trimVideoRef,
   257→    trimState,
   258→    trimCurrentTime,
   259→    setTrimCurrentTime,
   260→    trimmedDuration,
   261→    hasTrimChanges,
   262→    setStartTrim,
   263→    setEndTrim,
   264→    resetTrim,
   265→    setVideoDuration,
   266→    isSavingTrim,
   267→    trimSaveProgress,
   268→    trimSaveError,
   269→    trimSaveSuccess,
   270→    saveTrimmedVideo,
   271→    videoEditing,
   272→    videoEnhance: {
   273→      settings: videoEnhance.settings,
   274→      updateSetting: videoEnhance.updateSetting,
   275→      handleGenerate: videoEnhance.handleGenerate,
   276→      isGenerating: videoEnhance.isGenerating,
   277→      generateSuccess: videoEnhance.generateSuccess,
   278→      canSubmit: videoEnhance.canSubmit,
   279→    },
   280→    handleEnterVideoEditMode: videoEditModeHandlers.handleEnterVideoEditMode,
   281→    handleExitVideoEditMode: videoEditModeHandlers.handleExitVideoEditMode,
   282→    handleEnterVideoTrimMode: videoEditModeHandlers.handleEnterVideoTrimMode,
   283→    handleEnterVideoReplaceMode: videoEditModeHandlers.handleEnterVideoReplaceMode,
   284→    handleEnterVideoRegenerateMode: videoEditModeHandlers.handleEnterVideoRegenerateMode,
   285→    handleEnterVideoEnhanceMode: videoEditModeHandlers.handleEnterVideoEnhanceMode,
   286→    handleExitVideoTrimMode: videoEditModeHandlers.handleExitVideoTrimMode,
   287→    isVideoTrimMode,
   288→    isInVideoEditMode,
   289→    isVideoTrimModeActive,
   290→    isVideoEditModeActive,
   291→  };
   292→}

### **Finding 1: `cancelPendingTasks` Duplicate Query**

**Assessment:**
This is **NOT a duplicate query problem**. Reading the code carefully:

- The function then iterates through that single result set twice (lines 126 and 134) to:
  1. Add all pending task IDs to the cancel set
  2. Find orchestrator task references among the subtasks
  
There is no duplicate query here. The function makes one efficient query and reuses the result through two passes of the same data. The finding is a **false positive**.

**Recommended action:** **WONTFIX** — No actual duplication exists. The code makes a single query and processes the results efficiently.

### **Finding 2: `buildLightboxVideoModeReturn` Passthrough**

**Location:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/src/shared/components/MediaLightbox/hooks/useLightboxVideoMode.ts` (lines 141-292)

The 60 lines of return statement are not merely copying fields—they're performing selective projection and synthesis of the hook outputs into a structured interface. Removing this would require flattening the return shape or passing through all internal hook outputs unfiltered, which would be worse API design.

**Recommended action:** **WONTFIX** — The function performs meaningful field selection and synthesis. It's not a trivial wrapper; it's an intentional facade that structures multiple hook outputs into a clean interface.

     export type PayloadRecord = Record<string, unknown>;
     interface TaskLineageFields {
       shotId?: string;
       basedOn?: string;
       sourceVariantId?: string;
       createAsGeneration?: boolean;
       toolType?: string;
       markPrimaryWhenBasedOn?: boolean;
     }
     export function setTaskLineageFields(
       payload: PayloadRecord,
       fields: TaskLineageFields,
     ): void {
       if (fields.shotId) payload['shot_id'] = fields.shotId;
       if (fields.basedOn) {
         payload['based_on'] = fields.basedOn;
         payload['parent_generation_id'] = fields.basedOn;
       }
       if (fields.sourceVariantId) payload['source_variant_id'] = fields.sourceVariantId;
       if (fields.createAsGeneration) payload['create_as_generation'] = true;
       if (fields.toolType) payload['tool_type'] = fields.toolType;
       if (fields.markPrimaryWhenBasedOn && fields.basedOn) payload['is_primary'] = true;
     }
